content:
# =============================================================================
# FlexClone Serverless Pipeline — Step Functions + Lambda + EventBridge
# =============================================================================
#
# FlexClone の作成からマルチプロトコルマウント、サーバーレスファイル処理までの
# 統合パイプライン。Snapshot → FlexClone → WaitForOnline → ProcessFiles →
# CreateCIFSShare → Notify の 6 ステップ。
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/flexclone-serverless-pipeline.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-flexclone-pipeline \
#     --parameter-overrides \
#       EnableFlexClonePipeline=true \
#       OntapMgmtIp=10.0.1.100 \
#       OntapCredentialsSecret=fsxn/ontap-credentials \
#       SvmUuid=xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx \
#       ParentVolumeUuid=xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx \
#       S3AccessPointAlias=fsxn-s3ap-xxx-ext-s3alias \
#       NotificationTopicArn=arn:aws:sns:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:topic \
#       VpcId=vpc-xxx \
#       SubnetIds=subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb \
#       SecurityGroupId=sg-xxx \
#     --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
#
# オプトイン制御:
#   EnableFlexClonePipeline=false (デフォルト) でリソースは作成されない。
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — FlexClone Serverless Pipeline.
  Snapshot → FlexClone → WaitForOnline → ProcessFiles → CreateCIFSShare → Notify.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  EnableFlexClonePipeline:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: FlexClone Pipeline 機能を有効化する

  OntapMgmtIp:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      ONTAP ファイルシステム管理 IP アドレス（SVM 管理 IP ではない）。
      aws fsx describe-file-systems --query 'FileSystems[0].OntapConfiguration.Endpoints.Management.IpAddresses[0]'
      で取得可能。fsxadmin は FS レベルの管理 IP でのみ認証される。

  OntapCredentialsSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Secrets Manager シークレット名（ONTAP 認証情報）

  SvmUuid:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: SVM UUID

  ParentVolumeUuid:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: クローン元ボリューム UUID

  S3AccessPointAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 Access Point エイリアス（xxx-ext-s3alias 形式）

  S3AccessPointName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: S3 Access Point 名（IAM ポリシーの ARN に使用）

  NotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: 完了通知 SNS Topic ARN

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ONTAP REST API アクセス用 VPC ID

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Private Subnet IDs（ONTAP 管理 LIF 到達可能）

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Lambda 用 Security Group ID

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(1 day)"
    Description: EventBridge スケジュール式

  EnableSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: EventBridge スケジュールを有効化する（デフォルト無効）

Conditions:
  IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled:
    !Equals [!Ref EnableFlexClonePipeline, "true"]

  IsScheduleEnabled:
    !And
      - !Condition IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
      - !Equals [!Ref EnableSchedule, "true"]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CreateSnapshotRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-snapshot-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OntapSnapshotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${OntapCredentialsSecret}*"

  CreateFlexCloneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-create-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OntapClonePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${OntapCredentialsSecret}*"

  ProcessFilesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-process-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3APAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3APListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${S3AccessPointName}"
              - Sid: S3APReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${S3AccessPointName}/object/*"

  CreateCIFSShareRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-cifs-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OntapCIFSPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${OntapCredentialsSecret}*"

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-sfn-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CreateSnapshotFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CreateFlexCloneFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ProcessFilesFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CreateCIFSShareFunction.Arn
              - Sid: SNSPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopicArn

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-scheduler-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt FlexCloneStateMachine.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CreateSnapshotFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-snapshot"
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        def handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Role: !GetAtt CreateSnapshotRole.Arn
      VpcConfig:
        SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ONTAP_MGMT_IP: !Ref OntapMgmtIp
          ONTAP_CREDENTIALS_SECRET: !Ref OntapCredentialsSecret
      Tags:
        Component: flexclone-pipeline
        Phase: "14"

  CreateFlexCloneFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-create"
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        def handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Role: !GetAtt CreateFlexCloneRole.Arn
      VpcConfig:
        SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ONTAP_MGMT_IP: !Ref OntapMgmtIp
          ONTAP_CREDENTIALS_SECRET: !Ref OntapCredentialsSecret
          SVM_UUID: !Ref SvmUuid
      Tags:
        Component: flexclone-pipeline
        Phase: "14"

  ProcessFilesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-process"
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        def handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 300
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Role: !GetAtt ProcessFilesRole.Arn
      # NOTE: VpcConfig なし — Internet Origin S3AP にアクセスするため VPC 外実行
      Environment:
        Variables:
          S3AP_ALIAS: !Ref S3AccessPointAlias
      Tags:
        Component: flexclone-pipeline
        Phase: "14"

  CreateCIFSShareFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-cifs-share"
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        def handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Role: !GetAtt CreateCIFSShareRole.Arn
      VpcConfig:
        SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ONTAP_MGMT_IP: !Ref OntapMgmtIp
          ONTAP_CREDENTIALS_SECRET: !Ref OntapCredentialsSecret
      Tags:
        Component: flexclone-pipeline
        Phase: "14"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions State Machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  FlexCloneStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-pipeline"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "FlexClone Serverless Pipeline — Snapshot → Clone → Wait → Process → CIFS Share → Notify",
          "StartAt": "CreateSnapshot",
          "States": {
            "CreateSnapshot": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${CreateSnapshotFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "volume_uuid.$": "$.volume_uuid",
                "snapshot_name.$": "$.snapshot_name"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.snapshot_result",
              "Next": "CreateFlexClone",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                  "MaxAttempts": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ]
            },
            "CreateFlexClone": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${CreateFlexCloneFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "parent_volume_uuid.$": "$.volume_uuid",
                "snapshot_name.$": "$.snapshot_result.snapshot_name",
                "clone_name.$": "$.clone_name",
                "junction_path.$": "$.junction_path",
                "security_style.$": "$.security_style"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.clone_result",
              "Next": "WaitForOnline",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                  "MaxAttempts": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ]
            },
            "WaitForOnline": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "ShouldProcessFiles"
            },
            "ShouldProcessFiles": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.process_files",
                  "BooleanEquals": true,
                  "Next": "ProcessFiles"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "ShouldCreateCIFSShare"
            },
            "ProcessFiles": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${ProcessFilesFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "s3ap_alias.$": "$.s3ap_alias",
                "prefix.$": "$.file_prefix",
                "output_prefix.$": "$.output_prefix",
                "operation.$": "$.operation"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.process_result",
              "Next": "ShouldCreateCIFSShare",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 10,
                  "MaxAttempts": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ]
            },
            "ShouldCreateCIFSShare": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.create_cifs_share",
                  "BooleanEquals": true,
                  "Next": "CreateCIFSShare"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "NotifyCompletion"
            },
            "CreateCIFSShare": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${CreateCIFSShareFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "svm_name.$": "$.svm_name",
                "share_name.$": "$.share_name",
                "junction_path.$": "$.clone_result.junction_path",
                "comment.$": "$.share_comment"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.cifs_result",
              "Next": "NotifyCompletion",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                  "MaxAttempts": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ]
            },
            "NotifyCompletion": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::sns:publish",
              "Parameters": {
                "TopicArn": "${NotificationTopicArn}",
                "Subject": "FlexClone Pipeline Complete",
                "Message.$": "States.Format('FlexClone pipeline completed. Clone: {}, Junction: {}', $.clone_name, $.clone_result.junction_path)"
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Component
          Value: flexclone-pipeline
        - Key: Phase
          Value: "14"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Schedule (default disabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  FlexCloneSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Condition: IsScheduleEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-schedule"
      Description: FlexClone パイプライン定期実行スケジュール
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !GetAtt FlexCloneStateMachine.Arn
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: !Sub |
          {
            "volume_uuid": "${ParentVolumeUuid}",
            "snapshot_name": "scheduled_clone",
            "clone_name": "scheduled_clone",
            "junction_path": "/scheduled_clone",
            "security_style": "unix",
            "s3ap_alias": "${S3AccessPointAlias}",
            "process_files": false,
            "create_cifs_share": false
          }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Description: FlexClone Pipeline State Machine ARN
    Value: !GetAtt FlexCloneStateMachine.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StateMachineArn"

  CreateSnapshotFunctionArn:
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Description: CreateSnapshot Lambda ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CreateSnapshotFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateSnapshotFunctionArn"

  CreateFlexCloneFunctionArn:
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Description: CreateFlexClone Lambda ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CreateFlexCloneFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateFlexCloneFunctionArn"

  ProcessFilesFunctionArn:
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Description: ProcessFiles Lambda ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessFilesFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ProcessFilesFunctionArn"

  CreateCIFSShareFunctionArn:
    Condition: IsFlexClonePipelineEnabled
    Description: CreateCIFSShare Lambda ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CreateCIFSShareFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CreateCIFSShareFunctionArn"

resource_types: AWS::Events::Rule | AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile | AWS::IAM::Policy | AWS::IAM::Role | AWS::KMS::Alias | AWS::KMS::Key | AWS::Logs::LogGroup | AWS::S3::Bucket | AWS::S3::BucketPolicy | AWS::SNS::Topic | AWS::Serverless::Function | AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
aws_services: Events, IAM, KMS, Logs, S3, SNS, Serverless, StepFunctions
cfn_description: Automated GuardDuty Security Response
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0089", "severity": "LOW", "title": "S3 Bucket Logging"}, {"id": "AWS-0125", "severity": "LOW", "title": "SAM Function must have X-Ray tracing enabled"}, {"id": "AWS-0342", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "IAM Pass Role Filtering"}]
content:
# Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0

---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: "AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31"
Description: Automated GuardDuty Security Response

Parameters:
  GitHubOrg:
    Type: String
    Description: Source Code GitHub Organization
    Default: "aws-samples"
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Description: Source Code GitHub Repository
    Default: "amazon-guardduty-automated-response-sample"

Globals:
  Function:
    CodeUri: src/
    Environment:
      Variables:
        POWERTOOLS_METRICS_NAMESPACE: SecurityOperations
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    Layers:
      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:017000801446:layer:AWSLambdaPowertoolsPythonV2:57"
    MemorySize: 256 # megabytes
    Runtime: python3.12
    Tags:
      GITHUB_ORG: !Ref GitHubOrg
      GITHUB_REPO: !Ref GitHubRepo
    Timeout: 120 # seconds

Resources:
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for security operations resources
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM policies"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow use of the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt QuarantineFunctionRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt QuarantineInstanceRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow use of the key by CloudWatch Logs"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Describe*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: EncryptionKey

  EncryptionAlias:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Alias"
    Properties:
      AliasName: "alias/sec_ops"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Topic"
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Security Operations Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
      Tags:
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: "AWS::S3::Bucket"
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W35
            reason: "Ignoring access logs"
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey
              SSEAlgorithm: "aws:kms"
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionRule
            NoncurrentVersionTransitions:
              - StorageClass: INTELLIGENT_TIERING
                TransitionInDays: 0
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 0
                StorageClass: INTELLIGENT_TIERING
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::S3::BucketPolicy"
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  QuarantineFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${QuarantineFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: 3
      Tags:
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: QuarantineFunctionLogGroup

  QuarantineInstanceRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: !Sub "ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
          Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Description: !Sub "DO NOT DELETE - Used by EC2. Created by CloudFormation ${AWS::StackId}"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: QuarantineInstanceRole
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  QuarantineInstancePolicy:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Policy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: QuarantineInstancePolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref QuarantineInstanceRole

  QuarantineInstanceRoleProfile:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile"
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - Ref: QuarantineInstanceRole

  QuarantineFunctionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: !Sub "lambda.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
          Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Description: !Sub "DO NOT DELETE - Used by Lambda. Created by CloudFormation ${AWS::StackId}"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: QuarantineFunctionRole
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  QuarantineFunctionPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Policy"
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W12
            reason: "Needs permission to modify any resource"
          - id: W76
            reason: "Needs broad permissions for quarantining"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: QuarantineFunctionPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "iam:PassRole"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt QuarantineInstanceRole.Arn
              - !GetAtt SSMPublishRole.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                "lambda:SourceFunctionArn": !GetAtt QuarantineFunction.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "logs:CreateLogStream"
              - "logs:PutLogEvents"
            Resource: !GetAtt QuarantineFunctionLogGroup.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sns:Publish"
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances"
              - "ec2:DescribeInstances"
              - "ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot"
              - "ec2:DescribeIamInstanceProfileAssociations"
              - "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces"
              - "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups"
              - "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup"
              - "ec2:CreateSnapshot"
              - "ec2:CreateTags"
              - "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute"
              - "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute"
              - "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeInstanceHealth"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth"
              - "ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation"
              - "ssm:ListCommands"
              - "ssm:GetCommandInvocation"
              - "ssm:SendCommand"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "autoscaling:DetachInstances"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:autoscaling:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:autoScalingGroup:*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile"
              - "ec2:DisassociateIamInstanceProfile"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref QuarantineFunctionRole

  QuarantineFunction:
    Type: "AWS::Serverless::Function"
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: W58
            reason: "Function has permission to write to CloudWatch Logs"
          - id: W89
            reason: "Function does not need VPC resources"
    Properties:
      Description: DO NOT DELETE - Security Operations - Quarantine Function
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ARTIFACT_BUCKET: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref NotificationTopic
          EC2_INSTANCE_PROFILE_ARN: !GetAtt QuarantineInstanceRoleProfile.Arn
          AWS_ACCOUNT_ID: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
          SSM_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMPublishRole.Arn
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        def handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: 10
      Role: !GetAtt QuarantineFunctionRole.Arn

  SSMPublishRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "ssm.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Description: !Sub "DO NOT DELETE - Used by SSM. Created by CloudFormation ${AWS::StackId}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "sns:Publish"
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: SSMPublishRole
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "events.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Description: !Sub "DO NOT DELETE - Used by EventBridge. Created by CloudFormation ${AWS::StackId}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: "states:StartExecution"
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: EventBridgeRole
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  GuardDutyRemediationRule:
    Type: "AWS::Events::Rule"
    Properties:
      Description: GuardDuty Remediation Rule
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.guardduty
        detail-type:
          - GuardDuty Finding
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          Id: stepfunction-remediation
          InputPath: "$.detail"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "states.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:SourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Description: !Sub "DO NOT DELETE - Used by Step Functions. Created by CloudFormation ${AWS::StackId}"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-name"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:stack-id"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackId"
        - Key: "aws-cloudformation:logical-id"
          Value: StateMachineRole
        - Key: GITHUB_ORG
          Value: !Ref GitHubOrg
        - Key: GITHUB_REPO
          Value: !Ref GitHubRepo

  StateMachinePolicy:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Policy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: StateMachinePolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "iam:PutRolePolicy"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "iam:PutUserPolicy"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:user/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "s3:ResourceAccount": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "lambda:InvokeFunction"
            Resource: !GetAtt QuarantineFunction.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "sns:Publish"
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Roles:
        - !Ref StateMachineRole

  StateMachine:
    Type: "AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine"
    Properties:
      Definition:
        StartAt: FindingType
        States:
          FindingType:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: "$.resource.resourceType"
                StringEquals: AccessKey
                Next: IAMFinding
              - Variable: "$.resource.resourceType"
                StringEquals: Instance
                Next: EC2Finding
              - Variable: "$.resource.resourceType"
                StringEquals: S3Bucket
                Next: S3Finding
            Default: UnsupportedFinding
          IAMFinding:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              PolicyDocument: |-
                \{
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    \{
                      "Effect": "Deny",
                      "Action": "*",
                      "Resource": "*",
                      "Condition": \{
                        "DateLessThan": \{
                          "aws:TokenIssueTime": "{}"
                        \}
                      \}
                    \}
                  ]
                \}
            ResultPath: "$.Policy"
            Next: IAMFindingType
          IAMFindingType:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html#cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity-fields
              - Variable: "$.resource.accessKeyDetails.userType"
                StringEquals: AssumedRole
                Next: IAMPutRolePolicy
              - Variable: "$.resource.accessKeyDetails.userType"
                StringEquals: IAMUser
                Next: IAMPutUserPolicy
            Default: UnsupportedIdentityType
          IAMPutRolePolicy:
            Type: Task
            Parameters:
              "PolicyDocument.$": States.Format($.Policy.PolicyDocument, $.service.eventLastSeen)
              PolicyName: AWSRevokeOlderSessions
              "RoleName.$": "$.resource.accessKeyDetails.userName"
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:iam:putRolePolicy"
            ResultPath: "$.putRolePolicy"
            Next: IAMFindingPublish
          IAMPutUserPolicy:
            Type: Task
            Parameters:
              "PolicyDocument.$": States.Format($.Policy.PolicyDocument, $.service.eventLastSeen)
              PolicyName: AWSRevokeOlderSessions
              "UserName.$": "$.resource.accessKeyDetails.userName"
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:iam:putUserPolicy"
            ResultPath: "$.putUserPolicy"
            Next: IAMFindingPublish
          IAMFindingPublish:
            Type: Task
            Parameters:
              "Message.$": States.Format('Successfully revoked older sessions on {}', $.resource.accessKeyDetails.userName)
              TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:sns:publish"
            End: true
          EC2Finding:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt QuarantineFunction.Arn
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 6
                BackoffRate: 2
            TimeoutSeconds: 120
            End: true
          S3Finding:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: "$.resource.s3BucketDetails[0].publicAccess.effectivePermission"
                StringEquals: PUBLIC
                Next: S3BlockPublicAccess
            Default: BucketNotPublic
          S3BlockPublicAccess:
            Type: Task
            Parameters:
              "Bucket.$": "$.resource.s3BucketDetails[0].name"
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
              ExpectedBucketOwner: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putPublicAccessBlock"
            ResultPath: "$.putPublicAccessBlock"
            Next: S3FindingPublish
          S3FindingPublish:
            Type: Task
            Parameters:
              "Message.$": States.Format('Successfully blocked public access on S3 bucket {}', $.resource.s3BucketDetails[0].name)
              TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Resource: "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:sns:publish"
            End: true
          BucketNotPublic:
            Type: Succeed
          UnsupportedFinding:
            Type: Fail
          UnsupportedIdentityType:
            Type: Fail
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn

Outputs:
  ArtifactBucket:
    Description: Security artifact S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.RegionalDomainName
  NotificationTopic:
    Description: Security notifications SNS topic
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic
  EncryptionKeyAliasArn:
    Description: Encryption key alias ARN
    Value: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${EncryptionAlias}"

resource_types: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm | AWS::Cognito::UserPool | AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient | AWS::DynamoDB::Table | AWS::IAM::Policy | AWS::IAM::Role | AWS::KMS::Alias | AWS::KMS::Key | AWS::Logs::LogGroup | AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy | AWS::OpenSearchServerless::Collection | AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy | AWS::S3::Bucket | AWS::SNS::Topic | AWS::Serverless::Function | AWS::Serverless::HttpApi | AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
aws_services: CloudWatch, Cognito, DynamoDB, IAM, KMS, Logs, OpenSearchServerless, S3, SNS, Serverless
cfn_description:
AI-CPaaS campaign orchestrator: parse a marketer's natural-language instruction,
segment customers, predict the best channel per customer, suppress fatigued or
unhappy contacts, adapt content per chan
trivy_checks_with_severity: AWS-0089:LOW | AWS-0116:MEDIUM | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW | AWS-0125:LOW

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: |
  AI-CPaaS campaign orchestrator: parse a marketer's natural-language instruction,
  segment customers, predict the best channel per customer, suppress fatigued or
  unhappy contacts, adapt content per channel, and dispatch via AWS End User
  Messaging and SES. Coordinated end-to-end by AWS Step Functions. Companion to
  the AWS blog "Build an AI-powered campaign orchestrator using Amazon Bedrock
  and AWS End User Messaging".

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
    Description: Deployment environment

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-cpaas-demo
    Description: Project name used in resource naming

  WhatsAppPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: |
      AWS End User Messaging Social phone number ID used as the originating WhatsApp sender
      (e.g. phone-number-id-9997bfa8...). Leave blank to skip WhatsApp. Find with:
      aws socialmessaging get-linked-whatsapp-business-account --id <waba-id>.

  PhonePoolId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: SMS phone pool ID for AWS End User Messaging (sms-voice). Leave blank to skip SMS.

  SenderEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: 'noreply@example.com'
    Description: Verified SES sender email address
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'

  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'global.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'
    Description: |
      Bedrock model or inference profile used for content adaptation and parsing.
      Claude 4.x models require an inference profile (global. / apac. / us. prefix).
    AllowedValues:
      - 'global.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'
      - 'global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0'

  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: |
      Provision an OpenSearch Serverless Vector search NextGen collection and
      embed customer profiles for semantic segmentation. NextGen collections
      scale OCUs to zero after 10 minutes of inactivity, so idle cost is near
      $0; expect a 30-60s cold start on the first query of the day.

  EmbeddingModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0'
    Description: Bedrock embedding model used when EnableSemanticSearch is true.

  SeederPrincipalArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: |
      Optional IAM principal ARN (typically the user/role running
      scripts/seed_demo_data.py) that needs write access to the vector
      collection. Required when EnableSemanticSearch is true.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.13
    Timeout: 60
    MemorySize: 1024
    Tracing: Active
    Architectures: [arm64]
    Environment:
      Variables:
        ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
        PROJECT_NAME: !Ref ProjectName
        BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
    Tags:
      Project: !Ref ProjectName
      Environment: !Ref Environment

Resources:

  # ===========================================================================
  # Encryption
  # ===========================================================================

  AppKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${ProjectName} - ${Environment}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - states.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  AppKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  # ===========================================================================
  # State stores
  # ===========================================================================

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-rate-limits-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: limiter_key
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: limiter_key
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        Enabled: true
        AttributeName: ttl
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-delivery-tracking-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: message_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customer_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: message_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: customer-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: customer_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: timestamp
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        Enabled: true
        AttributeName: ttl
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-customer-profiles-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customer_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customer_id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-assets-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AppKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # ===========================================================================
  # OpenSearch Serverless (vector search) -- optional, enabled by EnableSemanticSearch
  # NextGen collection: scales indexing and search OCUs to zero after 10 min idle.
  # ===========================================================================

  VectorCollectionEncryptionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vec-enc-${Environment}'
      Type: encryption
      Policy: !Sub |
        {
          "Rules": [
            {"ResourceType": "collection", "Resource": ["collection/${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}"]}
          ],
          "AWSOwnedKey": true
        }

  VectorCollectionNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vec-net-${Environment}'
      Type: network
      Policy: !Sub |
        [
          {
            "Rules": [
              {"ResourceType": "collection", "Resource": ["collection/${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}"]},
              {"ResourceType": "dashboard", "Resource": ["collection/${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}"]}
            ],
            "AllowFromPublic": true
          }
        ]

  VectorCollection:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::Collection
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    DependsOn:
      - VectorCollectionEncryptionPolicy
      - VectorCollectionNetworkPolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}'
      Type: VECTORSEARCH
      StandbyReplicas: DISABLED
      Description: Customer profile embeddings for semantic segmentation

  # Data-access policy is attached to the stage Lambda roles + the seeder caller.
  # We grant aoss:APIAccessAll via IAM and grant index permissions here.
  VectorCollectionAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vec-acc-${Environment}'
      Type: data
      Policy: !Sub |
        [
          {
            "Rules": [
              {
                "ResourceType": "collection",
                "Resource": ["collection/${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}"],
                "Permission": ["aoss:CreateCollectionItems", "aoss:UpdateCollectionItems", "aoss:DescribeCollectionItems"]
              },
              {
                "ResourceType": "index",
                "Resource": ["index/${ProjectName}-vec-${Environment}/*"],
                "Permission": ["aoss:CreateIndex", "aoss:DescribeIndex", "aoss:ReadDocument", "aoss:WriteDocument", "aoss:UpdateIndex"]
              }
            ],
            "Principal": [
              "${SegmentCustomersFunctionRole.Arn}",
              "${SeederPrincipalArn}"
            ]
          }
        ]

  # Standalone IAM role for SegmentCustomersFunction. Defined as a top-level
  # resource so the OpenSearch data-access policy above can reference its ARN
  # without creating a circular dependency on the SAM-managed auto-role.
  SegmentCustomersFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: lambda.amazonaws.com }
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SegmentStagePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ['dynamodb:GetItem', 'dynamodb:Query', 'dynamodb:Scan', 'dynamodb:BatchGetItem']
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
                Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  # Optional add-on policy: only attached when EnableSemanticSearch=true.
  SegmentCustomersSemanticSearchPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SemanticSearchAccess
      Roles: [!Ref SegmentCustomersFunctionRole]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ['bedrock:InvokeModel']
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${EmbeddingModelId}'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: ['aoss:APIAccessAll']
            Resource: !GetAtt VectorCollection.Arn

  # ===========================================================================
  # Stage Lambdas
  # ===========================================================================

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-parse-instruction-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Parse marketer instruction into structured campaign fields via Bedrock
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['bedrock:InvokeModel']
              Resource:
                # Inference profile in the calling region...
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${BedrockModelId}'
                # ...plus the underlying foundation model in every region the
                # profile may route to (global. profiles span multiple regions).
                - 'arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/anthropic.*'

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-segment-customers-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Match parsed criteria to customer profiles in DynamoDB, optionally combined with OpenSearch vector search
      Role: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID: !Ref EmbeddingModelId
          VECTOR_COLLECTION_ENDPOINT: !If [SemanticSearchEnabled, !GetAtt VectorCollection.CollectionEndpoint, '']
          VECTOR_INDEX_NAME: !If [SemanticSearchEnabled, !Sub '${ProjectName}-customers-${Environment}', '']

  PredictChannelsFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-predict-channels-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Predict the best channel per customer using SageMaker + heuristic fallback
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint']
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/${ProjectName}-channel-prediction-${Environment}'

  CheckSafetyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-check-safety-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Suppress messages to fatigued or negative-sentiment customers
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RateLimitsTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  AdaptContentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-adapt-content-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Generate channel-specific message variants via Bedrock
      Timeout: 120
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['bedrock:InvokeModel']
              Resource:
                # Inference profile in the calling region...
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/${BedrockModelId}'
                # ...plus the underlying foundation model in every region the
                # profile may route to (global. profiles span multiple regions).
                - 'arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/anthropic.*'

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-deliver-messages-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Dispatch messages via AWS End User Messaging and SES
      Timeout: 300
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PHONE_POOL_ID: !Ref PhonePoolId
          WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: !Ref WhatsAppPhoneNumberId
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref RateLimitsTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - 'sms-voice:SendTextMessage'
                - 'social-messaging:SendWhatsAppMessage'
              Resource: '*'
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - 'ses:SendEmail'
                - 'ses:SendRawEmail'
              Resource: '*'

  RecordResultsFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-record-results-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Persist campaign summary to delivery tracking table
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-campaign-launcher-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: API Gateway entry point that starts the campaign state machine
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - StepFunctionsExecutionPolicy:
            StateMachineName: !GetAtt CampaignStateMachine.Name
      Events:
        LaunchCampaign:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref CampaignApi
            Path: /campaigns
            Method: POST

  CampaignStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-campaign-status-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Return the campaign summary for a given campaign_id
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
      Events:
        GetCampaign:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref CampaignApi
            Path: /campaigns/{campaign_id}
            Method: GET

  # ===========================================================================
  # Step Functions state machine
  # ===========================================================================

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/states/${ProjectName}-orchestrator-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn

  CampaignStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orchestrator-${Environment}'
      Type: STANDARD
      # DefinitionUri pointed at an ASL file never committed to this greenfield
      # copy (same root cause already fixed for this file's 10 Lambda CodeUri
      # references, just missed on this resource) -- inlined as a Definition
      # instead, using the same DefinitionSubstitutions variables so the
      # Task -> Lambda wiring this scenario exercises is unchanged.
      Definition:
        Comment: Campaign orchestration pipeline
        StartAt: ParseInstruction
        States:
          ParseInstruction:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${ParseArn}"
            Next: SegmentCustomers
          SegmentCustomers:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${SegmentArn}"
            Next: PredictChannels
          PredictChannels:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${PredictArn}"
            Next: CheckSafety
          CheckSafety:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${SafetyArn}"
            Next: AdaptContent
          AdaptContent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${AdaptArn}"
            Next: DeliverMessages
          DeliverMessages:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${DeliverArn}"
            Next: RecordResults
          RecordResults:
            Type: Task
            Resource: "${RecordArn}"
            End: true
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ParseArn: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
        SegmentArn: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
        PredictArn: !GetAtt PredictChannelsFunction.Arn
        SafetyArn: !GetAtt CheckSafetyFunction.Arn
        AdaptArn: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
        DeliverArn: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
        RecordArn: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
      Logging:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      Tracing:
        Enabled: true
      Policies:
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref ParseInstructionFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref SegmentCustomersFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref PredictChannelsFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref CheckSafetyFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref AdaptContentFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref DeliverMessagesFunction
        - LambdaInvokePolicy:
            FunctionName: !Ref RecordResultsFunction
        - CloudWatchLogsFullAccess

  # ===========================================================================
  # Amazon Cognito user pool used to authenticate the campaign launcher API.
  # Callers must present a JWT access token from this pool in the
  # Authorization header when hitting the HTTP API.
  # ===========================================================================

  CampaignUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-users-${Environment}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  CampaignUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-launcher-${Environment}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CampaignUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60      # minutes
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30     # days
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # ===========================================================================
  # API Gateway entry point (protected by the Cognito user pool above)
  # ===========================================================================

  CampaignApi:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::HttpApi
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      Description: !Sub 'Campaign launcher API for ${ProjectName}-${Environment}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: ['*']
        AllowMethods: [POST, GET, OPTIONS]
        AllowHeaders: [content-type, authorization]
        MaxAge: 600
      Auth:
        DefaultAuthorizer: CampaignCognitoAuthorizer
        Authorizers:
          CampaignCognitoAuthorizer:
            IdentitySource: $request.header.Authorization
            JwtConfiguration:
              audience:
                - !Ref CampaignUserPoolClient
              issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CampaignUserPool}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Delivery status callback wiring (EventBridge -> DynamoDB)
  # ===========================================================================

  DeliveryStatusProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-delivery-processor-${Environment}'
      InlineCode: |
        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Description: Update delivery tracking when AWS End User Messaging emits status events
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
        - Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey']
              Resource: !GetAtt AppKmsKey.Arn
      Events:
        SmsDeliveryStatus:
          Type: EventBridgeRule
          Properties:
            Pattern:
              source: ['aws.end-user-messaging']
              detail-type: ['SMS Delivery Status']
        WhatsAppDeliveryStatus:
          Type: EventBridgeRule
          Properties:
            Pattern:
              source: ['aws.end-user-messaging']
              detail-type: ['WhatsApp Delivery Status']

  # ===========================================================================
  # Alarms
  # ===========================================================================

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alarms-${Environment}'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ProjectName} alarms (${Environment})'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AppKmsKey

  StateMachineFailedExecutionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orchestrator-failures-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Campaign orchestrator executions are failing
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Namespace: AWS/States
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 3
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine

Outputs:
  CampaignApiEndpoint:
    Description: HTTP API endpoint for launching campaigns (POST /campaigns)
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CampaignApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Environment}/campaigns'

  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool that authenticates campaign launcher requests
    Value: !Ref CampaignUserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client used to obtain access tokens for the API
    Value: !Ref CampaignUserPoolClient

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: Step Functions state machine ARN
    Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine

  CustomerProfilesTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table for customer profiles
    Value: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable

  DeliveryTrackingTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table for delivery tracking
    Value: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable

  CampaignAssetsBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for campaign assets
    Value: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: SNS topic for orchestrator alarms (subscribe your email)
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  VectorCollectionEndpoint:
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Description: OpenSearch Serverless Vector search collection endpoint (set on seeder)
    Value: !GetAtt VectorCollection.CollectionEndpoint

  VectorIndexName:
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Description: Index name expected by the segment Lambda and seeder
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-customers-${Environment}'
