cfn_description: CI/CD optimized AWS CloudFormation Sample Template for AWS Service Catalog Product creation. ### Before deployment please make sure that all parameters are reviewed and updated according the specific
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: 'CI/CD optimized AWS CloudFormation Sample Template for AWS Service Catalog Product creation. ### Before deployment please make sure that all parameters are reviewed and updated according the specific use case. ### **WARNING** This template creates AWS Service Catalog Product, please make sure you review billing costs for AWS Service Catalog.'

Metadata:
  cfn-lint:
    config:
      regions:
        - us-east-1
        - us-west-2

  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Service Catalog Product Tags
        Parameters:
          - AppName
          - Env
          - Dept
          - User
          - Owner
      - Label:
          default: Service Catalog Portfolio Stack Name
        Parameters:
          - ServiceCatalogPortfolioStackName
      - Label:
          default: Service Catalog Product Details
        Parameters:
          - SCProductName
          - SCProductDescription
          - SCProductOwner
          - SCProductSupport
          - SCProductDistributor
          - SCSupportEmail
          - SCSupportUrl
      - Label:
          default: Service Catalog Product Details
        Parameters:
          - ProvisioningArtifactTemplateUrl
          - ProvisioningArtifactNameParameter
          - ProvisioningArtifactDescriptionParameter

Parameters:

  # Enviornment type
  Env:
    Description: Please specify the target Environment. Used for tagging and resource names. Mandatory LOWER CASE.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - test
      - dev
      - prod
    Default: dev

  # Application Name
  AppName:
    Description: Please specify the Application Name. Used for tagging and resource names. Mandatory LOWER CASE.
    Type: String
    Default: app

  # Department
  Dept:
    Description: Please specify the Department. Used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: "1234"

  # User
  User:
    Description: Please specify the User. Used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: User

  # Owner
  Owner:
    Description: Please specify the Owner. Used for tagging
    Type: String
    Default: Owner

  # Service Catalog Portfolio Stack Name
  ServiceCatalogPortfolioStackName:
    Description: Please specify the Service Catalog Portfolio Stack Name.
    Type: String
    Default: ""

  # ServiceCatalog Product Name
  SCProductName:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Name.
    Type: String
    Default: ProductName

  # ServiceCatalog Product Name Description
  SCProductDescription:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Name Description.
    Type: String
    Default: ProductDescription

  # ServiceCatalog Product Name Owner
  SCProductOwner:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Owner.
    Type: String
    Default: ProductOwner

  # ServiceCatalog Product Support
  SCProductSupport:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Support.
    Type: String
    Default: IT Support can be reached @support

  # ServiceCatalog Product Distributor
  SCProductDistributor:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Distributor.
    Type: String
    Default: App Vendor

  # ServiceCatalog Product Support Email
  SCSupportEmail:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Support Email.
    Type: String
    Default: support@example.com

  # ServiceCatalog Product Support URL
  SCSupportUrl:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Support URL.
    Type: String
    Default: https://www.support.example.com

  # ServiceCatalog Product S3 Bucket
  ProvisioningArtifactTemplateUrl:
    Description: Please specify the S3 URL of the template
    Type: String
    Default: https://awsdocs.s3.amazonaws.com/servicecatalog/development-environment.template

  # ServiceCatalog Product Artifact Name
  ProvisioningArtifactNameParameter:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Artifact Name.
    Type: String
    Default: ProductExample

  # ServiceCatalog Product Artifact Description
  ProvisioningArtifactDescriptionParameter:
    Description: Please specify ServiceCatalog Product Artifact Description.
    Type: String
    Default: ProductExample

Resources:
  ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref SCProductName
      Description: !Ref SCProductDescription
      Owner: !Ref SCProductOwner
      SupportDescription: !Ref SCProductSupport
      Distributor: !Ref SCProductDistributor
      SupportEmail: !Ref SCSupportEmail
      SupportUrl: !Sub ${SCSupportUrl}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}
        - Key: App
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}
        - Key: Dept
          Value: !Sub ${Dept}
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Sub ${Env}
        - Key: User
          Value: !Sub ${User}
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Sub ${Owner}
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub ${ProvisioningArtifactNameParameter}
          Description: !Sub ${ProvisioningArtifactDescriptionParameter}
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${ProvisioningArtifactTemplateUrl}

  ServiceCatalogPortfolioProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    DependsOn: ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: ${ServiceCatalogPortfolioStackName}-ServiceCatalogPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct

  ServiceCatalogCustomTagOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOptionAssociation
    Properties:
      TagOptionId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: ${ServiceCatalogPortfolioStackName}-ServiceCatalogProductTagOptions
      ResourceId: !Ref ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct

Outputs:
  ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProductName:
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct.ProductName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProductName

  ServiceCatalogProvisioningArtifactIds:
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct.ProvisioningArtifactIds
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProvisioningArtifactIds

  ServiceCatalogProvisioningArtifactNames:
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProduct.ProvisioningArtifactNames
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-ServiceCatalogCloudFormationProvisioningArtifactNames

Resources:
  OacTest:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Description: "OAC for testing deletion policy"
        Name: testingabc
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

cfn_description: AWS SSM Document to resize EBS volumes and grow the filesystem on them.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS SSM Document to resize EBS volumes and grow the filesystem on them.
Parameters:
  VolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Description: The Size in GB of the Instance Volume.
    Default: 50
Resources:
 ResizeEBSVolumeDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      DocumentType: Command
      Name: Resize-EBS-Volume
      TargetType: /AWS::EC2::Instance
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Command document to resize EBS volume."
        parameters:
          VolumeSize:
            type: String
            description: "Size in GB to grow the volume"
            default: !Sub "${VolumeSize}"
            allowedPattern: ^(?:1(?:[0-5][0-9]{0,3}|[7-9][0-9]{0,2}|6(?:[0-2]{0,3}|[4-9][0-9]?|3(?:[0-7][0-9]?|8[0-4]?|9)?)?)?|[2-9][0-9]{0,3})$
        mainSteps:
        - action: "aws:runShellScript"
          name: "resizeVolume"
          inputs:
            runCommand:
            - "date"
            - "SIZE_PARAM={{VolumeSize}}"
            - "export SIZE=${SIZE_PARAM:-20}"
            - "export INSTANCEID=$(curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)"
            - "echo \"INSTANCEID: $INSTANCEID\""
            - "export AWS_REGION=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone | sed 's/\\(.*\\)[a-z]/\\1/')"
            - "echo \"AWS_REGION: $AWS_REGION\""
            - "export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=$AWS_REGION"
            - "export VOLUMEID=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-id $INSTANCEID --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].BlockDeviceMappings[0].Ebs.VolumeId' --output text)"
            - "echo \"VOLUMEID: $VOLUMEID\""
            - "aws ec2 modify-volume --volume-id $VOLUMEID --size $SIZE"
            - "while [ \"$(aws ec2 describe-volumes-modifications --volume-id $VOLUMEID --filters Name=modification-state,Values='optimizing','completed' --query 'length(VolumesModifications)' --output text)\" != \"1\" ]; do"
            - "  sleep 1"
            - "done"
        - action: "aws:runShellScript"
          name: "extendFileSystem"
          inputs:
            runCommand:
            - "if [[ -e \"/dev/xvda\" && $(readlink -f /dev/xvda) = \"/dev/xvda\" ]]; then"
            - "  growpart /dev/xvda 1"
            - "  STR=$(cat /etc/os-release)"
            - "  SUB='VERSION_ID=\"2\"'"
            - "  if [[ \"$STR\" == *\"$SUB\"* ]]; then"
            - "    xfs_growfs -d /"
            - "  else"
            - "    resize2fs /dev/xvda1"
            - "  fi"
            - "else"
            - "  growpart /dev/nvme0n1 1"
            - "  STR=$(cat /etc/os-release)"
            - "  SUB='VERSION_ID=\"2\"'"
            - "  if [[ \"$STR\" == *\"$SUB\"* ]]; then"
            - "    xfs_growfs -d /"
            - "  else"
            - "    resize2fs /dev/nvme0n1p1"
            - "  fi"
            - "fi"

cfn_description: IAM OIDC roles for GitHub Actions CI pipelines. Creates roles that GitHub Actions can assume via OIDC federation (no long-lived credentials stored in secrets).
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  IAM OIDC roles for GitHub Actions CI pipelines.
  Creates roles that GitHub Actions can assume via OIDC federation
  (no long-lived credentials stored in secrets).

Parameters:
  GitHubOrg:
    Type: String
    Default: Yoshiki0705
    Description: GitHub organization or username

  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: FSx-for-ONTAP-S3AccessPoints-Serverless-Patterns
    Description: GitHub repository name

Resources:
  # --- GitHub OIDC Identity Provider ---
  # Only create if not already exists in the account.
  # If you already have a GitHub OIDC provider, comment this out.
  GitHubOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      Url: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      ClientIdList:
        - sts.amazonaws.com
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1
        - 1c58a3a8518e8759bf075b76b750d4f2df264fcd
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: GitHub Actions OIDC federation

  # --- IAM Policy Validation Role ---
  # Minimal permissions: only accessanalyzer:ValidatePolicy
  # Used by: .github/workflows/iam-policy-validation.yml
  IamValidationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-iam-validation"
      Description: "Allows GitHub Actions to call IAM Access Analyzer ValidatePolicy API for automated IAM policy security checks in CI."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": sts.amazonaws.com
              StringLike:
                "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub": !Sub "repo:${GitHubOrg}/${RepositoryName}:*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccessAnalyzerValidatePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - access-analyzer:ValidatePolicy
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CI IAM policy validation

  # --- Amplify Deploy Role (for future PR preview environments) ---
  # Broader permissions for sandbox deployment.
  # Used by: .github/workflows/pr-preview.yml (when implemented)
  AmplifyDeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-amplify-deploy"
      Description: "Allows GitHub Actions to deploy Amplify Gen2 sandboxes for PR preview environments. Broader permissions - only used for internal PRs (not forks)."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": sts.amazonaws.com
              StringLike:
                "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub": !Sub "repo:${GitHubOrg}/${RepositoryName}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess  # Required for CDK bootstrap + full stack deploy
      # Note: In production, scope down to specific CloudFormation/Cognito/AppSync/Lambda permissions
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref RepositoryName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CI Amplify sandbox deploy

Outputs:
  IamValidationRoleArn:
    Description: >
      ARN for the IAM Validation role.
      Set as GitHub Secret: IAM_VALIDATION_ROLE_ARN
    Value: !GetAtt IamValidationRole.Arn

  AmplifyDeployRoleArn:
    Description: >
      ARN for the Amplify Deploy role.
      Set as GitHub Secret: AMPLIFY_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AmplifyDeployRole.Arn

  DeployCommand:
    Description: Deploy this stack
    Value: !Sub >
      aws cloudformation deploy
      --template-file infrastructure/ci-iam-roles.yaml
      --stack-name ${AWS::StackName}
      --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
      --parameter-overrides GitHubOrg=${GitHubOrg} RepositoryName=${RepositoryName}
      --region us-east-1

cfn_description:
IAM Stack - FSx for ONTAP Hands-on Lab Environment
Provisions IAM roles, policies, and instance profiles for: - EC2 instances (SSM + AD join + S3 AP access + FSx read) - Lambda execution roles (Custom
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  IAM Stack - FSx for ONTAP Hands-on Lab Environment

  Provisions IAM roles, policies, and instance profiles for:
  - EC2 instances (SSM + AD join + S3 AP access + FSx read)
  - Lambda execution roles (Custom Resources)

# =====================================================================
# Parameters
# =====================================================================
Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsx-handson
    Description: Prefix for IAM resource names

# =====================================================================
# Resources
# =====================================================================
Resources:

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 Instance Role (SSM + AD Join + S3 AP + FSx Read)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  Ec2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackPrefix}-ec2-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPointOperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ApDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${StackPrefix}-*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${StackPrefix}-*/object/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/my-s3-access-point*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/my-s3-access-point*/object/*"
              - Sid: S3ApManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateAccessPoint
                  - s3:DeleteAccessPoint
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                  - s3:ListAccessPoints
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${StackPrefix}-*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/my-s3-access-point*"
        - PolicyName: FsxReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fsx:DescribeFileSystems
                  - fsx:DescribeStorageVirtualMachines
                  - fsx:DescribeVolumes
                  - fsx:DescribeSnapshots
                  - fsx:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: FsxVolumeOperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: FlexCloneOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fsx:CreateVolume
                  - fsx:DeleteVolume
                  - fsx:UpdateVolume
                  - fsx:CreateSnapshot
                  - fsx:DeleteSnapshot
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:fsx:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:fsx:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:snapshot/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${StackPrefix}-ec2-role"

  Ec2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${StackPrefix}-ec2-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref Ec2InstanceRole

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Execution Role (S3 Access Point Custom Resource)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  S3ApLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackPrefix}-s3ap-lambda-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FsxS3ApManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fsx:CreateDataRepositoryAssociation
                  - fsx:DeleteDataRepositoryAssociation
                  - fsx:DescribeDataRepositoryAssociations
                  - fsx:DescribeVolumes
                  - fsx:DescribeStorageVirtualMachines
                  - fsx:DescribeFileSystems
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateAccessPoint
                  - s3:DeleteAccessPoint
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                  - s3:PutAccessPointPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteAccessPointPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*"
        - PolicyName: SecretsManagerRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${StackPrefix}-*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${StackPrefix}-s3ap-lambda-role"

# =====================================================================
# Outputs
# =====================================================================
Outputs:
  Ec2InstanceRoleArn:
    Description: EC2 Instance Role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Ec2InstanceRoleArn"

  Ec2InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: EC2 Instance Profile ARN
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2InstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Ec2InstanceProfileArn"

  Ec2InstanceProfileName:
    Description: EC2 Instance Profile Name
    Value: !Ref Ec2InstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Ec2InstanceProfileName"

  S3ApLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: S3 Access Point Lambda Execution Role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt S3ApLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-S3ApLambdaRoleArn"

cfn_description: FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Multi-Account OAM Link (Phase 12). ワークロードアカウントから監視アカウントへの CloudWatch OAM リンク。
content:
# =============================================================================
# Multi-Account OAM Link — CloudWatch Observability Access Manager
# =============================================================================
#
# ワークロードアカウントから監視アカウントへの CloudWatch OAM リンク。
# メトリクス、ログ、X-Ray トレースのクロスアカウント共有を実現。
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/oam-link.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-oam-link \
#     --parameter-overrides \
#       MonitoringAccountSinkArn=arn:aws:oam:ap-northeast-1:MONITORING_ACCOUNT:sink/SINK_ID
#
# オプトイン制御:
#   MonitoringAccountSinkArn が空の場合、OAM Link リソースは作成されない。
#
# NOTE: 既存の workload-account-oam-link.yaml (Phase 11) との違い:
#   - Phase 12 版は EnableOAMLink Condition による明示的オプトイン制御を追加
#   - ResourceTypes をパラメータ化（カンマ区切りリスト）
#   - Phase 12 タグ付け
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Multi-Account OAM Link (Phase 12).
  ワークロードアカウントから監視アカウントへの CloudWatch OAM リンク。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  MonitoringAccountSinkArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      監視アカウントの OAM Sink ARN。
      空の場合、OAM Link リソースは作成されない。

  ResourceTypes:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "AWS::CloudWatch::Metric,AWS::Logs::LogGroup,AWS::XRay::Trace"
    Description: OAM Link で共有するリソースタイプ

  LabelTemplate:
    Type: String
    Default: "$AccountName"

Conditions:

Resources:

cfn_description: VPC Endpoint Security Group Manager — Custom Resource Lambda. Manages ingress rules on a shared VPC Endpoint SG during UC stack lifecycle. Deploy once per account/region, then reference from UC stacks
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpo_i6jik7.yaml:45-143", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  VPC Endpoint Security Group Manager — Custom Resource Lambda.
  Manages ingress rules on a shared VPC Endpoint SG during UC stack lifecycle.
  Deploy once per account/region, then reference from UC stacks.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: Prefix for resource naming

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Execution Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSgManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-vpce-sg-manager-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcEndpointSgManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Function
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSgManagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-vpce-sg-manager"
      Description: >-
        CloudFormation Custom Resource — manages VPC Endpoint SG ingress rules
        for UC demo stacks automatically on Create/Update/Delete.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt VpcEndpointSgManagerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          """CloudFormation Custom Resource for VPC Endpoint SG management."""
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")

          def authorize_ingress(vpce_sg, lambda_sg):
              try:
                  ec2.authorize_security_group_ingress(
                      GroupId=vpce_sg,
                      IpPermissions=[{
                          "IpProtocol": "tcp", "FromPort": 443, "ToPort": 443,
                          "UserIdGroupPairs": [{"GroupId": lambda_sg,
                              "Description": "Allow HTTPS from Lambda SG (managed by fsxn-s3ap-patterns)"}]
                      }])
                  logger.info(f"Authorized: {vpce_sg} <- {lambda_sg}")
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response["Error"]["Code"] == "InvalidPermission.Duplicate":
                      logger.info(f"Rule already exists (idempotent): {vpce_sg} <- {lambda_sg}")
                  else:
                      raise

          def revoke_ingress(vpce_sg, lambda_sg):
              try:
                  ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                      GroupId=vpce_sg,
                      IpPermissions=[{
                          "IpProtocol": "tcp", "FromPort": 443, "ToPort": 443,
                          "UserIdGroupPairs": [{"GroupId": lambda_sg}]
                      }])
                  logger.info(f"Revoked: {vpce_sg} <- {lambda_sg}")
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response["Error"]["Code"] == "InvalidPermission.NotFound":
                      logger.info(f"Rule not found (already removed): {vpce_sg} <- {lambda_sg}")
                  else:
                      raise

          def send_response(event, context, status, physical_id, reason=""):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or f"Log: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": {}
              }).encode()
              req = urllib.request.Request(event["ResponseURL"], data=body,
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))}, method="PUT")
              urllib.request.urlopen(req)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(json.dumps(event))
              rt = event["RequestType"]
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              pid = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", f"vpce-sg-rule-{props.get('LambdaSecurityGroupId','x')}")
              try:
                  vpce_sg = props["VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId"]
                  lambda_sg = props["LambdaSecurityGroupId"]
                  if rt == "Create":
                      authorize_ingress(vpce_sg, lambda_sg)
                      pid = f"vpce-sg-rule-{lambda_sg}"
                  elif rt == "Update":
                      old = event.get("OldResourceProperties", {})
                      old_sg = old.get("LambdaSecurityGroupId")
                      if old_sg and old_sg != lambda_sg:
                          revoke_ingress(vpce_sg, old_sg)
                      authorize_ingress(vpce_sg, lambda_sg)
                      pid = f"vpce-sg-rule-{lambda_sg}"
                  elif rt == "Delete":
                      revoke_ingress(vpce_sg, lambda_sg)
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", pid)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error: {e}")
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", pid, str(e))
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: fsxn-s3ap-patterns
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: vpc-endpoint-sg-automation

Outputs:
  VpcEndpointSgManagerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the VPC Endpoint SG Manager Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt VpcEndpointSgManagerFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-vpce-sg-manager-arn"

  VpcEndpointSgManagerFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the VPC Endpoint SG Manager Lambda function
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSgManagerFunction

cfn_description: AgentCore Gateway Service Role for Web Search Tool us-east-1 にデプロイし、Web Search コネクタ用の権限を付与する。 FSx ONTAP S3 AP パターンのハイブリッド RAG で利用。
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AgentCore Gateway Service Role for Web Search Tool
  us-east-1 にデプロイし、Web Search コネクタ用の権限を付与する。
  FSx ONTAP S3 AP パターンのハイブリッド RAG で利用。

Parameters:
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-hybrid-rag-gateway
    Description: AgentCore Gateway 名（タグ用）

Resources:
  AgentCoreGatewayServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${GatewayName}-service-role'
      Description: AgentCore Gateway service role for Web Search connector invocation
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSearchConnectorAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowWebSearchConnector
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:InvokeGateway
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: UseCase
          Value: fsxn-hybrid-rag
        - Key: Component
          Value: agentcore-gateway

  # クロスリージョン呼び出し用: ap-northeast-1 の Lambda が us-east-1 の Gateway を呼ぶ際の権限
  CrossRegionInvokerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${GatewayName}-cross-region-invoker'
      Description: >
        ap-northeast-1 の Lambda/ECS が us-east-1 の AgentCore Gateway を呼び出すための
        ポリシー。UC29/UC30 の Lambda Role にアタッチする。
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGatewayInvoke
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock-agentcore:InvokeGateway
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:us-east-1:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'

Outputs:
  ServiceRoleArn:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway Service Role ARN（Gateway 作成時に指定）
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ServiceRoleArn'

  CrossRegionInvokerPolicyArn:
    Description: クロスリージョン呼び出し用ポリシー ARN（UC29/UC30 Lambda Role にアタッチ）
    Value: !Ref CrossRegionInvokerPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InvokerPolicyArn'

cfn_description: FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Idempotency Store. HYBRID モードでの重複排除用 DynamoDB テーブル。
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0025", "severity": "LOW", "title": "DynamoDB tables should use at rest encryption with a Customer Managed Key", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Table encryption does not use a customer-managed KMS key.", "resolution": "Enable server side encryption with a customer managed key", "resource": "", "query": "data.builtin.aws.dynamodb.aws0025.deny"}]
content:
# =============================================================================
# Idempotency Store — HYBRID モード重複排除用 DynamoDB テーブル
# =============================================================================
#
# HYBRID モードでは、EventBridge Scheduler (POLLING) と FPolicy EventBridge Rule
# (EVENT_DRIVEN) の両方が同一ファイルに対してワークフローを起動する可能性がある。
# Idempotency Store は処理済みイベントを記録し、重複実行を防止する。
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/idempotency-store.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-idempotency-store \
#     --parameter-overrides ProjectPrefix=fsxn-s3ap
#
# Step Functions の最初のステップで Idempotency Check を実行:
#   1. file_path + operation_type + timestamp_bucket をキーとして検索
#   2. 既存レコードがあれば SKIP (重複)
#   3. なければ INSERT して処理続行
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Idempotency Store.
  HYBRID モードでの重複排除用 DynamoDB テーブル。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  TtlDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: レコードの TTL（日数）。期限切れレコードは自動削除される。

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Point-in-Time Recovery を有効化する

Conditions:
  EnablePITR:
    !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, "true"]

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [EnablePITR, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: Component
          Value: idempotency-store
        - Key: Phase
          Value: "11"
        - Key: UseCase
          Value: hybrid-mode-deduplication

  # IAM Policy for Lambda/Step Functions to access the table
  IdempotencyAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-access"
      Description: Allow Lambda functions to read/write the Idempotency Store
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DynamoDBAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Idempotency Store テーブル名
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableName"

  TableArn:
    Description: Idempotency Store テーブル ARN
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableArn"

  AccessPolicyArn:
    Description: Idempotency Store アクセスポリシー ARN
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AccessPolicyArn"

  KeySchema:
    Description: |
      キースキーマ:
        pk = "{uc_name}#{file_path}" (パーティションキー)
        sk = "{operation_type}#{timestamp_bucket}" (ソートキー)
      timestamp_bucket は 5 分単位に丸めた値（同一ファイルの近接イベントを重複とみなす）
    Value: "pk=uc#path, sk=op#ts_bucket"

cfn_description: FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — SLO Dashboard. イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO 可視化ダッシュボードとアラーム。
content:
# =============================================================================
# SLO Dashboard — CloudWatch Dashboard + Alarms
# =============================================================================
#
# イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO（Service Level Objectives）を定義し、
# CloudWatch ダッシュボードと SLO アラームで可視化する。
#
# SLO ターゲット:
#   1. EventIngestionLatency — P99 < 5 seconds
#   2. ProcessingSuccessRate — > 99.5%
#   3. ReconnectTime — < 30 seconds
#   4. ReplayCompletionTime — < 5 minutes
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/slo-dashboard.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-slo-dashboard \
#     --parameter-overrides EnableSLODashboard=true
#
# オプトイン制御:
#   EnableSLODashboard=false (デフォルト) でリソースは作成されない。
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — SLO Dashboard.
  イベント駆動パイプラインの SLO 可視化ダッシュボードとアラーム。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  EnableSLODashboard:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: SLO Dashboard 機能を有効化する

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns"
    Description: CloudWatch メトリクス名前空間

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary"
    Description: Synthetic Monitoring Canary メトリクス名前空間

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: SLO 違反通知用 SNS Topic ARN

  IngestionLatencyThresholdMs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5000
    Description: EventIngestionLatency SLO 閾値（ミリ秒、P99）

  SuccessRateThresholdPct:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: ProcessingSuccessRate SLO 閾値（%）

  ReconnectTimeThresholdSec:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: ReconnectTime SLO 閾値（秒）

  ReplayCompletionThresholdSec:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: ReplayCompletionTime SLO 閾値（秒）

Conditions:
  IsSLODashboardEnabled:
    !Equals [!Ref EnableSLODashboard, "true"]

Resources:
  # --- CloudWatch Alarms ---
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-ingestion-latency"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: EventIngestionLatency P99 > 5s"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency_ms
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref IngestionLatencyThresholdMs
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-success-rate"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: ProcessingSuccessRate < 99.5%"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate_pct
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref SuccessRateThresholdPct
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-reconnect-time"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: FPolicyReconnectTime > 30s"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime_sec
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReconnectTimeThresholdSec
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-replay-completion"
      AlarmDescription: "SLO Violation: ReplayCompletionTime > 5min"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime_sec
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionThresholdSec
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  # --- CloudWatch Dashboard ---
  SLODashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99) — SLO < ${IngestionLatencyThresholdMs}ms",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency_ms", {"stat": "p99"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${IngestionLatencyThresholdMs}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Processing Success Rate — SLO > ${SuccessRateThresholdPct}%",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate_pct", {"stat": "Average"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${SuccessRateThresholdPct}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time — SLO < ${ReconnectTimeThresholdSec}s",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime_sec", {"stat": "Maximum"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${ReconnectTimeThresholdSec}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Replay Completion Time — SLO < ${ReplayCompletionThresholdSec}s",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime_sec", {"stat": "Maximum"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": ${ReplayCompletionThresholdSec}, "label": "SLO Threshold", "color": "#d62728"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 1,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "## Synthetic Monitoring — S3AP & ONTAP Health (Feature 3 Integration)"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 13,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "S3AP Latency (Synthetic Canary)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3AP_ListLatency_ms", {"stat": "Average", "label": "List Latency"}],
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3AP_GetLatency_ms", {"stat": "Average", "label": "Get Latency"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 13,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "ONTAP Health Check (Synthetic Canary)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "ONTAP_HealthCheck", {"stat": "Minimum", "label": "Health (1=OK, 0=Fail)"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 19,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 3,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: SLO Dashboard 名
    Value: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DashboardName"

  IngestionLatencyAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: EventIngestionLatency Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IngestionLatencyAlarmArn"

  SuccessRateAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ProcessingSuccessRate Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SuccessRateAlarmArn"

  ReconnectTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ReconnectTime Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReconnectTimeAlarmArn"

  ReplayCompletionAlarmArn:
    Condition: IsSLODashboardEnabled
    Description: ReplayCompletionTime Alarm ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn
    Export:

content:
# =============================================================================
# Data Lineage Tracking — DynamoDB テーブル + GSI + IAM Policy
# =============================================================================
#
# ファイル処理履歴を追跡する DynamoDB テーブル。
# PK: source_file_key, SK: processing_timestamp で時系列管理。
# GSI: uc_id-timestamp-index で UC 別クエリをサポート。
# TTL: 365 日で自動削除。
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/lineage-table.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-lineage-table \
#     --parameter-overrides EnableDataLineage=true
#
# オプトイン制御:
#   EnableDataLineage=false (デフォルト) でリソースは作成されない。
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Data Lineage Tracking Table.
  ファイル処理履歴追跡用 DynamoDB テーブル（GSI + TTL）。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  EnableDataLineage:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Data Lineage Tracking 機能を有効化する

  # Note: TTL 値（365 日）はアプリケーション層（shared/lineage.py）で
  # レコード書き込み時に current_time + 365*86400 として計算される。
  # DynamoDB の TimeToLiveSpecification は ttl 属性を有効化するのみ。

Conditions:
  IsDataLineageEnabled:
    !Equals [!Ref EnableDataLineage, "true"]

Resources:
  LineageTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-data-lineage"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: source_file_key
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: processing_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: uc_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: source_file_key
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: processing_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: uc_id-timestamp-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: uc_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: processing_timestamp
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Component
          Value: data-lineage
        - Key: Phase
          Value: "12"

  LineageAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-lineage-access"
      Description: Allow UC Lambda functions to read/write the Data Lineage table
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DynamoDBTableAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LineageTable.Arn
          - Sid: DynamoDBGSIAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:Query
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${LineageTable.Arn}/index/uc_id-timestamp-index"

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Description: Data Lineage テーブル名
    Value: !Ref LineageTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableName"

  TableArn:
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Description: Data Lineage テーブル ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LineageTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableArn"

  GSIArn:
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Description: UC ID GSI ARN
    Value: !Sub "${LineageTable.Arn}/index/uc_id-timestamp-index"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GSIArn"

  AccessPolicyArn:
    Condition: IsDataLineageEnabled
    Description: Data Lineage アクセスポリシー ARN
    Value: !Ref LineageAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AccessPolicyArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-

Conditions:

cfn_description: FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Cost Optimization Dashboard. Metrics Math によるサービスカテゴリ別コスト推定ダッシュボード。
content:
# =============================================================================
# Cost Optimization Dashboard — CloudWatch Metrics Math
# =============================================================================
#
# UC ごとのサービスカテゴリ別コスト内訳を CloudWatch ダッシュボードで可視化する。
# Metrics Math を使用してリアルタイムコスト推定を表示。
#
# 使用方法:
#   aws cloudformation deploy \
#     --template-file shared/cfn/cost-dashboard.yaml \
#     --stack-name fsxn-phase13-cost-dashboard \
#     --parameter-overrides \
#       EnableCostDashboard=true \
#       ProjectPrefix=fsxn-s3ap \
#     --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
#
# =============================================================================

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns — Cost Optimization Dashboard.
  Metrics Math によるサービスカテゴリ別コスト推定ダッシュボード。

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: リソース命名プレフィックス

  EnableCostDashboard:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Cost Dashboard 機能を有効化する

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ダッシュボード名（空の場合は ProjectPrefix から生成）

  FPolicyClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ECS クラスター名（Fargate コスト計算用）

  FPolicyServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ECS サービス名（Fargate コスト計算用）

  NatGatewayId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: NAT Gateway ID（コスト計算用、空の場合はウィジェット非表示）

Conditions:
  IsCostDashboardEnabled:
    !Equals [!Ref EnableCostDashboard, "true"]

  HasNatGateway:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayId, ""]]

  HasDashboardName:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref DashboardName, ""]]

Resources:
  CostDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: IsCostDashboardEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !If
        - HasDashboardName
        - !Ref DashboardName
        - !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-cost-optimization"
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# Cost Optimization Dashboard — FSx for ONTAP S3 AP Serverless Patterns\nPer-service cost estimation using CloudWatch Metrics Math. Prices based on ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo)."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Fargate FPolicy Server — Estimated Cost ($/hour)",
                "metrics": [
                  [{"expression": "m1 / 100 * 0.25 * 0.04048", "label": "vCPU Cost", "id": "e1"}],
                  [{"expression": "m2 / 100 * 0.5 * 0.004445", "label": "Memory Cost", "id": "e2"}],
                  [{"expression": "e1 + e2", "label": "Total Fargate $/hr", "id": "e3"}],
                  ["AWS/ECS", "CPUUtilization", "ClusterName", "${FPolicyClusterName}", "ServiceName", "${FPolicyServiceName}", {"id": "m1", "visible": false}],
                  ["AWS/ECS", "MemoryUtilization", "ClusterName", "${FPolicyClusterName}", "ServiceName", "${FPolicyServiceName}", {"id": "m2", "visible": false}]
                ],
                "period": 3600,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Average",
                "view": "timeSeries"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "DynamoDB — Consumed Capacity (RCU/WCU)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/DynamoDB", "ConsumedReadCapacityUnits", "TableName", "${ProjectPrefix}-guardrails-tracking", {"label": "Guardrails RCU"}],
                  ["AWS/DynamoDB", "ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits", "TableName", "${ProjectPrefix}-guardrails-tracking", {"label": "Guardrails WCU"}],
                  ["AWS/DynamoDB", "ConsumedReadCapacityUnits", "TableName", "${ProjectPrefix}-data-lineage", {"label": "Lineage RCU"}],
                  ["AWS/DynamoDB", "ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits", "TableName", "${ProjectPrefix}-data-lineage", {"label": "Lineage WCU"}]
                ],
                "period": 3600,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "view": "timeSeries"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SQS — Messages Sent/Received",
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/SQS", "NumberOfMessagesSent", "QueueName", "${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-events", {"label": "FPolicy Events Sent"}],
                  ["AWS/SQS", "NumberOfMessagesReceived", "QueueName", "${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-events", {"label": "FPolicy Events Received"}],
                  ["AWS/SQS", "ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible", "QueueName", "${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-events", {"label": "Backlog"}]
                ],
                "period": 300,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "view": "timeSeries"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Lambda — Invocations & Duration",
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${ProjectPrefix}-capacity-forecast", {"label": "Capacity Forecast"}],
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${ProjectPrefix}-s3ap-ext-monitor", {"label": "S3AP Monitor"}],
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-snapshot", {"label": "FlexClone Snapshot"}],
                  ["AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${ProjectPrefix}-flexclone-create", {"label": "FlexClone Create"}]
                ],
                "period": 3600,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "view": "timeSeries"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "CloudWatch Synthetics — Canary Runs",
                "metrics": [
                  ["CloudWatchSynthetics", "SuccessPercent", "CanaryName", "${ProjectPrefix}-s3ap-health", {"label": "S3AP Canary Success %"}]
                ],
                "period": 3600,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Average",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    {"value": 100, "label": "Target", "color": "#2ca02c"}
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "CloudWatch Logs — Ingestion (Bytes)",
                "metrics": [
                  ["AWS/Logs", "IncomingBytes", "LogGroupName", "/aws/ecs/${ProjectPrefix}-fpolicy-server", {"label": "FPolicy Server Logs"}],
                  ["AWS/Logs", "IncomingBytes", "LogGroupName", "/aws/lambda/${ProjectPrefix}-capacity-forecast", {"label": "Forecast Lambda Logs"}]
                ],
                "period": 3600,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stat": "Sum",
                "view": "timeSeries"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 3,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "## Cost Reference (ap-northeast-1)\n| Service | Unit | Price |\n|---------|------|-------|\n| Fargate vCPU | per hour | $0.04048 |\n| Fargate Memory | per GB-hour | $0.004445 |\n| NAT Gateway | per hour + per GB | $0.045 + $0.045/GB |\n| Synthetics | per canary run | $0.0012 |\n| DynamoDB RCU | per unit | $0.000000285 |\n| DynamoDB WCU | per unit | $0.000001425 |\n| SQS | per million requests | $0.40 |\n| CloudWatch Logs | per GB ingested | $0.76 |\n| Persistent Store | per GB/month | $0.125 |"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardUrl:
    Condition: IsCostDashboardEnabled
    Description: Cost Dashboard URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards/dashboard/${ProjectPrefix}-cost-optimization"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DashboardUrl"

cfn_description: Bedrock Guardrail for File Portal — PII detection/masking + content filtering. Deploy this stack, then copy the GuardrailId and GuardrailVersion outputs into portal-config.ts (bedrockGuardrailId / bed
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Bedrock Guardrail for File Portal — PII detection/masking + content filtering.
  Deploy this stack, then copy the GuardrailId and GuardrailVersion outputs
  into portal-config.ts (bedrockGuardrailId / bedrockGuardrailVersion).

Parameters:
  GuardrailName:
    Type: String
    Default: file-portal-guardrail
    Description: Name for the Bedrock Guardrail

  BlockedInputMessage:
    Type: String
    Default: "This question cannot be processed due to safety policy."
    Description: Message shown when input is blocked

  BlockedOutputMessage:
    Type: String
    Default: "This response was filtered by the safety guardrail."
    Description: Message shown when output is blocked

Resources:
  PortalGuardrail:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GuardrailName
      Description: "PII detection/masking and content filtering for FSx for ONTAP File Portal AI features"
      BlockedInputMessaging: !Ref BlockedInputMessage
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: !Ref BlockedOutputMessage

      # --- PII Detection & Masking ---
      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          # Anonymize (mask) — replace with placeholder
          - Type: EMAIL
            Action: ANONYMIZE
          - Type: PHONE
            Action: ANONYMIZE
          - Type: NAME
            Action: ANONYMIZE
          - Type: IP_ADDRESS
            Action: ANONYMIZE
          # Block entirely — reject the response
          - Type: US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_CVV
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_EXPIRY
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: AWS_ACCESS_KEY
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: AWS_SECRET_KEY
            Action: BLOCK

      # --- Content Filtering ---
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: SEXUAL
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: HIGH
          - Type: VIOLENCE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: HIGH
          - Type: HATE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: HIGH
          - Type: INSULTS
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: MEDIUM
          - Type: MISCONDUCT
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: HIGH

      # --- Word/Phrase Filtering ---
      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: PROFANITY

  # Create a version (required for use with Converse API)
  PortalGuardrailVersion:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion
    Properties:
      GuardrailIdentifier: !GetAtt PortalGuardrail.GuardrailId
      Description: "Initial version for File Portal"

Outputs:
  GuardrailId:
    Description: "Guardrail ID — copy to portal-config.ts bedrockGuardrailId"
    Value: !GetAtt PortalGuardrail.GuardrailId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GuardrailId"

  GuardrailVersion:
    Description: "Guardrail version number — copy to portal-config.ts bedrockGuardrailVersion"
    Value: !GetAtt PortalGuardrailVersion.Version
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GuardrailVersion"

  GuardrailArn:
    Description: "Guardrail ARN for IAM policy scoping"
    Value: !GetAtt PortalGuardrail.GuardrailArn

  DeployCommand:
    Description: "How to deploy this stack"
    Value: !Sub |
      aws cloudformation deploy \
        --template-file infrastructure/bedrock-guardrail.yaml \
        --stack-name ${AWS::StackName} \
        --region ${AWS::Region} \
        --no-fail-on-empty-changeset

cfn_description: HarveLogix AI - API Gateway HTTPS Proxy to EC2 Backend
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0001", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "API Gateway stages for V1 and V2 should have access logging enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Access logging is not configured.", "resolution": "Enable logging for API Gateway stages", "resource": "tmpnpk2uih4.yaml:61-66", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0001.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'HarveLogix AI - API Gateway HTTPS Proxy to EC2 Backend'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name

  Ec2IpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: '18.60.156.250'
    Description: 'Public IP address of the EC2 backend server'

Resources:
  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'harvelogix-api-${Environment}'
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins:
          - '*'
        AllowMethods:
          - '*'
        AllowHeaders:
          - '*'

  ProxyIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: HTTP_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'http://${Ec2IpAddress}:5000/api/{proxy}'
      IntegrationMethod: ANY
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  RootIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: HTTP_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'http://${Ec2IpAddress}:5000/api/'
      IntegrationMethod: ANY
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  ProxyRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'ANY /{proxy+}'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ProxyIntegration}'

  RootRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: 'ANY /'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${RootIntegration}'

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      AutoDeploy: true

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: "The HTTPS URL for the API Gateway"
    Value: !Sub "https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Environment}"

---

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: This template deploys an IAM User to be used with Citrix MCS and Hosting Configuration as CTX140429.

Resources:
  CitrixUser:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::User'
    Properties:
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CitrixXAXDServiceMCS
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - ec2:AttachVolume
                - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                - ec2:CreateImage
                - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                - ec2:CreateTags
                - ec2:CreateVolume
                - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                - ec2:DeleteVolume
                - ec2:DeregisterImage
                - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                - ec2:DescribeImages
                - ec2:DescribeInstances
                - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                - ec2:DescribeRegions
                - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                - ec2:DetachVolume
                - ec2:RebootInstances
                - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                - ec2:RunInstances
                - ec2:StartInstances
                - ec2:StopInstances
                - ec2:TerminateInstances
                - s3:CreateBucket
                - s3:DeleteBucket
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
              Resource: "*"
  CitrixAccessKey:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::AccessKey'
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref CitrixUser

  AccessKeyParameter:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'CitrixQSAccessKey-${AWS::StackName}'
      Type: "String"
      Value: !Ref CitrixAccessKey
      Description: "IAM Access Key used for Citrix MCS Hosting Configuration"

  SecretKeyParameter:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'CitrixQSSecretKey-${AWS::StackName}'
      Type: "String"
      Value: !GetAtt
      - CitrixAccessKey
      - SecretAccessKey
      Description: "IAM Secret Key used for Citrix MCS Hosting Configuration"

Outputs:
  ParameterKeyAccessKey:
    Value: !Ref AccessKeyParameter
    Description: Parameter Store Key for Citrix MCS IAM Access Key
  ParameterKeySecretKey:
    Value: !Ref SecretKeyParameter
    Description: Parameter Store Key for Citrix MCS IAM Secret Key

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Administrator access service role for CloudFormation
Resources:
  CFNAdminRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
        - Effect: "Allow"
          Principal:
            Service: ["cloudformation.amazonaws.com"]
          Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

    Description: CloudFormation admin access service role.
    Value: !Ref CFNAdminRole

    Description: CloudFormation admin access service role ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt CFNAdminRole.Arn

---

Description: This is the Biotech Blueprint Informatics Service Catalog template that creates a Serivce Catalog portfolio and stocks it with a variety of informatics components you can easily deploy.

        Parameters:

      QSS3BucketName:

    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9a-zA-Z]+([0-9a-zA-Z-]*[0-9a-zA-Z])*$
    ConstraintDescription: Quick Start bucket name can include numbers, lowercase
      letters, uppercase letters, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen
      (-).
    Default: aws-ia

      can include numbers, lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and hyphens (-).
      It cannot start or end with a hyphen (-).
    Type: String
  QSS3KeyPrefix:
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9a-zA-Z-/]*$
    ConstraintDescription: Quick Start key prefix can include numbers, lowercase letters,
      uppercase letters, hyphens (-), and a forward slash (/) at the end of the prefix.
    Default: quickstart-biotech-blueprint/
    Description: S3 key prefix for the Quick Start assets. Quick Start key prefix
      can include numbers, lowercase letters, uppercase letters, hyphens (-), and
      forward slash (/).

Resources:
  PorfolioBB:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio"

    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct"

      Distributor: AWS
      SupportDescription: "You need to subscribe to the ChemAxon marketplace AMI before you can deploy this software. https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B077F6VV3B?qid=1553611079631&sr=0-1&ref_=srh_res_product_title."

  ChemAxonProductAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation"
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref PorfolioBB
      ProductId: !Ref ChemAxonProduct

  BenchlingProduct:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct"
    Properties:
      Owner: AWS
      Description: Benchling Biotech Blueprint template to automate creating PrivateLink and split horizon DNS configs to Benchling's SaaS platform.
      Distributor: Benchling
      SupportUrl: https://benchling.com/enterprise
      Name: Benchling
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "https://${QSS3BucketName}.s3.amazonaws.com/${QSS3KeyPrefix}templates/bb.benchling-platform.template"
  BenchlingProductAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation"
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref PorfolioBB
      ProductId: !Ref BenchlingProduct

  TitianMosaicProduct:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct"
    Properties:
      Owner: "Titian Software Limited"
      Description: "Mosaic FreezerManagement is a comprehensive and cost-effective software solution for managing and tracking all types of sample inventory, backed by a full audit trail. It provides a flexible interface to define and record properties for any type of sample or container, and manages your entire hierarchy of storage including freezers, shelves, cupboards, etc. Other features include an intuitive search interface, and expiry date tracking. IMPORTANT NOTE:  Please contact Titian at info@titian.co.uk for validation before you launch the template below, otherwise the template will fail."
      Distributor: "Titian Software Limited"
      SupportUrl: "https://www.titian.co.uk/resourcesandsupport/support-services"
      SupportDescription: "Titian supports a worldwide customer base – including customer sites in Europe, USA and Asia. Support may be provided by email, telephone or shared Desktop sessions"
      SupportEmail: "info@titian.co.uk"
      Name: "Mosaic FreezerManagement"
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "https://${QSS3BucketName}.s3.amazonaws.com/${QSS3KeyPrefix}submodules/quickstart-titian-mosaic/templates/bb.titian-mosaic.template"

  TitianProductAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation"
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref PorfolioBB
      ProductId: !Ref TitianMosaicProduct

  DotmaticsProduct:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct"
    Properties:
      Owner: "Dotmatics"
      Description: "Dotmatics Suite running on AWS.  Please contact sales@dotmatics.com for licensing details."
      Distributor: "Dotmatics"
      SupportUrl: "https://support.dotmatics.com"
      SupportDescription: "Support is provided through our usual channels – please visit our support pages or drop us an email."
      SupportEmail: "support@dotmatics.com"
      Name: "Dotmatics Suite"
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "https://${QSS3BucketName}.s3.amazonaws.com/${QSS3KeyPrefix}submodules/quickstart-dotmatics/templates/bb.dotmatics.template"

  DotmaticsProductAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation"
    Properties:
