cfn_description: CI/CD identity for the mir-emulator demo: a role GitHub Actions assumes via the account's existing OIDC provider (scoped to one repo + branch), and a CloudFormation service role that holds the resourc
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CI/CD identity for the mir-emulator demo: a role GitHub Actions assumes via
  the account's existing OIDC provider (scoped to one repo + branch), and a
  CloudFormation service role that holds the resource permissions so the
  GitHub role itself can only drive CloudFormation and the artifacts bucket.

Parameters:
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: JimothyJohn/amr-emulator
    Description: owner/repo allowed to assume the deploy role
  GitHubBranch:
    Type: String
    Default: master
    Description: Only pushes to this branch may deploy
  StackName:
    Type: String
    Default: mir-emulator-demo
    Description: The demo stack this identity is allowed to deploy
  HostedZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z039212425BG1MHVPYWDN
    Description: Route53 zone the demo stack may write DNS records into
  SecondaryHostedZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z00853032XEEE2WAQSDAH
    Description: Second Route53 zone (amr-emulator.com) the demo stack may write into

Resources:
  CfnExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${StackName}-cfn-exec
      Description: Assumed by CloudFormation to create/update the demo stack's resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: demo-stack-resources
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: LambdaOwnFunctionOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${StackName}
              # API Gateway v2 ARNs contain opaque ids minted at create time,
              # so this can only be scoped to the service within this region.
              - Sid: ApiGatewayThisRegion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - apigateway:GET
                  - apigateway:POST
                  - apigateway:PUT
                  - apigateway:PATCH
                  - apigateway:DELETE
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/*
              - Sid: FunctionRoleLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:UpdateRoleDescription
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${StackName}-FunctionRole-*
              - Sid: PassFunctionRoleToLambdaOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${StackName}-FunctionRole-*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: lambda.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: OwnLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:UntagResource
                  - logs:ListTagsForResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${StackName}*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${StackName}*
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroupsIsListOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
              # ACM certificate ARNs are opaque ids; request/describe/delete
              # cannot be resource-scoped ahead of issuance.
              - Sid: AcmForCustomDomain
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - acm:RequestCertificate
                  - acm:DescribeCertificate
                  - acm:DeleteCertificate
                  - acm:AddTagsToCertificate
                  - acm:ListTagsForCertificate
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DnsRecordsInOwnedZonesOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets
                  - route53:GetHostedZone
                  - route53:ListResourceRecordSets
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:route53:::hostedzone/${HostedZoneId}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:route53:::hostedzone/${SecondaryHostedZoneId}
              - Sid: DnsChangePolling
                Effect: Allow
                Action: route53:GetChange
                Resource: arn:aws:route53:::change/*
              - Sid: FetchLambdaBundle
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::mir-emulator-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*

  GitHubDeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${StackName}-github-deploy
      Description: !Sub Assumed by GitHub Actions (${GitHubRepo}@${GitHubBranch}) to deploy the demo
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud: sts.amazonaws.com
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub: !Sub repo:${GitHubRepo}:ref:refs/heads/${GitHubBranch}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: deploy-via-cloudformation-only
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DriveDemoStack
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${StackName}/*
              - Sid: TemplateSummaryIsReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: HandResourceWorkToCfnRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CfnExecRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ArtifactsBucketRw
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::mir-emulator-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::mir-emulator-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*
              - Sid: ResolveZoneIdIsReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: route53:ListHostedZonesByName
                Resource: "*"

Outputs:
  GitHubDeployRoleArn:
    Description: Set as repo variable AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN
    Value: !GetAtt GitHubDeployRole.Arn
  CfnExecRoleArn:
    Description: Set as repo variable AWS_CFN_EXEC_ROLE_ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CfnExecRole.Arn

cfn_description: Read-only identity for the weekly endpoint-log triage routine (issue #22): an IAM user whose only permissions are CloudWatch Logs reads against the demo stack's two log groups. The routine runs outsid
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0143", "severity": "LOW", "title": "IAM policies should not be granted directly to users.", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "One or more policies are attached directly to a user", "resolution": "Grant policies at the group level instead.", "resource": "tmph4pjexky.yaml:17-44", "query": "data.builtin.aws.iam.aws0143.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Read-only identity for the weekly endpoint-log triage routine (issue #22):
  an IAM user whose only permissions are CloudWatch Logs reads against the
  demo stack's two log groups. The routine runs outside GitHub Actions, so it
  cannot assume the OIDC deploy role; it authenticates with an access key
  created out-of-band (never in this template) and stored in the routine's
  environment.

Parameters:
  StackName:
    Type: String
    Default: mir-emulator-demo
    Description: The demo stack whose log groups this identity may read

Resources:
  LogTriageUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub ${StackName}-log-triage
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: read-demo-logs-only
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadDemoLogGroupsOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                  - logs:StartQuery
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${StackName}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${StackName}:*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${StackName}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/${StackName}:*
              # GetQueryResults returns results only for query ids this
              # principal started; DescribeLogGroups is list-only. Neither
              # supports resource-level scoping.
              - Sid: QueryResultsAndListCannotBeScoped
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:GetQueryResults
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

Outputs:
  LogTriageUserArn:
    Description: Create an access key for this user and store it in the triage routine's environment
    Value: !GetAtt LogTriageUser.Arn

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0342", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "IAM Pass Role Filtering", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "IAM policy allows 'iam:PassRole' action", "resolution": "Resolve permission escalations by denying pass role'", "resource": "tmp2mkih0y5.yaml:69-134", "query": "data.builtin.aws.iam.aws0342.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: MLflow Tracking Server infrastructure for SageMaker Studio

Parameters:
  StackCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'staging'
    Description: Stack identifying code (staging/prod)

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: String
    Description: Existing SageMaker Studio execution role name
    Default: ''

  SageMakerBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket for SageMaker artifacts
    Default: ''

  MLflowPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'mlflow'
    Description: S3 prefix for MLflow artifacts

Conditions:
  HasSageMakerRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SageMakerExecutionRole, '']]

Resources:
  # IAM ROLE FOR MLFLOW TRACKING SERVER
  MLflowTrackingServerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'MLflowTrackingServerRole-${StackCode}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLflowS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SageMakerBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SageMakerBucket}/${MLflowPrefix}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/mlflow/*'

  # POLICY TO ATTACH TO EXISTING SAGEMAKER ROLE
  SageMakerMLflowPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasSageMakerRole
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SageMakerMLflowPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: MLflowTrackingServerPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateMlflowTrackingServer
              - sagemaker:UpdateMlflowTrackingServer
              - sagemaker:DeleteMlflowTrackingServer
              - sagemaker:DescribeMlflowTrackingServer
              - sagemaker:ListMlflowTrackingServers
              - sagemaker:StartMlflowTrackingServer
              - sagemaker:StopMlflowTrackingServer
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:mlflow-tracking-server/*'
          - Sid: SageMakerStudioPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:StartSession
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*'
          - Sid: IAMListRolesPermission
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:ListRoles
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: IAMPassRoleForMLflow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt MLflowTrackingServerRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: S3PermissionsForMLflow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SageMakerBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${SageMakerBucket}/${MLflowPrefix}/*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsForMLflow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/mlflow/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole

Outputs:
  MLflowArtifactsBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for MLflow artifacts (existing SageMaker default bucket)
    Value: !Ref SageMakerBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MLflowBucket'

  MLflowArtifactsPath:
    Description: Full S3 path for MLflow artifacts
    Value: !Sub 's3://${SageMakerBucket}/${MLflowPrefix}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MLflowPath'

  MLflowTrackingServerRoleArn:
    Description: Role ARN for MLflow Tracking Server
    Value: !GetAtt MLflowTrackingServerRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MLflowRoleArn'

  MLflowTrackingServerRoleName:
    Description: Role name for MLflow Tracking Server
    Value: !Ref MLflowTrackingServerRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MLflowRoleName'

  SageMakerExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Existing SageMaker Studio execution role (updated with MLflow permissions)
    Value: !If [HasSageMakerRole, !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole, 'Not configured']

cfn_description: CodeBuild IAM Setup template
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CodeBuild IAM Setup template
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: An environment name that is prefixed to resource names
    Type: String
    Default: Poc

Resources:
  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-CodeBuildRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          -
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service:
                - "codebuild.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: /
      Policies:
        -
          PolicyName: "CodeBuildAccessPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"

              -
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "codecommit:ListBranches"
                  - "codecommit:ListRepositories"
                  - "codecommit:BatchGetRepositories"
                  - "codecommit:Get*"
                  - "codecommit:GitPull"
                Resource:
                - "arn:aws:codecommit:ap-south-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:codecommit:eu-central-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:codecommit:us-east-1:*:*"
              -
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource:
                - "arn:aws:logs:ap-south-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:*:*"
              -
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3::*:*"
              -
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                - kms:Create*
                - kms:Delete*
                - kms:Describe*
                - kms:Generate*
                - kms:List*
                - kms:TagResource
                - kms:UntagResource
                - kms:Get*
                - kms:Enable*
                - kms:Disable*
                - kms:Encrypt*
                - kms:Replicate*
                - kms:Put*
                - kms:Decrypt
                Resource:
                - "arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:*:*"
                - "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:*:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryFullAccess'

cfn_description: CloudFormation template to create an ACM Certificate.
content:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: This template creates the required IAM roles for SageMaker project templates

Outputs:

      - ProductsLaunchRoleCondition

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRoleArn:

      - ProductsUseRoleCondition

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildRoleArn:

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRoleArn:

    Value: !If
      - CodePipelineRoleCondition
      - !GetAtt CodePipelineRole.Arn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRoleArn:
    Description: EventsRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - EventsRoleCondition
      - !GetAtt EventsRole.Arn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsApiGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ApiGatewayRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - ApiGatewayRoleCondition
      - !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsApiGatewayRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsFirehoseRoleArn:
    Description: FirehoseRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - FirehoseRoleCondition
      - !GetAtt FirehoseRole.Arn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsFirehoseRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsGlueRoleArn:
    Description: GlueRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - GlueRoleCondition

      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsGlueRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: LambdaRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - LambdaRoleCondition

      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLambdaRole'

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ProductsExecutionRole ARN
    Value: !If
      - ProductsExecutionRoleCondition
      - !GetAtt ProductsExecutionRole.Arn
      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole'

Parameters:

  CreateProductsLaunchRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'NO'

  CreateProductsUseRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'NO'

  CreateCloudFormationRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCloudformationRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateCodeBuildRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateCodePipelineRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateEventsRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateApiGatewayRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsApiGatewayRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateFirehoseRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsFirehoseRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateGlueRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsGlueRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateLambdaRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLambdaRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

  CreateProductsExecutionRole:
    Description: Create AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Default: 'YES'

Conditions:
  ProductsLaunchRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateProductsLaunchRole, 'YES' ]
  ProductsUseRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateProductsUseRole, 'YES' ]
  CloudFormationRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateCloudFormationRole, 'YES' ]
  CodeBuildRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateCodeBuildRole, 'YES' ]
  CodePipelineRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateCodePipelineRole, 'YES' ]
  EventsRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateEventsRole, 'YES' ]
  ApiGatewayRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateApiGatewayRole, 'YES' ]
  FirehoseRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateFirehoseRole, 'YES' ]
  GlueRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateGlueRole, 'YES' ]
  LambdaRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateLambdaRole, 'YES' ]
  ProductsExecutionRoleCondition: !Equals [ !Ref CreateProductsExecutionRole, 'YES' ]

Resources:

  ProductsLaunchRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: ProductsLaunchRoleCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole
      Description: "SageMaker role created from the SageMaker AWS Management Console. This role has the permissions required to launch the Amazon SageMaker portfolio of products from AWS ServiceCatalog."
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service:
                - servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
                - codepipeline.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerAdmin-ServiceCatalogProductsServiceRolePolicy'

  ProductsUseRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: ProductsUseRoleCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole
      Description: "SageMaker role created from the SageMaker AWS Management Console. This role has the permissions required to use the Amazon SageMaker portfolio of products from AWS ServiceCatalog."
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service:
                - "codepipeline.amazonaws.com"
                - "cloudformation.amazonaws.com"
                - "firehose.amazonaws.com"
                - "codebuild.amazonaws.com"
                - "sagemaker.amazonaws.com"
                - "states.amazonaws.com"
                - "lambda.amazonaws.com"
                - "events.amazonaws.com"
                - "apigateway.amazonaws.com"
                - "glue.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              -
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/*SageMakerModelExecution*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:Delete*
                  - cloudformation:Get*
                  - cloudformation:Create*
                  - cloudformation:Update*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:stack/sagemaker-*
                  - arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:stackset/sagemaker-*
                  - arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:type/resource/*
                  - arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:stackset-target/sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                Resource:
                  - '*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudwatch:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:codebuild:*:*:project/sagemaker-*
                  - arn:aws:codebuild:*:*:build/sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - codebuild:ListCuratedEnvironmentImages
                Resource:
                  - '*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - codebuild:CreateReportGroup
                  - codebuild:CreateReport
                  - codebuild:UpdateReport
                  - codebuild:BatchPutTestCases
                  - codebuild:BatchPutCodeCoverages
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codebuild:*:${AWS::AccountId}:report-group/sagemaker*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - codecommit:CancelUploadArchive
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                  - codecommit:GetUploadArchiveStatus
                  - codecommit:UploadArchive
                Resource: arn:aws:codecommit:*:*:sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                Resource: arn:aws:codepipeline:*:*:sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission

                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability

                  - ecr:Describe*
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource:

                Effect: Allow
              -
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchDeleteImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:CreateRepository
                  - ecr:DeleteRepository
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:ecr:*:*:repository/sagemaker-*
              -
                Action:
                  - events:DeleteRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:RemoveTargets
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:events:*:*:rule/sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: arn:aws:firehose:*:*:deliverystream/sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeletePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeleteTable
                  - glue:BatchDeleteTableVersion
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:CreatePartition
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:DeletePartition
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:DeleteTableVersion
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetTableVersion
                  - glue:GetTableVersions
                  - glue:SearchTables
                  - glue:UpdatePartition
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:catalog
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:database/default
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:database/global_temp
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:database/sagemaker-*
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:table/sagemaker-*
                  - arn:aws:glue:*:*:tableVersion/sagemaker-*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:iam::*:role/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalog*
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:lambda:*:*:function:sagemaker-*
              -
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:Describe*
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketCors
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutBucketCors
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:

                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::sagemaker-*'

                  - states:ListTagsForResource

                  - states:StopExecution
                  - states:TagResource
                  - states:UntagResource

              -

              -
                Action:

                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:ListAliases'
                Resource:
                  - '*'
                Effect: Allow
              -
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:GetParameter*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
                Effect: Allow

  CloudFormationRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: CloudFormationRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCloudformationRole
      Description: "CloudFormationRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudformation.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCloudformationServiceRolePolicy"

  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: CodeBuildRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildRole
      Description: "CodeBuildRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "codebuild.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildServiceRolePolicy"

  CodePipelineRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: CodePipelineRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRole
      Description: "CodePipelineRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "codepipeline.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineServiceRolePolicy"

  EventsRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: EventsRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRole
      Description: "EventsRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "events.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Path: "/service-role/"
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsServiceRolePolicy"

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: ApiGatewayRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsApiGatewayRole

cfn_description: CloudFormation template for Sera session data ElastiCache Redis infrastructure
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Sera session data ElastiCache Redis infrastructure'

Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: sera
    Description: Prefix for all resource names to support multiple SERA deployments
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and be 3-21 characters long

Resources:
  # ElastiCache Subnet Group
  SeraSessionDataSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-session-data-subnet-group'
      Description: !Sub 'Subnet group for ${StackPrefix} session data ElastiCache cluster'
      SubnetIds:
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-session-db-subnet-1-id'
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-session-db-subnet-2-id'
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-session-db-subnet-3-id'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # Redis AUTH token secret (kept for migration compatibility)
  RedisAuthTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Metadata:
      cdk_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: AwsSolutions-SMG4
            reason: "This is only to maintain compatibility-uses IAM Auth Tokens for authentication"
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-auth-token'
      Description: !Sub 'Redis AUTH token for ${StackPrefix} session data cluster'
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\`~+=[]{}|;:,.*?()_%'
        RequireEachIncludedType: false
        IncludeSpace: false
      KmsKeyId: !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-kms-key-arn'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # Custom default User for migration compatibility
  RedisDisabledDefaultUser:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::User
    Properties:
      UserId: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-disabled-default'
      UserName: "default"
      AccessString: "off ~* +@all"
      AuthenticationMode:
        Type: "password"
        Passwords:
          - !Sub "{{resolve:secretsmanager:${RedisAuthTokenSecret}:SecretString}}"
      Engine: "redis"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # IAM-based User
  RedisIamUser:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::User
    Properties:
      UserId: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-iam-user'
      UserName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-iam-user'
      AccessString: "on ~* +@all"
      AuthenticationMode:
        Type: "iam"
      Engine: "redis"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # UserGroup containing both users
  RedisUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::UserGroup
    Properties:
      Engine: "redis"
      UserGroupId: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-user-group'
      UserIds:
        - !Ref RedisDisabledDefaultUser
        - !Ref RedisIamUser
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # ElastiCache Replication Group (Redis with replicas)
  SeraSessionDataRedisCluster:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DependsOn: RedisUserGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupId: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-session-data'
      ReplicationGroupDescription: !Sub 'Redis cluster for ${StackPrefix} session data'
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: 7.1
      CacheNodeType: cache.m6g.large
      NumCacheClusters: 2
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-kms-key-id'
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref SeraSessionDataSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-redis-sg-id'
      UserGroupIds:
        - !Sub '${StackPrefix}-user-group'
      Port: 19703
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

Outputs:
  # Redis AUTH token secret
  RedisAuthTokenSecretArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Redis AUTH token secret'
    Value: !Ref RedisAuthTokenSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-auth-token-secret-arn'

  # ElastiCache outputs
  ElastiCacheEndpoint:
    Description: Primary endpoint for the Redis cluster
    Value: !GetAtt SeraSessionDataRedisCluster.PrimaryEndPoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-endpoint'

  ElastiCachePort:
    Description: Port for the Redis cluster
    Value: !GetAtt SeraSessionDataRedisCluster.PrimaryEndPoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-port'

  # Hard coded value: Support for CloudFormation error: Template error: resource SeraSessionDataRedisCluster does not support attribute type ReplicationGroupId in Fn::GetAtt even though docs say this is valid
  ReplicationGroupId:
    Description: Replication Group ID
    Value: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-session-data'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-replication-group-id'

  # Replication Group ARN
  ReplicationGroupArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Redis replication group'
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:elasticache:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:replicationgroup:${SeraSessionDataRedisCluster}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-replication-group-arn'

  # IAM User outputs
  RedisIamUserArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Redis IAM user'
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:elasticache:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user:${RedisIamUser}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-iam-user-arn'

  RedisIamUserName:
    Description: 'Name of the Redis IAM user'
    Value: !Ref RedisIamUser
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-redis-iam-user-name'

cfn_description: SERA ALB WAF - Web Application Firewall for Application Load Balancer - Multi-Stack Support
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SERA ALB WAF - Web Application Firewall for Application Load Balancer - Multi-Stack Support'

Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Unique prefix for this SERA deployment (e.g., sera-prod, sera-dev, sera-partner1)'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be 3-21 characters, lowercase, start with letter, hyphens allowed'
    Default: 'sera'

Resources:
  # WAF Web ACL for ALB
  ALBWAFWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Metadata:
      checkov:
        skip:
          - id: CKV_AWS_192
            comment: "WAF includes AWS Managed Rules for comprehensive protection including SQLi, XSS, and known bad inputs. Application is Python-based with proper input validation."
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf'
      Description: !Sub 'WAF for ${StackPrefix} Application Load Balancer'
      Scope: REGIONAL
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}

      Rules:
        # Rate limiting for general traffic (custom rule - uses Action)
        - Name: GeneralRateLimit
          Priority: 1
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000  # 2000 requests per 5 minutes per IP
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}GeneralRateLimit'

        # Stricter rate limiting for API endpoints (custom rule - uses Action)
        - Name: APIRateLimit
          Priority: 2
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 1000  # 1000 requests per 5 minutes per IP
              AggregateKeyType: IP
              ScopeDownStatement:
                ByteMatchStatement:
                  SearchString: '/api/'
                  FieldToMatch:
                    UriPath: {}
                  TextTransformations:
                    - Priority: 0
                      Type: LOWERCASE
                  PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}APIRateLimit'

        # AWS Managed Rules - Common Rule Set (OWASP Top 10)
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 3
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}CommonRuleSet'

        # AWS Managed Rules - Known Bad Inputs
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 4
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}KnownBadInputs'

        # AWS Managed Rules - SQL Injection Protection
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          Priority: 5
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}SQLi'

        # AWS Managed Rules - Linux Operating System Protection
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet
          Priority: 6
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}Linux'

        # IP Reputation monitoring
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 7
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}IpReputation'

      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # Associate WAF with ALB
  ALBWebACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-alb-arn'
      WebACLArn: !GetAtt ALBWAFWebACL.Arn

  # CloudWatch Log Group for WAF Logs
  WAFLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub 'aws-waf-logs-${StackPrefix}-alb'
      RetentionInDays: 3653
      KmsKeyId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-kms-key-arn'

  # WAF Logging Configuration
  WAFLoggingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::LoggingConfiguration
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !GetAtt ALBWAFWebACL.Arn
      LogDestinationConfigs:
        - !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:aws-waf-logs-${StackPrefix}-alb"
      LoggingFilter:
        DefaultBehavior: KEEP
        Filters:
          - Behavior: KEEP
            Conditions:
              - ActionCondition:
                  Action: COUNT
            Requirement: MEETS_ANY

Outputs:
  WAFWebACLId:
    Description: 'ID of the WAF Web ACL for ALB'
    Value: !Ref ALBWAFWebACL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf-id'

  WAFWebACLArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the WAF Web ACL for ALB'
    Value: !GetAtt ALBWAFWebACL.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf-arn'

  WAFLogGroupName:
    Description: 'CloudWatch Log Group for ALB WAF logs'
    Value: !Ref WAFLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-alb-waf-log-group'

        - AttributeName: seller_id

cfn_description: SERA CloudTrail Security Monitoring - Detects malicious activity via CloudWatch Alarms - Multi-Stack Support
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SERA CloudTrail Security Monitoring - Detects malicious activity via CloudWatch Alarms - Multi-Stack Support'

Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Unique prefix for this SERA deployment'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be 3-21 characters, lowercase, start with letter, hyphens allowed'
    Default: 'sera'

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Email address for security alerts (optional)'
    Default: ''

Resources:
  # SNS Topic for Security Alerts
  SecurityAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-security-alerts'
      DisplayName: 'SERA Security Alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-kms-key-id'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'

  SecurityAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - SNS:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SecurityAlertTopic

  # Email Subscription (if provided)
  SecurityAlertEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      TopicArn: !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  # ===== HIGH PRIORITY DETECTIONS =====

  # CloudTrail Tampering - DeleteTrail
  DeleteTrailMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = DeleteTrail) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: DeleteTrailCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  DeleteTrailAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-DeleteTrail-Detected'
      AlarmDescription: 'CRITICAL: CloudTrail deletion attempted - attacker covering tracks'
      MetricName: DeleteTrailCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # CloudTrail Tampering - StopLogging
  StopLoggingMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = StopLogging) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: StopLoggingCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  StopLoggingAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-StopLogging-Detected'
      AlarmDescription: 'CRITICAL: CloudTrail logging stopped - attacker covering tracks'
      MetricName: StopLoggingCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # IAM Role Policy Changes
  IAMRolePolicyChangeMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteRolePolicy) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: IAMRolePolicyChangeCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  IAMRolePolicyChangeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-IAMRolePolicy-Changed'
      AlarmDescription: 'HIGH: IAM role policy modified - potential privilege escalation'
      MetricName: IAMRolePolicyChangeCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # IAM User/Access Key Creation
  IAMAccessCreationMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateAccessKey) || ($.eventName = CreateUser) || ($.eventName = CreateLoginProfile) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: IAMAccessCreationCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  IAMAccessCreationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-IAMAccess-Created'
      AlarmDescription: 'HIGH: New IAM access created - potential persistence mechanism'
      MetricName: IAMAccessCreationCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # Security Group Changes - Unauthorized Port Opening
  SecurityGroupIngressMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SecurityGroupIngressCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  SecurityGroupIngressAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-SecurityGroup-Modified'
      AlarmDescription: 'MEDIUM: Security group rule added - review for unauthorized access'
      MetricName: SecurityGroupIngressCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 5
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # VPC Network Changes
  VPCNetworkChangeMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateRoute) || ($.eventName = AttachInternetGateway) || ($.eventName = CreateVpcPeeringConnection) || ($.eventName = AcceptVpcPeeringConnection) }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: VPCNetworkChangeCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  VPCNetworkChangeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-VPCNetwork-Changed'
      AlarmDescription: 'HIGH: VPC network configuration changed - potential data exfiltration route'
      MetricName: VPCNetworkChangeCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # Root Account Usage
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      LogGroupName: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-cloudtrail-log-group-name'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: RootAccountUsageCount
          MetricNamespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-RootAccount-Used'
      AlarmDescription: 'CRITICAL: Root account used - should only be used for break-glass scenarios'
      MetricName: RootAccountUsageCount
      Namespace: !Sub '${StackPrefix}/SecurityEvents'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Conditions:
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Outputs:
  SecurityAlertTopicArn:
    Description: 'SNS Topic ARN for security alerts'
    Value: !Ref SecurityAlertTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-security-alert-topic-arn'

  SecurityAlertTopicName:
    Description: 'SNS Topic Name for security alerts'
    Value: !GetAtt SecurityAlertTopic.TopicName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-security-alert-topic-name'

cfn_description: SERA Cognito WAF - Deploy in us-east-1 ONLY - Multi-Stack Support
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SERA Cognito WAF - Deploy in us-east-1 ONLY - Multi-Stack Support'

Parameters:
  StackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Unique prefix for this SERA deployment (e.g., sera-prod, sera-dev, sera-partner1)'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be 3-21 characters, lowercase, start with letter, hyphens allowed'
    Default: 'sera'

Conditions:
  IsUSEast1: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'us-east-1']

Resources:
  # WAF Web ACL for Cognito (us-east-1 only) - With Managed Rules
  CognitoWAFWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Condition: IsUSEast1
    Metadata:
      checkov:
        skip:
          - id: CKV_AWS_192
            comment: "Log4j protection rule (AWSManagedRulesLog4jRuleSet) has been added to the WAF rules. SERA application is Python-based (not Java) so not vulnerable to Log4j, but rule added for compliance and defense-in-depth."
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf'
      Description: !Sub 'WAF for ${StackPrefix} Cognito User Pool - COUNT mode for monitoring'
      Scope: REGIONAL
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}

      Rules:
        # Rate limiting for authentication attempts (custom rule - uses Action)
        - Name: AuthenticationRateLimit
          Priority: 1
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 100  # 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP
              AggregateKeyType: IP
              ScopeDownStatement:
                OrStatement:
                  Statements:
                    - ByteMatchStatement:
                        SearchString: '/oauth2/'
                        FieldToMatch:
                          UriPath: {}
                        TextTransformations:
                          - Priority: 0
                            Type: LOWERCASE
                        PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                    - ByteMatchStatement:
                        SearchString: '/login'
                        FieldToMatch:
                          UriPath: {}
                        TextTransformations:
                          - Priority: 0
                            Type: LOWERCASE
                        PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
          Action:
            Count: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}AuthRateLimit'

        # AWS Managed Rules - Common Rule Set (managed rule - uses OverrideAction only)
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            Count: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}CommonRuleSet'

        # AWS Managed Rules - Known Bad Inputs (managed rule - uses OverrideAction only)
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 3
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            Count: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}KnownBadInputs'

        # IP Reputation monitoring (managed rule - uses OverrideAction only)
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 4
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            Count: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}IpReputation'

      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Sub 'SERA-${StackPrefix}'
        - Key: StackPrefix
          Value: !Ref StackPrefix

  # CloudWatch Log Group for WAF Logs (us-east-1 only)
  WAFLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: IsUSEast1
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub 'aws-waf-logs-${StackPrefix}-cognito'
      RetentionInDays: 3653
      KmsKeyId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${StackPrefix}-kms-key-arn'

  # WAF Logging Configuration (us-east-1 only)
  WAFLoggingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::LoggingConfiguration
    Condition: IsUSEast1
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !GetAtt CognitoWAFWebACL.Arn
      LogDestinationConfigs:
        - !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:aws-waf-logs-${StackPrefix}-cognito"
      LoggingFilter:
        DefaultBehavior: KEEP
        Filters:
          - Behavior: KEEP
            Conditions:
              - ActionCondition:
                  Action: COUNT
            Requirement: MEETS_ANY

Outputs:
  WAFWebACLId:
    Description: 'ID of the WAF Web ACL for Cognito (us-east-1 only)'
    Value: !If [IsUSEast1, !Ref CognitoWAFWebACL, 'Not deployed - wrong region']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf-id'

  WAFWebACLArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the WAF Web ACL for Cognito (us-east-1 only)'
    Value: !If [IsUSEast1, !GetAtt CognitoWAFWebACL.Arn, 'Not deployed - wrong region']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf-arn'

  DeploymentRegion:
    Description: 'Region where this WAF template was deployed'
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${StackPrefix}-cognito-waf-region'

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0001", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "API Gateway stages for V1 and V2 should have access logging enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Access logging is not configured.", "resolution": "Enable logging for API Gateway stages", "resource": "tmpjuq5hjeg.yaml:48-54", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0001.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0003", "severity": "LOW", "title": "API Gateway must have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "X-Ray tracing is not enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpjuq5hjeg.yaml:48-54", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0003.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0004", "severity": "LOW", "title": "No unauthorized access to API Gateway methods", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Authorization is not enabled for this method.", "resolution": "Use and authorization method or require API Key", "resource": "ApiGatewayMethod", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0004.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpjuq5hjeg.yaml:83-104", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation Examples by AlNao - 08 API Gateway per esporre un servizio REST con Lambda

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Description: Stage Name
    Default: dev
Resources:
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      ApiKeySourceType: HEADER
      Description: An API Gateway with a Lambda Integration
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - EDGE
      Name: lambda-api
  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: 'lambda'
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      HttpMethod: GET
      Integration:
        ConnectionType: INTERNET
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayIamRole.Arn
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST #see https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41371970/accessdeniedexception-unable-to-determine-service-operation-name-to-be-authoriz
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      OperationName: 'lambda'
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
  ApiGatewayModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      ContentType: 'application/json'
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Schema: {}
  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      Description: Lambda API Stage v0
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName #'v0'
  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      Description: Lambda API Deployment
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
  ApiGatewayIamRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ''
            Effect: 'Allow'
            Principal:
              Service:
                - 'apigateway.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: 'Allow'
                Action: 'lambda:*'
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
            print(event)
            response = {
              'isBase64Encoded': False,
              'statusCode': 200,
              'headers': {},
              'multiValueHeaders': {},
              'body': 'Hello, World!'
            }
            return response
      Description: AWS Lambda function called by Api gateway
      FunctionName: 'lambda-es08-apigaway'
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaIamRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 60
  LambdaIamRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: root
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: 'arn:aws:logs:*:*:*'

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: Deployed StackName for update
    Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  APIEndPoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL API REST
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/lambda

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Esempio29 - AppSync GraphQL API "listaNote" con DynamoDB e interfaccia web

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: esempio29-listaNote
    Description: Nome della GraphQL API
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: esempio29-listaNote
    Description: Nome della tabella DynamoDB

Resources:
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Nota {
          id: ID!
          testo: String!
        }
        type Query {
          getNote: [Nota]
        }
        type Mutation {
          addNota(testo: String!): Nota
          deleteNota(id: ID!): ID
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }
#      Tags:
#        - Key: Project
#          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  GraphQLApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
# il valore è calcolato così:
# date -d "+7 days" +%s
      Expires: 1754760363 #non funziona: !Sub "{{resolve:timestamp: +7d}}"
#      Tags:
#        - Key: Project
#          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  NoteTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  DataSourceDynamo:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoteTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref NoteTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoRole.Arn
#      Tags:
#        - Key: Project
#          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  AppSyncDynamoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt NoteTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: Esempio29GraphQL

  ResolverGetNote:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceDynamo.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $utils.toJson($ctx.result.items)

  ResolverAddNota:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addNota
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceDynamo.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": { "S": "$util.autoId()" }
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "testo": { "S": "$ctx.args.testo" }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "id": "$ctx.result.id.S",
          "testo": "$ctx.result.testo.S"
        }

  ResolverDeleteNota:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteNota
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceDynamo.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "DeleteItem",
          "key": {
            "id": { "S": "$ctx.args.id" }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        "$ctx.args.id"

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: URL dell'endpoint GraphQL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiKey:
    Description: API Key per l'accesso
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApiKey.ApiKey
  DynamoTableName:
    Description: Nome della tabella DynamoDB
    Value: !Ref NoteTable
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID della GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  AwsRegion:
    Description: Regione AWS
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'ECR repository for Strands Agent'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentic-sales-analyst

Resources:
  Repository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref ProjectName
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [{
              "rulePriority": 1,
              "description": "Keep last 10 images",
              "selection": {
                "tagStatus": "any",
                "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                "countNumber": 10
              },
              "action": {"type": "expire"}
            }]
          }

Outputs:
  RepositoryUri:
    Value: !GetAtt Repository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-ecr-uri

cfn_description: IAM roles for Strands Agent
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles for Strands Agent'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentic-sales-analyst

Resources:
  ExecutionRole:  # cdk-nag: disable=AwsSolutions-IAM4:ECS requires AWS managed policy for task execution
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
