cfn_description: AWS Cloud WAN Inspection - Centralized Outbound (Global Network & Core Network)
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: AWS Cloud WAN Inspection - Centralized Outbound (Global Network & Core Network)

Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Global Network - Centralized Outbound
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: global-network-centralized-outbound

  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Core Network - Centralized Outbound
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: core-network-centralized-outbound
      PolicyDocument:
        version: "2025.11"
        core-network-configuration:
          vpn-ecmp-support: false
          asn-ranges:
            - 64520-64525
          edge-locations:
            - location: eu-west-1
            - location: us-east-1
            - location: ap-southeast-2
        segments:
          - name: production
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
            isolate-attachments: true
          - name: development
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        network-function-groups:
          - name: inspectionVpcs
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                operator: equals
                key: inspection
                value: true
            action:
              add-to-network-function-group: inspectionVpcs
          - rule-number: 200
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: domain
            action:
              association-method: tag
              tag-value-of-key: domain

Outputs:
  CoreNetworkId:
    Description: Core Network ID.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkId
  CoreNetworkArn:
    Description: Core Network ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkArn

content:

Description: AWS Cloud WAN Filtering - Influencing DXGW hybrid path (Global & Core network)

Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

      Description: Core Network - Influencing DXGW hybrid path
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: core-network-influencing-dxgw-hybrid-path
      PolicyDocument:
        version: '2025.11'
        core-network-configuration:
          vpn-ecmp-support: true
          dns-support: true
          security-group-referencing-support: true
          asn-ranges:
            - 65000-65003
          edge-locations:
            - location: us-east-1
              asn: 65000
            - location: eu-west-1
              asn: 65001
        segments:
          - name: europevpcs
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: usvpcs
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: hybrid
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            condition-logic: and
            conditions:
              - type: attachment-type
                operator: equals
                value: vpc
              - type: region
                operator: equals
                value: eu-west-1
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: europevpcs
          - rule-number: 200
            condition-logic: and
            conditions:
              - type: attachment-type
                operator: equals
                value: vpc
              - type: region
                operator: equals
                value: us-east-1
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: usvpcs
          - rule-number: 300
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: attachment-type
                operator: equals
                value: direct-connect-gateway
            action:
              association-method: constant
              segment: hybrid
        segment-actions:
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: hybrid
            share-with:
              - europevpcs
            routing-policy-names:
              - addASPathUS
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: hybrid
            share-with:
              - usvpcs
            routing-policy-names:
              - addASPathEurope
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: europevpcs
            share-with:
              - usvpcs
        routing-policies:
          - routing-policy-name: addASPathEurope
            routing-policy-description: Adding extra ASNs for Europe's DXGW
            routing-policy-direction: outbound
            routing-policy-number: 100
            routing-policy-rules:
              - rule-number: 100
                rule-definition:
                  match-conditions:
                    - type: asn-in-as-path
                      value: 64512
                  condition-logic: or
                  action:
                    type: prepend-asn-list
                    value:
                      - 65500
                      - 65501
          - routing-policy-name: addASPathUS
            routing-policy-description: Adding extra ASNs for US' DXGW
            routing-policy-direction: outbound
            routing-policy-number: 200
            routing-policy-rules:
              - rule-number: 100
                rule-definition:
                  match-conditions:
                    - type: asn-in-as-path

                  condition-logic: or
                  action:
                    type: prepend-asn-list
                    value:
                      - 65500
                      - 65501

Outputs:

  CoreNetworkArn:
    Description: Core Network ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkArn

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: AWS Cloud WAN Filtering - IPv4 & IPv6 only segments (Global & Core network)

Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:

    Properties:
      Description: Global Network - IPv4-IPv6-only segments
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: global-network-ipv4-ipv6-only-segments

  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Core Network - IPv4-IPv6-only segments
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: core-network-ipv4-ipv6-only-segments
      PolicyDocument:
        version: '2025.11'
        core-network-configuration:
          vpn-ecmp-support: true
          dns-support: true
          security-group-referencing-support: true
          asn-ranges:
            - 65000-65003
          edge-locations:
            - location: us-east-1
              asn: 65000
            - location: eu-west-1
              asn: 65001
        segments:
          - name: production
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: development
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: ipv4only
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: ipv6only
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            condition-logic: and
            conditions:
              - type: attachment-type
                operator: equals
                value: vpc
              - type: tag-exists
                key: domain
            action:
              association-method: tag
              tag-value-of-key: domain
        segment-actions:
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: ipv4only
            share-with:
              - production
              - development
            routing-policy-names:
              - filterIpv6
          - action: share
            mode: attachment-route
            segment: ipv6only
            share-with:
              - production
              - development
            routing-policy-names:
              - filterIpv4
        routing-policies:
          - routing-policy-name: filterIpv4
            routing-policy-description: Filtering all IPv4 ranges
            routing-policy-direction: inbound
            routing-policy-number: 100
            routing-policy-rules:
              - rule-number: 100
                rule-definition:
                  match-conditions:
                    - type: prefix-in-cidr
                      value: 0.0.0.0/0
                    - type: prefix-equals
                      value: 0.0.0.0/0
                  condition-logic: or
                  action:
                    type: drop
          - routing-policy-name: filterIpv6
            routing-policy-description: Filtering all IPv6 ranges
            routing-policy-direction: inbound
            routing-policy-number: 200
            routing-policy-rules:
              - rule-number: 100
                rule-definition:
                  match-conditions:
                    - type: prefix-in-cidr
                      value: ::/0
                    - type: prefix-equals
                      value: ::/0
                  condition-logic: or
                  action:
                    type: drop

Outputs:
  CoreNetworkId:
    Description: Core Network ID.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkId
  CoreNetworkArn:
    Description: Core Network ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt CoreNetwork.CoreNetworkArn

cfn_description: AWS network backbone resources paired with OCI-primary DRG backbone.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS network backbone resources paired with OCI-primary DRG backbone.

Parameters:
  BackboneVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
  BackboneSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
  AllowedIngressCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
  EnableSiteToSiteVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
  OciCustomerGatewayPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.51.100.10
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.54.0.0/16
  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898

Conditions:
  EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableSiteToSiteVpn, "true"]

Resources:
  BackboneVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref BackboneVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-backbone'

  BackboneLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} VPC flow log encryption key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'

  BackboneFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt BackboneLogKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  BackboneFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: write-vpc-flow-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${BackboneFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  BackboneVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt BackboneFlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref BackboneFlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw-backbone'

  VpcIgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BackboneRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt-backbone'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcIgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BackboneRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BackboneSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref BackboneSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sn-backbone'

  SubnetRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BackboneSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BackboneRouteTable

  BackboneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: AWS backbone security group for OCI hybrid interconnect demos.
      VpcId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Allow approved HTTPS ingress to the backbone edge.
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedIngressCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Allow HTTPS egress toward the OCI backbone CIDR.
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg-backbone'

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} transit gateway for OCI backbone interconnect'
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-backbone'

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref BackboneVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BackboneSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attach-backbone'

  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayPublicIp
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cgw-oci-primary'

  OciSiteToSiteVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpn-oci-primary'

  BackboneToOciTransitRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition
    DependsOn:
      - TransitGatewayAttachment
      - OciSiteToSiteVpnConnection
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BackboneRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

Outputs:
  AwsTransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID for OCI DRG attachment contracts.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  AwsTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: Transit Gateway attachment ID.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachment
  AwsBackboneVpcId:
    Description: AWS backbone VPC ID.
    Value: !Ref BackboneVpc
  AwsBackboneSubnetId:
    Description: AWS backbone subnet ID.
    Value: !Ref BackboneSubnet
  AwsBackboneRouteTableId:
    Description: AWS backbone route table ID.
    Value: !Ref BackboneRouteTable
  AwsBackboneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: AWS backbone security group ID.
    Value: !Ref BackboneSecurityGroup
  AwsCustomerGatewayId:
    Description: AWS Customer Gateway ID for OCI-primary Site-to-Site VPN.
    Value: !If [EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition, !Ref OciCustomerGateway, ""]
  AwsVpnConnectionId:
    Description: AWS VPN connection ID for OCI-primary Site-to-Site VPN.
    Value: !If [EnableSiteToSiteVpnCondition, !Ref OciSiteToSiteVpnConnection, ""]

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  AWS Landing Zone - VPC & Networking Layer
  Provisions a hub VPC with Transit Gateway, public/private subnets,
  NAT Gateways, and route tables. Designed for multi-account spoke attachment.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: "VPC Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
          - VpcCIDR
          - PublicSubnet1CIDR
          - PublicSubnet2CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet1CIDR
          - PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      - Label:
          default: "Transit Gateway Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayASN
          - EnableDnsSupport
          - EnableVpnEcmpSupport

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix used for resource naming and tagging.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC.
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ1.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ2.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.10.0/24"
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ1.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.11.0/24"
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ2.

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: BGP ASN for the Transit Gateway (64512-65534 for private ASN).
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  EnableDnsSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: "enable"
    AllowedValues: ["enable", "disable"]

  EnableVpnEcmpSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: "enable"
    AllowedValues: ["enable", "disable"]

Resources:
  # ─── VPC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  HubVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ─── SUBNETS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private

  # ─── NAT GATEWAYS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1"

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-az1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-az2"

  # ─── ROUTE TABLES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rtb"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az1"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rtb-az2"

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ─── TRANSIT GATEWAY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Landing Zone Transit Gateway - ${EnvironmentName}"
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable      # Explicit approval required for security
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: !Ref EnableDnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref EnableVpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-hub-attachment"

  # Route private traffic destined for spoke CIDRs via TGW (10.0.0.0/8 summary)
  PrivateTGWRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/8"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateTGWRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/8"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ─── VPC FLOW LOGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log"

  # ─── VPC ENDPOINTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Allow HTTPS traffic for VPC Endpoints"
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg"

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref HubVPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcId"

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID (share with spoke accounts via RAM)
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayId"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id"

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"

  VpcCIDR:

    Export:

cfn_description: Cognito User Pool with self-service signup enabled. For testing AgentCore Gateway JWT flows. No admin user setup required.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito User Pool with self-service signup enabled. For testing AgentCore Gateway JWT flows. No admin user setup required.'

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/callback,http://localhost:8501/,http://localhost:8080/callback'
    Description: 'Allowed redirect URIs after a successful login (comma-separated)'

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/,http://localhost:8501/,http://localhost:8080/'
    Description: 'Allowed logout redirect URIs (comma-separated)'

Resources:
  # User Pool — self-service signup enabled, no admin gating
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    # This UserPool is provisioned for tutorial / lab walkthroughs only — it is
    # not intended for production. The MFA-off and "no advanced security"
    # findings are intentional so the notebooks stay self-serve runnable for
    # readers without an SES sender or a Cognito Plus tier; the password
    # policy is intentionally relaxed (no symbols required) so the demo
    # passwords in the tutorial code remain accept-able by the pool.
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: F78
            reason: 'Tutorial/demo Cognito pool — MFA is intentionally OFF so the lab can be run by readers without setting up an MFA channel. Not for production.'
      cdk_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: AwsSolutions-COG1
            reason: 'Tutorial password policy is intentionally minimal (no symbols required) so the demo credentials in the notebook keep working. Not for production.'
          - id: AwsSolutions-COG2
            reason: 'Tutorial/demo Cognito pool — MFA is intentionally OFF so the notebooks are self-serve runnable. Not for production.'
          - id: AwsSolutions-COG3
            reason: 'Advanced security mode left at default for this tutorial pool — readers may not have access to the Cognito Plus tier required to enable it.'
          - id: AwsSolutions-COG8
            reason: 'Advanced security mode left at default for this tutorial pool — readers may not have access to the Cognito Plus tier required to enable ENFORCED mode.'
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pool'

      # Self-service signup
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

      # Sign in with email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

      # Email verification code is sent on signup; user verifies themselves
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'Verify your email for elicitation testing'

      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

      UserPoolTags:
        Application: elicitation
        Purpose: 'Self-service signup for JWT testing'

  # Hosted UI domain for signup / login pages
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource server — required for client_credentials (Cognito mandates a custom scope)
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub 'api'
      Name: !Sub 'api resource server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: 'mcp'
          ScopeDescription: 'Invoke the MCP server'
        - ScopeName: 'gateway'
          ScopeDescription: 'Invoke the gateway'

  # Public web client — auth code + PKCE, plus password grant for dev/CLI testing
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

      # Public client (PKCE) — no client secret
      GenerateSecret: false  # pragma: allowlist secret  -- CFN property, not a credential

      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile

      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs

      # Programmatic auth flows for testing without a browser
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'

  # M2M client for inbound to the MCP server
  # Gateway uses these credentials (client_credentials grant) to mint a JWT
  # whose client_id is whitelisted by the MCP server's CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
  # Note: user context is NOT preserved across this hop — propagate via headers if needed.
  MCPClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

      GenerateSecret: true  # pragma: allowlist secret  -- CFN property, not a credential

      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'api/mcp'

      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'

  # M2M client for inbound auth to the Gateway.
  # The notebook uses these credentials (client_credentials grant) to mint a JWT
  # whose client_id is whitelisted by the Gateway's CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
  GatewayClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-gateway'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

      GenerateSecret: true  # pragma: allowlist secret  -- CFN property, not a credential

      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'api/gateway'

      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: 'ENABLED'

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StackName'

  UserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID'
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  WebClientId:
    Description: 'Public web client ID (use this in your app)'
    Value: !Ref WebClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebClientId'

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: 'Cognito hosted UI base URL'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedUIDomain'

  SignupUrl:
    Description: 'Open this in a browser to self-signup (uses first callback URL)'
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/signup?client_id=${WebClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${FirstCallback}'
      - FirstCallback: !Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs]

  LoginUrl:
    Description: 'Hosted UI login page'
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${WebClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${FirstCallback}'
      - FirstCallback: !Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs]

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'OAuth 2.0 token endpoint'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenEndpoint'

  Issuer:
    Description: 'Token issuer (iss claim)'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Issuer'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC discovery URL — use this in the Gateway / Runtime CUSTOM_JWT authorizer'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrl'

  PasswordGrantExample:
    Description: 'Example: get a JWT via password grant (after self-signup + email verify)'
    Value: !Sub |
      curl -s -X POST https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/ \
        -H "Content-Type: application/x-amz-json-1.1" \
        -H "X-Amz-Target: AWSCognitoIdentityProviderService.InitiateAuth" \
        -d '{
          "AuthFlow":"USER_PASSWORD_AUTH",
          "ClientId":"${WebClient}",
          "AuthParameters":{"USERNAME":"<your-email>","PASSWORD":"<your-password>"}
        }'

  MCPClientId:
    Description: 'M2M client ID — whitelist this in MCP server CUSTOM_JWT allowedClients'
    Value: !Ref MCPClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MCPClientId'

  MCPScope:
    Description: 'Scope to request when minting MCP-bound tokens'
    Value: !Sub 'api/mcp'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MCPScope'

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: 'Resource server identifier (scope prefix)'
    Value: !Ref ResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier'

  MCPClientSecretCommand:
    Description: 'Run this to fetch the MCP client secret (CFN does not surface it directly)'
    Value: !Sub |
      aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client \
        --user-pool-id ${UserPool} \
        --client-id ${MCPClient} \
        --region ${AWS::Region} \
        --query 'UserPoolClient.ClientSecret' --output text

  MCPClientCredentialsExample:
    Description: 'Example: Gateway mints an MCP-bound token via client_credentials'
    Value: !Sub |
      curl -s -X POST https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token \
        -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
        -u "${MCPClient}:<MCP_CLIENT_SECRET>" \
        -d "grant_type=client_credentials&scope=api/mcp"

  GatewayClientId:
    Description: 'M2M client ID for inbound auth to the Gateway — whitelist in Gateway CUSTOM_JWT allowedClients'
    Value: !Ref GatewayClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayClientId'

  GatewayScope:
    Description: 'Scope to request when minting Gateway-bound tokens'
    Value: !Sub 'api/gateway'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayScope'

  GatewayClientSecretCommand:
    Description: 'Run this to fetch the Gateway client secret (CFN does not surface it directly)'
    Value: !Sub |
      aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client \
        --user-pool-id ${UserPool} \
        --client-id ${GatewayClient} \
        --region ${AWS::Region} \
        --query 'UserPoolClient.ClientSecret' --output text

cfn_description: AgentCore Memory cross-region replication — DynamoDB Global Table

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0001", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "API Gateway stages for V1 and V2 should have access logging enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Access logging is not configured.", "resolution": "Enable logging for API Gateway stages", "resource": "tmp2tr0k_50.yaml:152-157", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0001.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0003", "severity": "LOW", "title": "API Gateway must have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "X-Ray tracing is not enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmp2tr0k_50.yaml:152-157", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0003.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Sample PetStore REST API for AgentCore Gateway API Gateway target tutorial. Mock integrations with IAM (SigV4) and API Key authorization.'

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: 'API Gateway deployment stage name'

Resources:
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-petstore'
      Description: 'Sample PetStore API for AgentCore Gateway integration'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Body:
        openapi: '3.0.1'
        info:
          title: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-petstore'
          description: 'Sample PetStore API for AgentCore Gateway integration'
          version: '1.0'
        paths:
          /pets:
            get:
              operationId: ListPets
              summary: List all available pets
              parameters:
                - name: type
                  in: query
                  schema:
                    type: string
                - name: page
                  in: query
                  schema:
                    type: string
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: 200 response
                  content:
                    application/json:
                      schema:
                        type: array
              security:
                - sigv4: []
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                type: mock
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: '[{"id":1,"type":"dog","price":249.99},{"id":2,"type":"cat","price":124.99},{"id":3,"type":"fish","price":0.99}]'
            post:
              operationId: AddPet
              summary: Add a new pet
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: 200 response
                  content:
                    application/json:
                      schema:
                        type: object
              security:
                - sigv4: []
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                type: mock
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: '{"message":"Pet added successfully","id":4}'
          /pets/{petId}:
            get:
              operationId: GetPetById
              summary: Get pet by ID
              parameters:
                - name: petId
                  in: path
                  required: true
                  schema:
                    type: string
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: 200 response
                  content:
                    application/json:
                      schema:
                        type: object
              security:
                - sigv4: []
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                type: mock
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: '{"id":3,"type":"fish","price":0.99,"available":true}'
          /orders/{orderId}:
            get:
              operationId: GetOrderById
              summary: Get order details by ID
              parameters:
                - name: orderId
                  in: path
                  required: true
                  schema:
                    type: string
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: 200 response
                  content:
                    application/json:
                      schema:
                        type: object
              security:
                - api_key: []
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                type: mock
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: '{"orderId":"2","status":"shipped","estimatedDelivery":"2025-06-15","items":[{"petId":1,"quantity":1}]}'
              x-amazon-apigateway-api-key-source: HEADER
        components:
          securitySchemes:
            sigv4:
              type: apiKey
              name: Authorization
              in: header
              x-amazon-apigateway-authtype: awsSigv4
            api_key:
              type: apiKey
              name: x-api-key
              in: header

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    DependsOn: Stage
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api-key'
      Enabled: true
      StageKeys:
        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
          StageName: !Ref StageName

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn: Stage
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-usage-plan'
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName
      Throttle:
        BurstLimit: 10
        RateLimit: 5

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  RestApiId:
    Description: 'API Gateway REST API ID'
    Value: !Ref RestApi
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RestApiId'

  InvokeUrl:
    Description: 'API Gateway invoke URL'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: 'API Key ID'
    Value: !Ref ApiKey

  ApiKeyRetrieveCommand:
    Description: 'Run this to retrieve the API key value'
    Value: !Sub |
      aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key ${ApiKey} --include-value --query 'value' --output text

  UsagePlanId:
    Description: 'Usage Plan ID'
    Value: !Ref UsagePlan

  StageName:
    Description: 'Deployed stage name'
    Value: !Ref StageName

cfn_description: Deploy a service on AWS Fargate, hosted in a public subnet, and accessible via a public load balancer.
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0017", "severity": "LOW", "title": "CloudWatch log groups should be encrypted using CMK", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Log group is not encrypted.", "resolution": "Enable CMK encryption of CloudWatch Log Groups", "resource": "tmpb2e7jeph.yaml:152-155", "query": "data.builtin.aws.cloudwatch.aws0017.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploy a service on AWS Fargate, hosted in a public subnet, and accessible via a public load balancer.
Parameters:
  StackName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: The name of the parent Fargate networking stack that you created. Necessary
                 to locate and reference resources created by that stack.
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: A name for the service
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: The url of a docker image that contains the application process that
                 will handle the traffic for this service
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: What port number the application inside the docker container is binding to
  ContainerCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU
  ContainerMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container
  Path:
    Type: String
    Default: "*"
    Description: A path on the public load balancer that this service
                 should be connected to. Use * to send all load balancer
                 traffic to this service.
  Priority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: The priority for the routing rule added to the load balancer.
                 This only applies if your have multiple services which have been
                 assigned to different paths on the load balancer.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: How many copies of the service task to run
  Role:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: (Optional) An IAM role to give the service's containers if the code within needs to
                 access other AWS resources like S3 buckets, DynamoDB tables, etc

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [ !Equals [!Ref 'Role', ''] ]

Resources:
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    # Makes sure the log group is created before it is used.
    DependsOn: LogGroup
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
      Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'ECSTaskExecutionRole']]
      TaskRoleArn:
        Fn::If:
          - 'HasCustomRole'
          - !Ref 'Role'
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          Cpu: !Ref 'ContainerCpu'
          Memory: !Ref 'ContainerMemory'
          Image: !Ref 'ImageUrl'
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          # Send logs to CloudWatch Logs
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: LoadBalancerRule
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Cluster:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'ClusterName']]
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
      DesiredCount: !Ref 'DesiredCount'
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - Fn::ImportValue:
                !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'FargateContainerSecurityGroup']]
          Subnets:
            - Fn::ImportValue:
                !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'PublicSubnetOne']]
            - Fn::ImportValue:
                !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'PublicSubnetTwo']]
      TaskDefinition: !Ref 'TaskDefinition'
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: !Ref 'ServiceName'
          ContainerPort: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref 'TargetGroup'

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 6
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      TargetType: ip
      Name: !Ref 'ServiceName'
      Port: !Ref 'ContainerPort'
      Protocol: HTTP
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      VpcId:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'VPCId']]

  # Create a rule on the load balancer for routing traffic to the target group
  LoadBalancerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      Actions:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref 'TargetGroup'
          Type: 'forward'
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          Values: [!Ref 'Path']
      ListenerArn:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Join [':', [!Ref 'StackName', 'PublicListener']]
      Priority: !Ref 'Priority'

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Join ['', [/ecs/, !Ref ServiceName, TaskDefinition]]

cfn_description:
DNS and TLS certificate stack for Database Modernizer Assessment.
Creates a Route 53 hosted zone and ACM wildcard certificate
with DNS validation. Supports per-environment subdomains.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  DNS and TLS certificate stack for Database Modernizer Assessment.
  Creates a Route 53 hosted zone and ACM wildcard certificate
  with DNS validation. Supports per-environment subdomains.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name (e.g., dev, prod, or sanitized branch name)
    Default: dev

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Project identifier for resource naming
    Default: modernizer

  ParentDomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Parent domain (e.g., example.com)
    Default: example.com

  SubDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Subdomain prefix under the parent domain (e.g., modernizer)
    Default: modernizer

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # Route 53 Hosted Zone
  # ============================================================
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SubDomainPrefix}.${ParentDomainName}'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub '${ProjectName} ${Environment} - managed by CloudFormation'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ============================================================
  # ACM Wildcard Certificate
  # ============================================================
  WildcardCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '*.${SubDomainPrefix}.${ParentDomainName}'
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub '*.${SubDomainPrefix}.${ParentDomainName}'
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route 53 hosted zone ID
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedZoneId'

  HostedZoneNameServers:
    Description: NS records to add to parent zone for delegation
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NameServers'

  CertificateArn:
    Description: ACM wildcard certificate ARN for HTTPS
    Value: !Ref WildcardCertificate
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CertificateArn'

  DomainName:
    Description: Base domain name for this zone
    Value: !Sub '${SubDomainPrefix}.${ParentDomainName}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainName'

cfn_description: NetLicensing MCP Server — AWS App Runner deployment. Simplest option: auto-provisions HTTPS, scales to zero, no VPC required.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  NetLicensing MCP Server — AWS App Runner deployment.
  Simplest option: auto-provisions HTTPS, scales to zero, no VPC required.

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PARAMETERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Parameters:
  ImageUri:
    Type: String
    Default: ghcr.io/labs64/netlicensing-mcp:latest
    Description: >
      Container image URI. For GHCR images you must first push to ECR
      (App Runner only supports ECR and ECR Public natively).

  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.25 vCPU"
    AllowedValues: ["0.25 vCPU", "0.5 vCPU", "1 vCPU"]
    Description: Instance CPU

  Memory:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.5 GB"
    AllowedValues: ["0.5 GB", "1 GB", "2 GB"]
    Description: Instance memory

  MinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    Description: >
      Minimum number of instances. Set to 0 for scale-to-zero
      (first request has ~5 s cold start).

  MaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Maximum number of instances

  McpVerbose:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Enable verbose debug logging

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RESOURCES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Resources:

  # ── ECR Access Role (required for pulling from ECR / ECR Public) ───────

  AccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppRunnerServicePolicyForECRAccess

  # ── App Runner Service ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  McpService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: netlicensing-mcp
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt AccessRole.Arn
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: false
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Ref ImageUri
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: "8000"
            StartCommand: "http"
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: MCP_TRANSPORT
                Value: http
              - Name: MCP_HOST
                Value: "0.0.0.0"
              - Name: MCP_PORT
                Value: "8000"
              - Name: MCP_VERBOSE
                Value: !Ref McpVerbose
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: !Ref Cpu
        Memory: !Ref Memory
      AutoScalingConfigurationArn: !GetAtt AutoScaling.AutoScalingConfigurationArn
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /health
        Interval: 20
        Timeout: 5
        HealthyThreshold: 1
        UnhealthyThreshold: 3

  # ── Auto-Scaling (supports scale-to-zero) ──────────────────────────────

  AutoScaling:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::AutoScalingConfiguration
    Properties:
      AutoScalingConfigurationName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-scaling"
      MinSize: !Ref MinSize
      MaxSize: !Ref MaxSize
      MaxConcurrency: 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Outputs:
  ServiceUrl:
    Description: Public HTTPS URL (auto-provisioned by App Runner)
    Value: !Sub "https://${McpService.ServiceUrl}"

  McpEndpoint:
    Description: MCP streamable-http endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${McpService.ServiceUrl}/mcp"

  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: Health check URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${McpService.ServiceUrl}/health"

  ServiceArn:
    Description: App Runner service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt McpService.ServiceArn

cfn_description: Maths MCP Server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito Authentication
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0004", "severity": "LOW", "title": "No unauthorized access to API Gateway methods", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Authorization is not enabled for this method.", "resolution": "Use and authorization method or require API Key", "resource": "MCPApiOptionsMethod", "query": "data.builtin.aws.apigateway.aws0004.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpvjuna8k7.yaml:89-104", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Maths MCP Server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito Authentication'

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: 'dev'
    Description: 'API Gateway deployment stage'
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'maths-mcp-users'
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool name'
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'maths-mcp-client'
    Description: 'Cognito App Client name'

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ADMIN_NO_SRP_AUTH
        - USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-mcp-server'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-mcp-server:*'

  # Lambda Function
  MCPLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-server'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: lambda_function.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Placeholder - will be updated'}
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PYTHONPATH: /var/task

  # API Gateway
  MCPApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-api'
      Description: 'Maths MCP Server API Gateway with Cognito Authentication'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # Cognito Authorizer
  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref MCPApiGateway
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  # API Gateway Resources and Methods
  MCPApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MCPApiGateway
      ParentId: !GetAtt MCPApiGateway.RootResourceId
      PathPart: 'mcp'

  MCPApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MCPApiGateway
      ResourceId: !Ref MCPApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MCPLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MCPApiOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MCPApiGateway
      ResourceId: !Ref MCPApiResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # Health check endpoint (no auth required)
  MCPApiRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MCPApiGateway
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MCPApiGateway.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MCPLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # Lambda permissions
  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MCPLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MCPApiGateway}/*/*'

  # API Gateway Deployment
  MCPApiDeployment:
