cfn_description: GitHub Actions → AWS via OIDC. Lets a named repository's workflows assume a role and push to ECR without a long-lived access key living in GitHub secrets.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  GitHub Actions → AWS via OIDC. Lets a named repository's workflows assume a role
  and push to ECR without a long-lived access key living in GitHub secrets.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, production]

  GitHubOwner:
    Type: String
    Default: Andre-Mygentic

  # ONE REPOSITORY, AND THE TRUST POLICY SAYS SO.
  #
  # The tempting shape is `repo:owner/*:*`, which trusts every repository the
  # owner has or will ever have — including a fork someone opens a PR from. The
  # condition below pins the repo AND the ref, so a workflow on a branch of a
  # different repo cannot assume this role even though it presents a token from
  # the same issuer.
  GitHubRepo:
    Type: String
    Default: cello-ops-dashboard

  # THE CLAIM CARRIES IMMUTABLE NUMERIC IDS, and nothing in GitHub's own
  # documentation of the `sub` format shows them. Observed in CloudTrail after
  # two failed deploys:
  #   repo:Andre-Mygentic@186459211/cello-ops-dashboard@1312030261:ref:refs/heads/main
  # The IDs sit INSIDE the owner and repo segments, so neither
  # `repo:owner/repo:ref:refs/heads/main` nor even `repo:owner/repo:*` matches.
  #
  # Pinning the IDs is STRONGER than pinning the names: a repository rename
  # changes the name and keeps the ID, and a different account cannot mint the
  # same one. The names stay in the parameters for readability.
  GitHubOwnerId:
    Type: String
    Default: "186459211"

  GitHubRepoId:
    Type: String
    Default: "1312030261"

Resources:
  # Created here rather than assumed to exist. The account had NO GitHub OIDC
  # provider (only accounts.google.com) when this was written — checked, not
  # guessed.
  GitHubOidcProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Url: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      ClientIdList:
        - sts.amazonaws.com
      # GitHub's root CA thumbprint. IAM no longer verifies this for the GitHub
      # issuer, but the field is still required; the value is the documented one.
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello

  EcrPushRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-github-${GitHubRepo}-ecr-push"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Ref GitHubOidcProvider
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud: sts.amazonaws.com
              StringLike:
                # One repository, identified by IDs, any ref within it. See the
                # note on GitHubOwnerId for why the documented form does not work.
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub: !Sub "repo:${GitHubOwner}@${GitHubOwnerId}/${GitHubRepo}@${GitHubRepoId}:*"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PushToOwnRepository
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              # The auth token is account-wide by API design and cannot be
              # resource-scoped. Every action that CAN be scoped, is — this role
              # can push to exactly one repository and read nothing else.
              - Sid: GetAuthToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: PushToOneRepo
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${GitHubRepo}"

Outputs:
  EcrPushRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt EcrPushRole.Arn
    Description: Pass to aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials as role-to-assume.

cfn_description: CELLO Operator Portal — data layer (M8). The portal's OWN Postgres (never the sovereign directory DB — DOD-INV-2 / SCAFFOLD-002), security groups, and the ACM certificate for the public portal hostnam
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0133", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Enable Performance Insights to detect potential problems", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Instance does not have performance insights enabled.", "resolution": "Enable performance insights", "resource": "tmp_io7xj7g.yaml:100-125", "query": "data.builtin.aws.rds.aws0133.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0176", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "RDS IAM Database Authentication Disabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Instance does not have IAM Authentication enabled", "resolution": "Modify the PostgreSQL and MySQL type RDS instances to enable IAM database authentication.", "resource": "tmp_io7xj7g.yaml:100-125", "query": "data.builtin.aws.rds.aws0176.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0177", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "RDS Deletion Protection Disabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Instance does not have Deletion Protection enabled", "resolution": "Modify the RDS instances to enable deletion protection.", "resource": "PortalDb", "query": "data.builtin.aws.rds.aws0177.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CELLO Operator Portal — data layer (M8). The portal's OWN Postgres (never the sovereign
  directory DB — DOD-INV-2 / SCAFFOLD-002), security groups, and the ACM certificate for the
  public portal hostname. Lives in the directory's VPC (us-east-1) reusing its private subnets.
  Separate from the app stack so the RDS endpoint + managed master secret exist before the
  PORTAL_DATABASE_URL secret is assembled and the ECS service references it.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, production]
  PortalHostname:
    Type: String
    Default: portal.cello.mygentic.ai
  HostedZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z02692523DOH7NW521CL8
    Description: Route53 hosted zone for cello.mygentic.ai (DNS validation of the ACM cert).
  DbInstanceClass:
    Type: String
    Default: db.t4g.micro

Resources:
  # ─── Security groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PortalAlbSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Portal public ALB - HTTP/HTTPS from the internet
      VpcId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "cello-${Environment}-vpc-id"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP (redirected to HTTPS)
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cello-portal-alb-${Environment}"

  PortalTaskSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Portal ECS task - Next.js on 3000, egress to RDS / directory ALB / SES
      VpcId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "cello-${Environment}-vpc-id"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3000
          ToPort: 3000
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PortalAlbSg
          Description: Next.js from the portal ALB
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cello-portal-task-${Environment}"

  PortalDbSg:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Portal RDS - Postgres 5432 from the portal task only
      VpcId: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: "cello-${Environment}-vpc-id"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PortalTaskSg
          Description: Postgres from the portal task
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cello-portal-db-${Environment}"

  # ─── RDS Postgres (the portal's own DB) ───────────────────────────────────────
  PortalDbSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Portal RDS subnet group (directory private subnets)
      SubnetIds:
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "cello-${Environment}-private-subnet-a"
        - !ImportValue
          Fn::Sub: "cello-${Environment}-private-subnet-b"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello

  PortalDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub "cello-portal-${Environment}"
      Engine: postgres
      DBInstanceClass: !Ref DbInstanceClass
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBName: cello_portal
      MasterUsername: portal_admin
      # RDS creates + manages the master credential secret ({username,password}); no password
      # ever appears in this template or in any task definition.
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref PortalDbSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref PortalDbSg
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello

  # ─── ACM certificate for the public portal hostname (DNS-validated) ───────────
  PortalCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref PortalHostname
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Ref PortalHostname
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: cello

Outputs:
  PortalDbEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt PortalDb.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-db-endpoint"
  PortalDbPort:
    Value: !GetAtt PortalDb.Endpoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-db-port"
  PortalDbMasterSecretArn:
    Value: !GetAtt PortalDb.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-db-master-secret-arn"
  PortalAlbSgId:
    Value: !Ref PortalAlbSg
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-alb-sg"
  PortalTaskSgId:
    Value: !Ref PortalTaskSg
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-task-sg"
  # Exported so another stack can grant itself 5432 to THIS database. Without
  # it the only DB security group reachable by cross-stack reference is the
  # directory's (cello-${env}-rds-sg from cello-vpc.yaml), and a stack that
  # needs the portal DB will reach for that one and appear to work — which is
  # exactly what happened to cello-waitlist.yaml on its first draft.
  PortalDbSgId:
    Value: !Ref PortalDbSg
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-db-sg"
  PortalCertificateArn:
    Value: !Ref PortalCertificate
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "cello-${Environment}-portal-cert-arn"

---
Resources:
  Certificate1:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: example.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: BadCertificateExample
        - Key: ProjectPart
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: ProjectPartDetail
          Value: Certificate1
  Certificate2:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: example.com
      Tags:
        - Key: foo
          Value: bar
        - Key: Project
          Value: BadCertificateExample
        - Key: ProjectPart
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: ProjectPartDetail
          Value: Certificate2

cfn_description: SO9250 Guidance for Natural Language Queries of Relational Databases on AWS - ECS for Bedrock stack template.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: "SO9250 Guidance for Natural Language Queries of Relational Databases on AWS - ECS for Bedrock stack template."
Parameters:
  BedrockModelName:
    Type: String
    Default: "amazon.titan-text-express-v1"
    Description: The Bedrock Model.

  ECRImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: "stable"
    Description: The name of the ECR Image tag to use with ECS/Fargate.

  TaskName:
    Type: String
    Default: "nlq-genai"
    Description: The name of the ECS Task and Fargate Service.

  ProjectTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "Natural Language Queries of Relational Databases on AWS"
    Description: The Project Tag value applied to all resources.

Resources:
  ECSTaskDefinitionBedrock:
    Type: "AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition"
    Properties:
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Environment:
            - Name: "REGION_NAME"
              Value: !Ref AWS::Region
            - Name: "MODEL_NAME"
              Value: !Ref BedrockModelName
            # - Name: "TEMPERATURE"
            #   Value: !Ref BedrockModelTemperature
            # - Name: "MAX_TOKENS_TO_SAMPLE"
            #   Value: !Ref BedrockModelMaxTokensToSample
            # - Name: "TOP_K"
            #   Value: !Ref BedrockModelTopK
            # - Name: "TOP_P"
            #   Value: !Ref BedrockModelTopP
            # - Name: "STOP_SEQUENCES"
            #   Value: !Ref BedrockModelStopSequences
            # - Name: "BASE_AVATAR_URL"
            #   Value: !Ref BaseAvatarUrl
            # - Name: "HUGGING_FACE_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL"
            #   Value: !Ref HuggingFaceEmbeddingsModel
          Essential: true
          Image: !Sub "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/ECRRepositoryUri}}:${ECRImageTag}"
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: "awslogs"
            Options:
              awslogs-create-group: "true"
              awslogs-group: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/ECSLogGroupName}}"
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: "ecs"
          Name: !Ref TaskName
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/NLQAppPort}}"
              HostPort: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/NLQAppPort}}"
              Protocol: "tcp"
      Family: !Ref TaskName
      TaskRoleArn: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn}}"
      ExecutionRoleArn: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn}}"
      NetworkMode: "awsvpc"
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - "FARGATE"
      Cpu: "1024"
      Memory: "3072"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectTagValue

  ECSServiceBedrock:
    Type: "AWS::ECS::Service"
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref TaskName
      Cluster: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/ECSClusterArn}}"
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/TargetGroupTargetGroupArn}}"
          ContainerName: !Ref TaskName
          ContainerPort: "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/NLQAppPort}}"
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: "FARGATE"
      PlatformVersion: "LATEST"
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinitionBedrock
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: "ENABLED"
          SecurityGroups:
            - "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/ECSSecurityGroupGroupId}}"
            - "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/VPCDefaultSecurityGroup}}"
          Subnets:
            - "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/PublicSubnet1SubnetId}}"
            - "{{resolve:ssm:/nlq/PublicSubnet2SubnetId}}"
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      SchedulingStrategy: "REPLICA"
      DeploymentController:
        Type: "ECS"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Project"
          Value: !Ref ProjectTagValue

cfn_description: SQS queues for audit events
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: SQS queues for audit events
Transform: AWS::LanguageExtensions

Parameters:
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  Environment:
    Description: The target environment
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, build, staging, integration, production]
    ConstraintDescription: must be dev, build, staging, integration or production
  SupportManualURL:
    Description: "Link to the CRI specific support manual"
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://govukverify.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OJ/pages/3303931965/CRI+specific+support'
  ServiceName:
    Description: Provide a service name to enable naming convention patterns
    Type: String
    Default: "none"
  BuildNotificationStackName:
    Description: The topic to publish notification and sns alerts
    Type: String
    Default: "none"

Conditions:
  IsDevEnvironment: !Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]
  IsLocalDevEnvironment: !Equals [ !Ref Environment, localdev ]
  IsNotDevEnvironment: !Not [!Condition IsDevEnvironment]
  IsDevLikeEnvironment:
    !Or [ !Condition IsLocalDevEnvironment, !Condition IsDevEnvironment ]
  IsNotDevLikeEnvironment: !Not
    - !Condition IsDevLikeEnvironment
  UsePermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, ""]]

Mappings:
  TxMARootMapping:
    Environment:
      build: "arn:aws:iam::178023842775:root"
      staging: "arn:aws:iam::178023842775:root"
      integration: "arn:aws:iam::729485541398:root"
      production: "arn:aws:iam::451773080033:root"

Resources:
  AuditEventQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If [IsDevEnvironment, "3600", "1209600"] # 1 hour in dev, 14 days otherwise
      VisibilityTimeout: !If [IsDevEnvironment, "30", "70"]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyAlias
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: denyAll
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsDevEnvironment
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventDeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 10
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: ci/cd
        - Key: Source
          Value: govuk-one-login/ipv-cri-common-infrastructure/txma/template.yaml

  AuditEventQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Condition: IsNotDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      Queues: [!Ref AuditEventQueue]
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow read by TxMA account"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !FindInMap [TxMARootMapping, Environment, !Ref Environment]
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.Arn
          - Sid: "Allow EventBridge to send TxMA events"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.Arn

  AuditEventDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600 # 14 days
      VisibilityTimeout: 70
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Service
          Value: ci/cd
        - Key: Source
          Value: govuk-one-login/ipv-cri-common-infrastructure/txma/template.yaml

  AuditEventDeadLetterQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Condition: IsNotDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      Queues: [!Ref AuditEventDeadLetterQueue]
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow EventBridge to send TxMA events"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "events.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sqs:SendMessage"
            Resource: !GetAtt AuditEventDeadLetterQueue.Arn

  AuditEventQueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Symmetric key used to encrypt audit messages at rest in SQS
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable root access"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - IsDevEnvironment
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - Sid: "Allow decryption of events by TXMA"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !FindInMap [TxMARootMapping, Environment, !Ref 'Environment']
              Action: kms:decrypt
              Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - IsDevEnvironment
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - Sid: "Allow EventBridge to generate data key and decrypt"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: events.amazonaws.com
              Action:
                - kms:decrypt
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
              Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-auditEventQueueEncryptionKey
        - Key: Service
          Value: ci/cd
        - Key: Source
          Value: govuk-one-login/ipv-cri-common-infrastructure/txma/template.yaml

  AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}/auditEventQueueEncryptionKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventQueueEncryptionKey

  AuditEventQueueConsumerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsNotDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      Description: >
        A role to use in the SQS queue and KMS key policies. To be overridden in envs other than dev and build with
        supplied TXMA roles when they exist.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [UsePermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-auditEventQueueConsumerRole
        - Key: Service
          Value: ci/cd
        - Key: Source
          Value: govuk-one-login/ipv-cri-common-infrastructure/txma/template.yaml

  AuditEventSQSOldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDevLikeEnvironment
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventStayedOnQueueForMoreThan24HoursMessagesAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Triggers CloudWatch Alarm when a message has stayed on the queue for more than 24 Hours ${SupportManualURL}"
      ActionsEnabled: true
      OKActions:
        - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${BuildNotificationStackName}-WarningAlertsTopicArn"
      AlarmActions:
        - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${BuildNotificationStackName}-WarningAlertsTopicArn"
      InsufficientDataActions: [ ]
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.QueueName
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 86400
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  AuditEventDLQMessagesVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDevLikeEnvironment
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventDLQMessagesVisibleAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Triggers CloudWatch Alarm when message gets added to audit event DLQ. ${SupportManualURL}"
      ActionsEnabled: true
      OKActions:
        - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${BuildNotificationStackName}-WarningAlertsTopicArn"
      AlarmActions:
        - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub "${BuildNotificationStackName}-WarningAlertsTopicArn"
      InsufficientDataActions: [ ]
      Metrics:
        - Expression: "max-min"
          Id: "e1"
          Label: "ChangeInAmountOfVisibleMessages"
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: "min"
          Label: "MessagesVisibleMin"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt AuditEventDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
            Period: 300 # evaluate maximum over period of 5 min
            Stat: Minimum
            Unit: Count
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: "max"
          Label: "MessagesVisibleMax"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt AuditEventDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
            Period: 300 # evaluate maximum over period of 5 min
            Stat: Maximum
            Unit: Count
          ReturnData: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  AuditEventQueueName:
    Description: The name of the SQS audit event queue. Needed to give write permissions to lambdas
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.QueueName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventQueueName

  AuditEventQueueNameToRemove:
    Description: The name of the SQS audit event queue. Needed to give write permissions to lambdas
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.QueueName
    Export:
      Name: AuditEventQueueName

  AuditEventQueueUrl:
    Description: The URL of the SQS audit event queue. Needed to write messages to the queue
    Value: !Ref AuditEventQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventQueueUrl

  AuditEventQueueUrlToRemove:
    Description: The URL of the SQS audit event queue. Needed to write messages to the queue
    Value: !Ref AuditEventQueue
    Export:
      Name: AuditEventQueueUrl

  AuditEventQueueArn:
    Description: The ARN of the SQS audit event queue. Needed to pull messages off the queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventQueueArn

  AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt audit event messages in the SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueueEncryptionKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyArn

  AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyArnToRemove:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt audit event messages in the SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventQueueEncryptionKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: AuditEventQueueEncryptionKeyArn

  AuditEventDLQArn:
    Condition: IsNotDevEnvironment
    Description: The ARN of the audit event SQS queue DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventDeadLetterQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventDLQArn

cfn_description: WAF WebACL for CloudFront - Must be deployed in us-east-1
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'WAF WebACL for CloudFront - Must be deployed in us-east-1'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: spree-production
    Description: Environment name prefix

Resources:
  # ==================== WAF (Web Application Firewall) ====================
  WAFWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-waf
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Description: WAF rules for Spree Commerce CloudFront distribution
      Rules:
        # AWS Managed Rule - Core Rule Set (CRS) with admin path exclusion
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
              ScopeDownStatement:
                NotStatement:
                  Statement:
                    ByteMatchStatement:
                      SearchString: /admin
                      FieldToMatch:
                        UriPath: {}
                      TextTransformations:
                        - Priority: 0
                          Type: NONE
                      PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSetMetric

        # AWS Managed Rule - Known Bad Inputs with admin path exclusion
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
              ScopeDownStatement:
                NotStatement:
                  Statement:
                    ByteMatchStatement:
                      SearchString: /admin
                      FieldToMatch:
                        UriPath: {}
                      TextTransformations:
                        - Priority: 0
                          Type: NONE
                      PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSetMetric

        # AWS Managed Rule - SQL Injection with admin path exclusion
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          Priority: 3
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
              ScopeDownStatement:
                NotStatement:
                  Statement:
                    ByteMatchStatement:
                      SearchString: /admin
                      FieldToMatch:
                        UriPath: {}
                      TextTransformations:
                        - Priority: 0
                          Type: NONE
                      PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSetMetric

        # AWS Managed Rule - Linux Operating System
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet
          Priority: 4
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet
              ExcludedRules: []
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSetMetric

        # Rate limiting rule - Prevent brute force attacks
        - Name: RateLimitRule
          Priority: 5
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitRuleMetric

        # Block common bot user agents (allow legitimate bots like Googlebot)
        - Name: BlockMaliciousBots
          Priority: 6
          Statement:
            AndStatement:
              Statements:
                - ByteMatchStatement:
                    SearchString: bot
                    FieldToMatch:
                      SingleHeader:
                        Name: user-agent
                    TextTransformations:
                      - Priority: 0
                        Type: LOWERCASE
                    PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                - NotStatement:
                    Statement:
                      OrStatement:
                        Statements:
                          - ByteMatchStatement:
                              SearchString: googlebot
                              FieldToMatch:
                                SingleHeader:
                                  Name: user-agent
                              TextTransformations:
                                - Priority: 0
                                  Type: LOWERCASE
                              PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                          - ByteMatchStatement:
                              SearchString: bingbot
                              FieldToMatch:
                                SingleHeader:
                                  Name: user-agent
                              TextTransformations:
                                - Priority: 0
                                  Type: LOWERCASE
                              PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: BlockMaliciousBotsMetric

      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-waf-metric
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-WAF-CloudFront
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  WAFWebACLId:

cfn_description: DiamonDB app stack
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0017", "severity": "LOW", "title": "CloudWatch log groups should be encrypted using CMK", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Log group is not encrypted.", "resolution": "Enable CMK encryption of CloudWatch Log Groups", "resource": "tmp_40vk2an.yaml:31-35", "query": "data.builtin.aws.cloudwatch.aws0017.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: DiamonDB app stack
Parameters:
  RedisClusterAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: "diamondb-dummy.cache.amazonaws.com"
  RedisClusterPort:
    Type: String
    Default: "6379"
Resources:
  ALB:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-refarch-cloudformation/infrastructure/load-balancers.yaml
      Parameters:
        EnvironmentName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        VPC: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-VPCID
        Subnets: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-PublicSubnets
        SecurityGroup: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
  ECS:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-refarch-cloudformation/infrastructure/ecs-cluster.yaml
      Parameters:
        EnvironmentName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        InstanceType: t2.micro
        ClusterSize: 2
        VPC: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-VPCID
        SecurityGroup: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-ECSHostSecurityGroup
        Subnets: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-PrivateSubnets
  CloudWatchLogsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      RetentionInDays: 30
  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: ECSListenerRule
    Properties:
      Cluster: !GetAtt ECS.Outputs.Cluster
      DesiredCount: 1
      LoadBalancers:
      - ContainerName: diamondb-app
        ContainerPort: 8000
        TargetGroupArn: !Ref 'ECSTargetGroup'
      Role: !Ref 'ECSServiceRole'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref 'TaskDefinition'
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Join ['', [!Ref 'AWS::StackName', -app]]
      ContainerDefinitions:
      - Name: diamondb-app
        Cpu: '2'
        Essential: 'true'
        Image: yuuk1/diamondb:latest
        Memory: '300'
        LogConfiguration:
          LogDriver: awslogs
          Options:
            awslogs-group: !Ref 'CloudWatchLogsGroup'
            awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
            awslogs-stream-prefix: diamondb-app
        PortMappings:
          - ContainerPort: 8000
        Environment:
          - Name: DIAMONDB_REDIS_ADDRS
            Value: !Sub
              - ${Address}:${Port}
              - { Address: !Ref RedisClusterAddress, Port: !Ref RedisClusterPort }
          - Name: DIAMONDB_ENABLE_REDIS_CLUSTER
            Value: 1
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
  ECSTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !ImportValue diamondb-infrastructure-VPCID
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: 200-299
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 10
      HealthCheckPath: /ping
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
  ECSListenerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      ListenerArn: !GetAtt ALB.Outputs.Listener
      Priority: 2
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          Values:
            - /*
      Actions:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref ECSTargetGroup
          Type: forward
  ECSServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ecs-service-${AWS::StackName}
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: |
        {
          "Statement": [{
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": { "Service": [ "ecs.amazonaws.com" ]},
            "Action": [ "sts:AssumeRole" ]
          }]
        }
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ecs-service-${AWS::StackName}
          PolicyDocument:
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [{
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": [
                  "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
                  "ec2:Describe*",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth",
                  "elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets"
                ],
                "Resource": "*"
              }]
            }
  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ecs-app-${AWS::StackName}
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: |
        {
          "Statement": [{
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": { "Service": [ "ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com" ]},
            "Action": [ "sts:AssumeRole" ]
          }]
        }
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ecs-app-${AWS::StackName}
          PolicyDocument:
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [{
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": [
                  "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
                  "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem",
                  "dynamodb:CreateTable",
                  "dynamodb:DeleteItem",
                  "dynamodb:DescribeTable",
                  "dynamodb:GetItem",
                  "dynamodb:PutItem",
                  "dynamodb:Query",
                  "dynamodb:Scan",
                  "dynamodb:UpdateItem",
                  "dynamodb:UpdateTimeToLive",
                  "dynamodb:DescribeLimits",
                  "s3:GetObject",
                  "s3:ListBucket",
                  "s3:PutObject"
                ],
                "Resource": "*"
              }]
            }
Outputs:
  DiamonDBUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt ALB.Outputs.LoadBalancerUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DiamonDBUrl"

---
Parameters:

  Name:
    Description: The primary name to identify this deployment and associated resources (including mesh name)
    Type: String
    Default: demo

  VirtualRouterName:
    Description: Target virtual router name
    Type: String
    Default: colorteller-vr

  RouteName:
    Description: Target route name
    Type: String
    Default: color-route

  MatchPrefix:
    Description: HttpRoute prefix to match
    Type: String
    Default: /

  BlueWeight:
    Description: blue virtual node route weight
    Type: Number
    Default: 1

  GreenWeight:
    Description: green virtual node route weight
    Type: Number
    Default: 1

  RedWeight:
    Description: red virtual node route weight
    Type: Number
    Default: 1

Resources:
  ColorRoute:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Name
      RouteName: !Ref RouteName
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:
              - VirtualNode: blue-vn
                Weight: !Ref BlueWeight
              - VirtualNode: green-vn
                Weight: !Ref GreenWeight
              - VirtualNode: red-vn
                Weight: !Ref RedWeight
          Match:
            Prefix: !Ref MatchPrefix
      VirtualRouterName: !Ref VirtualRouterName

content:
Description: >
    This template deploys the security group for remote worker access
Parameters:
    EnvironmentName:
        Description: An environment name that will be prefixed to resource names
        Default: dev
        AllowedValues:
            - dev
            - qa
            - prod
        Type: String

Resources:
  RemoteWorkersGroupName:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-remote-workers-sg"
      GroupDescription: Enable SSH access via port 22
      VpcId:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 126.218.240.84/32
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8500
          ToPort: 8500
          CidrIp: 126.218.240.84/32
      Tags:
        - Key: purpose
          Value: Allow remote workers ssh access

Outputs:
  RemoteWorkersSG:
    Description: Remote workers security group
    Value: !Ref RemoteWorkersGroupName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-RemoteWorkersSG

cfn_description: NDT Manage account policy
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: NDT Manage account policy
Parameters:
  paramManagedAccount:
    Description: Account to manage
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  paramManageRole:
    Description: Role to assume in the target account
    Type: String
    Default: ""
Resources:
  AllowManagePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName:
        !Sub "AllowAssumeManageRoleFor${paramManagedAccount}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: assumeManageRole
          Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - 'sts:AssumeRole'
          Resource:
            - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${paramManagedAccount}:role/${paramManageRole}"
Outputs:
  ManagePolicy:
    Value: !Ref AllowManagePolicy
    Export:
      Name:
        Fn::Join: [":", [{Ref: "AWS::StackName"}, ManagePolicy]]
  ManageRole:
    Value: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${paramManagedAccount}:role/${paramManageRole}"
    Export:
      Name:
        Fn::Join: [":", [{Ref: "AWS::StackName"}, ManageRole]]

cfn_description: Amazon Route53 Application Recovery Controller cluster and routing control for the DynamoDB five-9s app
content:
# Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0

# This template demonstrates how to configure Amazon Route53 Application Recovery Controller Routing Controls
#
# ***************************************************
# RUNNING THIS TEMPLATE COSTS $60/day ($2.5/hour)
# BE SURE TO DELETE THIS STACK WHEN NO LONGER NEEDED
# ***************************************************
#
# For a full description of how it works, please read
# https://aws.amazon.com/fr/blogs/aws/amazon-route-53-application-recovery-controller/
#

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Amazon Route53 Application Recovery Controller cluster and routing control for the DynamoDB five-9s app'
Parameters:
  Region1:
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: The region for the first cell
    Type: String

  Region2:
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: The region for the second cell
    Type: String

  ProjectId:
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric
      characters.
    Default: Dynamo59
    Description: The name of the project
    MaxLength: '64'
    MinLength: '1'
    Type: String

Resources:

#
# The Application Recovery Controller cluster
#

  Cluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectId}-Cluster

#
# The Application Recovery Controller control panel
#

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectId}-ControlPanel
      ClusterArn: !Ref Cluster

#
# The Application Recovery Controller routing controls
#

  RoutingControlCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}
      ClusterArn: !Ref Cluster
      ControlPanelArn: !Ref ControlPanel

  RoutingControlCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}
      ClusterArn: !Ref Cluster
      ControlPanelArn: !Ref ControlPanel

#
# The Application Recovery Controller safety rules
#

  SafetyRuleMinCellsActive:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectId}-MinCellsActive
      ControlPanelArn: !Ref ControlPanel
      AssertionRule:
        WaitPeriodMs: 5000
        AssertedControls:
          - !Ref RoutingControlCell1
          - !Ref RoutingControlCell2
      RuleConfig:
        Type: ATLEAST
        Threshold: 1
        Inverted: false

#
# The Application Recovery Controller healthchecks
#

  HealthCheckCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: "RECOVERY_CONTROL"
        RoutingControlArn: !Ref RoutingControlCell1

  HealthCheckCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: "RECOVERY_CONTROL"
        RoutingControlArn: !Ref RoutingControlCell2

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Value: !Ref Cluster

  ControlPanelArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  HealthCheckIdEast:
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell1

  HealthCheckIdWest:
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell2

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: An Policy Store with a scehma definition for ID Token and Access Token with CyberArk Identity

Resources:
  IDTokenAVPPolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      Description: "ID Token Policy Store - Created by CloudFormation Template"
      Schema:
        CedarJson: '{"NAMESPACE":{"entityTypes":{"Application":{"memberOfTypes":[],"shape":{"type":"Record","attributes":{}}},"Role":{"shape":{"attributes":{},"type":"Record"},"memberOfTypes":[]},"User":{"shape":{"attributes":{"phone_number_verified":{"type":"Boolean"},"phone_number":{"type":"String"},"project_list":{"type":"Set","required":true,"element":{"type":"String"}},"name":{"required":true,"type":"String"},"email":{"type":"String"},"session_config_json":{"type":"session_config_json_type","required":true},"app_id":{"type":"String","required":true},"email_verified":{"type":"Boolean"},"session_time_long":{"required":true,"type":"Long"},"family_name":{"type":"String","required":true}},"type":"Record"},"memberOfTypes":["Role"]}},"actions":{"View":{"appliesTo":{"principalTypes":["User"],"resourceTypes":["Application"],"context":{"type":"Record","attributes":{}}},"memberOf":[]}},"commonTypes":{"session_config_json_type":{"type":"Record","attributes":{"session_idle":{"required":true,"type":"Long"},"timeout":{"required":true,"type":"Long"}}}}}}'
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: "STRICT"

  IDTokenAVPPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
        Definition:
          Static:
            Description: Example authorization policy based on the day of the week, user department and project
            Statement: 'permit (
                            principal in NAMESPACE::Role::"System Administrator",
                            action in [NAMESPACE::Action::"View"],
                            resource
                        )
                        when
                        {
                            principal has app_id &&
                            principal.app_id == "AVPCyberArk" &&
                            principal has name &&
                            principal.name like "Prata*" &&
                            principal.session_time_long > 100000 &&
                            principal.session_config_json.session_idle > 20
                        };'
        PolicyStoreId: !Ref IDTokenAVPPolicyStore
    DependsOn:
    - IDTokenAVPPolicyStore

  AccessTokenAVPPolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      Description: "Access Token Policy Store - Created by CloudFormation Template"
      Schema:
        CedarJson: '{"NAMESPACE":{"entityTypes":{"Role":{"shape":{"attributes":{},"type":"Record"},"memberOfTypes":[]},"User":{"shape":{"type":"Record","attributes":{"phone_number_verified":{"type":"Boolean"},"phone_number":{"type":"String"},"family_name":{"type":"String","required":true},"name":{"type":"String","required":true},"app_id":{"type":"String","required":true},"email_verified":{"type":"Boolean"},"email":{"type":"String"}}},"memberOfTypes":["Role"]},"Application":{"memberOfTypes":[],"shape":{"type":"Record","attributes":{}}}},"commonTypes":{"ReusedContext":{"type":"Record","attributes":{"token":{"attributes":{"auth_time":{"type":"Long"},"project_list":{"type":"Set","element":{"type":"String"}},"app_id":{"type":"String"},"unique_name":{"type":"String"}},"type":"Record"}}}},"actions":{"View":{"appliesTo":{"context":{"attributes":{},"type":"ReusedContext"},"resourceTypes":["Application"],"principalTypes":["User"]},"memberOf":[]}}}}'
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: "STRICT"

  AccessTokenAVPPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Example authorization policy based on the day of the week, user department and project
          Statement: 'permit (
                          principal in NAMESPACE::Role::"System Administrator",
                          action in [NAMESPACE::Action::"View"],
                          resource
                      )
                      when
                      {
                          context has token &&
                          context.token has app_id &&
                          context.token.app_id == "AVPCyberArk" &&
                          context.token has auth_time &&
                          context.token.auth_time > 100000 &&
                          context.token has project_list &&
                          context.token.project_list.contains("Lion")
                      };'
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref AccessTokenAVPPolicyStore
    DependsOn:
      - AccessTokenAVPPolicyStore

Outputs:

  IdTokenPolicyStore:
    Description: ID Token Policy Store
    Value: !Ref IDTokenAVPPolicyStore

  AccessTokenPolicyStore:
    Description: Access Token Policy Store
    Value: !Ref AccessTokenAVPPolicyStore

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Helper resources for Auto Insurance Fraud Detection'

Resources:
  S3PrefixListLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PrefixListLookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribePrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  S3PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt S3PrefixListLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: 1
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          def handler(event, context):
              if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                  return
              try:
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                  region = event['ResourceProperties']['Region']
                  resp = ec2.describe_prefix_lists(Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [f'com.amazonaws.{region}.s3']}])
                  prefix_list_id = resp['PrefixLists'][0]['PrefixListId']
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'PrefixListId': prefix_list_id})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  S3PrefixListLookup:
    Type: Custom::S3PrefixListLookup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt S3PrefixListLookupFunction.Arn
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

Outputs:
  S3PrefixListId:
    Value: !GetAtt S3PrefixListLookup.PrefixListId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-S3PrefixListId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  FSx for ONTAP Content-Level PII Classification Scanner (CSF 2.0 Identify).
  Scans files via an S3 Access Point using Amazon Comprehend
  DetectPiiEntities. QUICK START: leave VpcId empty to deploy outside any
  VPC — this is the simplest path and requires only an internet-origin S3
  Access Point (check with `aws s3control get-access-point --account-id
  <id> --name <ap-name> --query NetworkOrigin`; "Internet" works with the
  default parameters below, "VPC" requires setting VpcId/SubnetIds/
  SecurityGroupId/RouteTableIds to the VPC the access point is bound to).
  No FSx control-plane API calls are made by this stack, so it has no
  dependency on any FSx Interface VPC Endpoint even when VpcId is set.
  Stack name pattern: fsxn-content-classification

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      VPC ID to run the scanner Lambda inside. Leave empty (default) to
      deploy outside any VPC — the simplest path, and the only requirement
      is that the access_point_arn you invoke with is an Internet-origin
      S3 Access Point (verify with `aws s3control get-access-point
      --account-id <account-id> --name <ap-name> --query NetworkOrigin`).
      Set this ONLY if the access_point_arn you plan to scan is VPC-scoped
      (NetworkOrigin=VPC, e.g., one created by restore-verification.yaml's
      AttachAccessPoint step) — a VPC-scoped access point has no route from
      outside its bound VPC, so the Lambda must run inside that same VPC.
      When set, also set SubnetIds/SecurityGroupId/RouteTableIds below to
      match that VPC.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17})?$'

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Private subnet IDs for the scanner Lambda. Required if VpcId is set;
      ignored otherwise. Leave as the default single empty-string entry
      when VpcId is empty.
    Default: ''

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Security Group ID for the scanner Lambda (egress to VPC Endpoints).
      Required if VpcId is set; ignored otherwise.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17})?$'

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Route table IDs associated with SubnetIds. Used to attach the S3 and
      DynamoDB Gateway VPC Endpoints the scanner needs when running inside
      a VPC. Required if VpcId is set and CreateVpcEndpoints=true; ignored
      otherwise.
    Default: ''

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      When VpcId is set, create VPC Endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB (Gateway)
      plus Comprehend and SNS (Interface) so the in-VPC scanner Lambda can
      reach the access point, report table, PII detection API, and
      notifications. Set to 'false' if your VPC already has all four —
      check first with `aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters
      Name=vpc-id,Values=<your-vpc-id>` (a second Interface Endpoint for a
      service that already has one fails with a PrivateDnsEnabled conflict
      and rolls back this whole stack). If reusing restore-verification.
      yaml's VPC: that stack creates Secrets Manager/STS/FSx/S3-Gateway
      endpoints, none of which overlap with this stack's Comprehend/
      DynamoDB/SNS/S3-Gateway set except S3 — if that stack's
      CreateS3GatewayEndpoint was 'true', check for that existing S3
      Gateway Endpoint before setting this to 'true' (a second S3 Gateway
      Endpoint bound to the same route tables is rejected as a duplicate).
      Ignored if VpcId is empty.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Description: Lambda memory size in MB for the scanner function
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048]

  LambdaTimeoutSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: >-
      Lambda timeout in seconds. Scanning many/large files against
      Comprehend can take time — size this to your expected file count.
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 900

  DefaultLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Description: Default Amazon Comprehend language code for DetectPiiEntities
    Default: en
    AllowedValues: [en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ar, hi, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW]

  DefaultMaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Description: Default cap on files scanned per invocation (cost/runtime control)
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000

  NotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      SNS Topic ARN for classification report notifications. Leave empty
      to skip notifications.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasNotificationTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationTopicArn, '']]
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']

Resources:
  # ================================================================
  # VPC Endpoints — only created when VpcId is set and
  # CreateVpcEndpoints=true. Required so the in-VPC scanner Lambda can
  # reach: the VPC-scoped S3 Access Point being scanned (S3 Gateway), the
  # DynamoDB report table (DynamoDB Gateway), Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
  # (Comprehend Interface), and SNS notifications (SNS Interface).
  # ================================================================
  S3GatewayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDbGatewayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: ShouldCreateVpcEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow scanner Lambda to access Interface VPC Endpoints (Comprehend, SNS)
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
          Description: Lambda SG to VPC Endpoint (HTTPS)

  # ================================================================
  # DynamoDB — classification report ledger
  # ================================================================
  ClassificationReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-reports'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: access_point_arn
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: started_at
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: access_point_arn
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: started_at
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: fsxn-observability
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: content-classification-report

  # ================================================================
  # Lambda Execution Role
  # ================================================================
  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # Attached unconditionally — harmless when VpcId is empty (the
      # scanner Lambda simply won't have ENIs to manage), and avoids a
      # Fn::If on ManagedPolicyArns.
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ContentClassificationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3AccessPointObjectRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*/object/*'
              - Sid: ComprehendDetectPii
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
                # DetectPiiEntities does not support resource-level
                # permissions (it is a synchronous, stateless inference
                # API with no addressable resource).
              - Sid: DynamoDbReportLedger
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ClassificationReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: SNSPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !If
                  - HasNotificationTopic
                  - !Ref NotificationTopicArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-scanner:*'

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-scanner'
      RetentionInDays: 365  # classification reports double as CSF 2.0 Identify evidence

  # ================================================================
  # Lambda — Content Classification Scanner
  # ================================================================
  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scanner'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeoutSeconds
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      # Only set VpcConfig when VpcId is provided. A VPC-scoped S3 Access
      # Point (e.g., from restore-verification.yaml's AttachAccessPoint
      # step) has no route from outside its bound VPC, so scanning one
      # requires this Lambda to run inside that VPC — see the Description
      # above and Security Considerations in content-classification-scanner.md.
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref ClassificationReportTable
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref DefaultLanguageCode
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES: !Ref DefaultMaxFiles
          NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN: !If [HasNotificationTopic, !Ref NotificationTopicArn, '']
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          """Content-level PII discovery scanner (CSF 2.0 Identify function).

          Invocation input (direct Lambda invoke or Step Functions task):
          {
              "access_point_arn": "arn:aws:s3:...:accesspoint/...",  // required
              "language_code": "en",                                  // optional
              "max_files": 500                                        // optional
          }

          Scans scannable text/structured-data files exposed via the given
          S3 Access Point for PII entities using Amazon Comprehend
          DetectPiiEntities, aggregates findings, writes a report to
          DynamoDB, and optionally notifies via SNS.

          Does NOT create or manage the S3 Access Point itself — pass the
          ARN of an existing one (e.g., from restore-verification.yaml's
          AttachAccessPoint step, or any other FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Point
          you want to classify).
          """
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          from dataclasses import dataclass, field
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from typing import Any

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend")
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          sns = boto3.client("sns")

          COMPREHEND_MAX_BYTES = 100_000
          CHUNK_SAFETY_MARGIN_BYTES = 2_000
          CHUNK_TARGET_BYTES = COMPREHEND_MAX_BYTES - CHUNK_SAFETY_MARGIN_BYTES

          SCANNABLE_EXTENSIONS = frozenset({
              ".txt", ".csv", ".tsv", ".json", ".xml", ".log", ".md",
              ".yaml", ".yml", ".ini", ".conf", ".sql", ".html", ".htm",
          })

          DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES = 5_000_000
          DEFAULT_SAMPLE_BYTES = 500_000

          COMPREHEND_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = frozenset({
              "en", "es", "fr", "de", "it", "pt", "ar", "hi", "ja", "ko", "zh", "zh-TW",
          })

          def _chunk_text(text, target_bytes=CHUNK_TARGET_BYTES):
              if not text:
                  return []
              chunks = []
              current_lines, current_bytes = [], 0
              for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
                  line_bytes = len(line.encode("utf-8"))
                  if line_bytes > target_bytes:
                      if current_lines:
                          chunks.append("".join(current_lines))
                          current_lines, current_bytes = [], 0
                      encoded = line.encode("utf-8")
                      for i in range(0, len(encoded), target_bytes):
                          chunks.append(encoded[i:i + target_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
                      continue
                  if current_bytes + line_bytes > target_bytes and current_lines:
                      chunks.append("".join(current_lines))
                      current_lines, current_bytes = [], 0
                  current_lines.append(line)
                  current_bytes += line_bytes
              if current_lines:
                  chunks.append("".join(current_lines))
              return chunks

          def _classify_object(access_point_arn, key, size_bytes, language_code):
              sampled = size_bytes > DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES
              finding = {"key": key, "size_bytes": size_bytes, "sampled": sampled,
                         "entity_counts": {}, "highest_confidence_by_type": {}, "error": ""}

              try:
                  if sampled:
                      resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=access_point_arn, Key=key,
                                           Range=f"bytes=0-{DEFAULT_SAMPLE_BYTES - 1}")
                  else:
                      resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=access_point_arn, Key=key)
                  raw = resp["Body"].read()
              except ClientError as e:
                  finding["error"] = f"read_failed: {e}"
                  return finding

              text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
              if not text.strip():
                  return finding

              for chunk in _chunk_text(text):
                  if not chunk.strip():
                      continue
                  try:
                      resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=chunk, LanguageCode=language_code)
                  except ClientError as e:
                      finding["error"] = f"comprehend_failed: {e}"
                      continue
                  for entity in resp.get("Entities", []):
                      etype = entity.get("Type", "UNKNOWN")
                      score = entity.get("Score", 0.0)
                      finding["entity_counts"][etype] = finding["entity_counts"].get(etype, 0) + 1
                      finding["highest_confidence_by_type"][etype] = max(
                          finding["highest_confidence_by_type"].get(etype, 0.0), score
                      )

              return finding

          def lambda_handler(event: dict[str, Any], context: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
              access_point_arn = event["access_point_arn"]
              language_code = event.get("language_code", os.environ.get("DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE", "en"))
              max_files = int(event.get("max_files", os.environ.get("DEFAULT_MAX_FILES", "500")))

              if language_code not in COMPREHEND_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES:
                  raise ValueError(
                      f"Unsupported language_code '{language_code}' — must be one of "
                      f"{sorted(COMPREHEND_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES)}"
                  )

              started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              files_scanned = 0
              files_skipped_unscannable = 0
              files_sampled_too_large = 0
              files_with_pii = 0
              pii_density_by_type = {}
              findings = []

              paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn, MaxKeys=1000):
                  for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
                      if files_scanned >= max_files:
                          break
                      key = obj["Key"]
                      size_bytes = obj.get("Size", 0)
                      lower_key = key.lower()

                      if not any(lower_key.endswith(ext) for ext in SCANNABLE_EXTENSIONS):
                          files_skipped_unscannable += 1
                          continue
                      if size_bytes == 0:
                          continue

                      finding = _classify_object(access_point_arn, key, size_bytes, language_code)
                      files_scanned += 1

                      if finding["sampled"]:
                          files_sampled_too_large += 1
                      if finding["entity_counts"]:
                          files_with_pii += 1
                          findings.append(finding)
                          for etype, count in finding["entity_counts"].items():
                              pii_density_by_type[etype] = pii_density_by_type.get(etype, 0) + count
                      elif finding["error"]:
                          findings.append(finding)
                  if files_scanned >= max_files:
                      break

              completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              report = {
                  "access_point_arn": access_point_arn,
                  "started_at": started_at,
                  "completed_at": completed_at,
                  "language_code": language_code,
                  "files_scanned": files_scanned,
                  "files_skipped_unscannable": files_skipped_unscannable,
                  "files_sampled_too_large": files_sampled_too_large,
                  "files_with_pii": files_with_pii,
                  "pii_density_by_type": pii_density_by_type,
                  "findings": findings[:100],
                  "finding_count": len(findings),
              }

              table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ["REPORT_TABLE_NAME"])
              table.put_item(Item=json.loads(json.dumps(report), parse_float=str))

              logger.info(
                  "Classification complete: %d files scanned, %d with PII, %d unscannable skipped",
                  files_scanned, files_with_pii, files_skipped_unscannable,
              )

              topic_arn = os.environ.get("NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN")
              if topic_arn and files_with_pii > 0:
                  try:
                      sns.publish(
                          TopicArn=topic_arn,
                          Subject=f"[FSx-ONTAP PII Scan] {files_with_pii} file(s) with PII found"[:100],
                          Message=json.dumps(
                              {k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "findings"},
                              indent=2, default=str,
                          ),
                      )
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.warning("Notification failed: %s", e)

              return report

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: >-
      Content classification scanner Lambda ARN. Invoke directly with
      {"access_point_arn": "..."} or chain after the restore-verification.yaml
      workflow's AttachAccessPoint step (e.g., via Step Functions or a
      scheduled EventBridge rule targeting an S3 Access Point you manage
      separately). If VpcId was set at deploy time, this function only
      reaches VPC-scoped access points bound to that same VPC (and
      internet-origin ones, via the VPC's own internet/NAT path if
      present) — if VpcId was left empty, this function only reaches
      internet-origin access points.
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn

  ReportTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name for classification reports
    Value: !Ref ClassificationReportTable

  InvokeExample:
    Description: Example AWS CLI command to invoke the scanner
    Value: !Sub >-
      aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction}
      --payload '{"access_point_arn":"arn:aws:s3:REGION:ACCOUNT:accesspoint/NAME","language_code":"en","max_files":500}'
      --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out response.json
