# Title: Simple Hello World Lambda Function.
# Date: May 12 to May 16 2025
# AI created Labt to learn Lambda, API Gateway interconnect
# AI chat link:
# Lambda: Returns Hello World text to api gatway
# API Gateway: Exposes the HTTP Endpoints
# https://<api-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com/prod/hello
###########################################
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple Hello World Lambda Function.
# Lambda Function Role
Resources:
  HelloWorldLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: HelloWorldLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

# Lambda Function with inline script
# NOTE the handler is identified by using the same name
# as the code's function name.
  HelloWorldFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: HelloWorldFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      # Use !GetAtt to get the arn # the role defined above
      Role: !GetAtt HelloWorldLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
      # Used for small code, AWS will zip the code during the build.
        ZipFile: |
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
             return "Hello, World"

# Api Gateway uses "curl" to get the response
#
# API Gateway REST API
  ApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: HelloWorldApi

# /hello path under root on the lambda function
  HelloResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGateway.RootResourceId
      PathPart: hello

# GET /hello method with Lambda proxy intergration
  HelloMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ResourceId: !Ref HelloResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri:
           Fn::Sub: arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${HelloWorldFunction.Arn}/invocations

# Permissions to API Gatreway to invoke Lambda
  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref HelloWorldFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGateway}/*/GET/hello

# Deploy to prod stage
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: HelloMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      StageName: prod

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Mission Mischief Beer Justice System Infrastructure'

Parameters:
  AccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '170377509849'

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Tables for Beer Justice
  BeerTrialsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: mission-mischief-beer-trials
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: trial_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: trial_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: status-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: status
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  BeerDebtsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: mission-mischief-beer-debts
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: debt_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: debtor
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: creditor
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: debt_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: debtor-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: debtor
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
        - IndexName: creditor-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: creditor
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  HonorScoresTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: mission-mischief-honor-scores
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_handle
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_handle
          KeyType: HASH

  # Lambda Function for Beer Justice API
  BeerJusticeFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: mission-mischief-beer-justice
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: lambda_function.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt BeerJusticeLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Beer Justice API placeholder'})
              }
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512

  # IAM Role for Beer Justice Lambda
  BeerJusticeLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: mission-mischief-beer-justice-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BeerJusticePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BeerTrialsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt BeerDebtsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HonorScoresTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${BeerTrialsTable.Arn}/index/*"
                  - !Sub "${BeerDebtsTable.Arn}/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/mission-mischief-posts"

  # API Gateway for Beer Justice
  BeerJusticeApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: mission-mischief-beer-justice-api
      Description: Beer Justice System API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  BeerJusticeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref BeerJusticeApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt BeerJusticeApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{action}'

  BeerJusticeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref BeerJusticeApi
      ResourceId: !Ref BeerJusticeResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${BeerJusticeFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  BeerJusticeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref BeerJusticeApi
      ResourceId: !Ref BeerJusticeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${BeerJusticeFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  BeerJusticeOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref BeerJusticeApi
      ResourceId: !Ref BeerJusticeResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  BeerJusticeDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - BeerJusticeMethod
      - BeerJusticeGetMethod
      - BeerJusticeOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref BeerJusticeApi
      StageName: prod

  # Lambda Permission for API Gateway
  BeerJusticeLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref BeerJusticeFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${BeerJusticeApi}/*/*'

Outputs:
  BeerJusticeApiUrl:
    Description: 'Beer Justice API Gateway URL'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${BeerJusticeApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BeerJusticeApiUrl'

  BeerTrialsTableName:
    Description: 'Beer Trials DynamoDB Table Name'
    Value: !Ref BeerTrialsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BeerTrialsTable'

  BeerDebtsTableName:
    Description: 'Beer Debts DynamoDB Table Name'
    Value: !Ref BeerDebtsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BeerDebtsTable'

  HonorScoresTableName:
    Description: 'Honor Scores DynamoDB Table Name'
    Value: !Ref HonorScoresTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HonorScoresTable'

cfn_description: Lab 9.2 — Saved Logs Insights queries against Lab 9.1 log group
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Lab 9.2 — Saved Logs Insights queries against Lab 9.1 log group

Resources:
  RecentErrorsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-09-02/recent-errors
      LogGroupNames:
        - /aws/lambda/dva-lab-09-01-logger
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /ERROR/
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  LambdaReportP99Query:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-09-02/lambda-p99-duration
      LogGroupNames:
        - /aws/lambda/dva-lab-09-01-logger
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @duration, @billedDuration, @maxMemoryUsed
        | filter @type = "REPORT"
        | stats avg(@duration), pct(@duration, 50), pct(@duration, 95), pct(@duration, 99) by bin(5m)

  CountByLevelQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-09-02/count-by-level
      LogGroupNames:
        - /aws/lambda/dva-lab-09-01-logger
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"level":"(?<level>[A-Z]+)"/
        | stats count() as cnt by level
        | sort cnt desc

  ParseLatencyQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-09-02/parse-latency-by-route
      LogGroupNames:
        - /aws/lambda/dva-lab-09-01-logger
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /"route":"(?<route>\S+)".*"latency_ms":(?<latency>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(latency)
        | stats avg(latency), max(latency), pct(latency, 95) by route

  ColdStartsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-09-02/cold-starts
      LogGroupNames:
        - /aws/lambda/dva-lab-09-01-logger
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @initDuration
        | filter ispresent(@initDuration)
        | sort @initDuration desc
        | limit 50

Outputs:
  Note:
    Value: "Open CloudWatch Logs Insights → Queries dropdown → expand 'Saved queries' to see the dva-lab-09-02/* entries."

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  DVA-C02 Lab 2.7 - DynamoDB table demonstrating TTL, provisioned capacity with
  auto-scaling, and Point-in-Time Recovery.

Resources:
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: dva-lab-02-07-sessions
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ReadCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 40
      MinCapacity: 5
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${SessionsTable}
      RoleARN: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/dynamodb.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_DynamoDBTable
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ReadCapacityScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: dva-lab-02-07-read-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  WriteCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 40
      MinCapacity: 5
      ResourceId: !Sub table/${SessionsTable}
      RoleARN: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/dynamodb.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_DynamoDBTable
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  WriteCapacityScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: dva-lab-02-07-write-scaling
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
  TableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Lab 4.5 — Cognito User Pool + JWT-protected REST API

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: dva-lab-04-05-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      UsernameAttributes: [email]
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: dva-lab-04-05-cli
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60       # 60 minutes
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30      # 30 days
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-04-05-api
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types: [REGIONAL]

  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-04-05-cognito-authorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dva-lab-04-05-echo
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        def handler(event, context):
            ctx = event.get("requestContext", {})
            authorizer = ctx.get("authorizer", {})
            claims = authorizer.get("claims", {})
            return {
                "statusCode": 200,
                "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                "body": json.dumps({
                    "path": event.get("path"),
                    "method": event.get("httpMethod"),
                    "claims": claims,
                    "message": (
                        "you are authenticated as " + claims.get("email", "unknown")
                        if claims else "open endpoint — no claims"
                    ),
                }),
            }

  ## /me — protected
  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  MeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ## /open — unauthenticated comparison
  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  OpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations

  EchoFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*/*

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: [MeMethod, OpenMethod]
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Lab 4.5 deployment

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: dva-lab-04-05-user-pool-id
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dva-lab-04-05-user-pool-arn
  ClientId:
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: dva-lab-04-05-client-id
  ApiUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Lab 4.8 — Route 53 hosted zone (placeholder domain) + WAF web ACL on REST API

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: dva-lab.example
    Description: Hosted zone DNS name (any string; not delegated to a real registrar in the lab)

Resources:
  ## ─────────────────────── Route 53 hosted zone ──────────────────
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName

  # Placeholder targets for routing demos — use 192.0.2.x (TEST-NET-1, RFC 5737)
  SimpleRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "simple.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.1" ]

  WeightedRecordA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "weighted.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: primary-90pct
      Weight: 90
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.10" ]

  WeightedRecordB:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "weighted.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: canary-10pct
      Weight: 10
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.11" ]

  FailoverPrimary:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "failover.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: primary
      Failover: PRIMARY
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.20" ]

  FailoverSecondary:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "failover.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: secondary
      Failover: SECONDARY
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.21" ]

  GeoUS:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "geo.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: us-only
      GeoLocation:
        CountryCode: US
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.30" ]

  GeoDefault:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "geo.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      TTL: 60
      SetIdentifier: world-default
      GeoLocation:
        CountryCode: "*"
      ResourceRecords: [ "192.0.2.31" ]

  ## ─────────────────────── REST API + Lambda ─────────────────────
  HelloFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dva-lab-04-08-hello
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        def handler(event, context):
            return {
                "statusCode": 200,
                "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                "body": json.dumps({"message": "hello from waf-protected api"}),
            }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-04-08-api
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types: [REGIONAL]

  HelloResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: hello

  HelloMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref HelloResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${HelloFunction.Arn}/invocations

  Permission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref HelloFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*/*

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: [HelloMethod]
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment

  ## ─────────────────────────── WAF web ACL ────────────────────────
  WebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-04-08-acl
      Scope: REGIONAL
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: dva-lab-04-08-acl
      Rules:
        # AWS-managed: Common Rule Set (OWASP top 10 patterns)
        - Name: AWSCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSCommonRuleSet
        # Rate-based: 100 reqs / IP / 5 minutes
        - Name: RateLimitPerIp
          Priority: 1
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 100
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitPerIp

  WebACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}::/restapis/${RestApi}/stages/${Stage}
      WebACLArn: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  HostedZoneName:
    Value: !Ref DomainName
  ApiUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod
  WebACLArn:
    Value: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn
  WebACLId:
    Value: !Ref WebACL

resource_types: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey | AWS::AppSync::DataSource | AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi | AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema | AWS::AppSync::Resolver | AWS::DynamoDB::Table | AWS::IAM::Role
cfn_description: Lab 5.7 — AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB direct resolvers, API key auth
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0024", "severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Point in time recovery should be enabled to protect DynamoDB table", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Point-in-time recovery is not enabled.", "resolution": "Enable point in time recovery", "resource": "tmpbc1ctxii.yaml:5-15", "query": "data.builtin.aws.dynamodb.aws0024.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0025", "severity": "LOW", "title": "DynamoDB tables should use at rest encryption with a Customer Managed Key", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Table encryption does not use a customer-managed KMS key.", "resolution": "Enable server side encryption with a customer managed key", "resource": "", "query": "data.builtin.aws.dynamodb.aws0025.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Lab 5.7 — AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB direct resolvers, API key auth

Resources:
  ProductsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: dva-lab-05-07-products
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  AppsyncApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: dva-lab-05-07-api
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      Description: dva-lab-05-07 lab key
      Expires: 4102444800   # year 2100; CFN requires unix timestamp

  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Product {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          price: Float!
        }
        input ProductInput {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          price: Float!
        }
        type ProductConnection {
          items: [Product]
          nextToken: String
        }
        type Query {
          getProduct(id: ID!): Product
          listProducts(limit: Int, nextToken: String): ProductConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createProduct(input: ProductInput!): Product
          deleteProduct(id: ID!): Product
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  AppsyncRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: appsync.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt ProductsTable.Arn

  DataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      Name: ProductsTableDS
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppsyncRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref ProductsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  GetProductResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getProduct
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        { "version": "2018-05-29", "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": { "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id) } }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  ListProductsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listProducts
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        { "version": "2018-05-29", "operation": "Scan",
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 20),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNullOrEmpty($ctx.args.nextToken, null)) }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        { "items": $util.toJson($ctx.result.items),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.result.nextToken) }

  CreateProductResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createProduct
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        { "version": "2018-05-29", "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": { "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.input.id) },
          "attributeValues": $util.dynamodb.toMapValuesJson($ctx.args.input) }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  DeleteProductResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteProduct
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        { "version": "2018-05-29", "operation": "DeleteItem",
          "key": { "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id) } }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQLUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt AppsyncApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Value: !GetAtt ApiKey.ApiKey
  TableName:
    Value: !Ref ProductsTable

resource_types: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application | AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup | AWS::IAM::Role | AWS::Lambda::Alias | AWS::Lambda::Function | AWS::Lambda::Version
cfn_description: Lab 8.3 — CodeDeploy for Lambda with pre/post traffic hooks
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpzig9msbj.yaml:5-19", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpzig9msbj.yaml:66-74", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}, {"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpzig9msbj.yaml:85-93", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Lab 8.3 — CodeDeploy for Lambda with pre/post traffic hooks

Resources:
  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dva-lab-08-03-main
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"msg": os.environ.get("MESSAGE", "version 1 message")}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MESSAGE: "version 1 message"

  MainRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: lambda.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  InitialVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: Initial version

  LiveAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Name: live
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt InitialVersion.Version

  HookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: lambda.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codedeploy-hook
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: "*"

  PreTrafficHook:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dva-lab-08-03-pre
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              cd = boto3.client("codedeploy")
              cd.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status="Succeeded",
              )
              return {"ok": True}

  PostTrafficHook:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: dva-lab-08-03-post
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              cd = boto3.client("codedeploy")
              cd.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status="Succeeded",
              )
              return {"ok": True}

  CodeDeployRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda

  CodeDeployApp:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: dva-lab-08-03-app
      ComputePlatform: Lambda

  DeploymentGroup:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApp
      DeploymentGroupName: dva-lab-08-03-dg
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployRole.Arn
      DeploymentStyle:
        DeploymentType: BLUE_GREEN
        DeploymentOption: WITH_TRAFFIC_CONTROL

Outputs:
  FunctionName:
    Value: !Ref MainFunction
  AliasArn:
    Value: !Ref LiveAlias
  AppName:
    Value: !Ref CodeDeployApp
  DeploymentGroup:
    Value: !Ref DeploymentGroup
  PreHook:
    Value: !Ref PreTrafficHook
  PostHook:
    Value: !Ref PostTrafficHook

cfn_description:
DVA-C02 Lab 8.1 — CodeCommit repository for the multi-lab Module 8 chain.
Used by labs 8.2 (CodeBuild), 8.3 (CodeDeploy Lambda), 8.4 (CodeDeploy EC2),
8.5 (CodeDeploy ECS), and 8.6 (CodePipeline).
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  DVA-C02 Lab 8.1 — CodeCommit repository for the multi-lab Module 8 chain.
  Used by labs 8.2 (CodeBuild), 8.3 (CodeDeploy Lambda), 8.4 (CodeDeploy EC2),
  8.5 (CodeDeploy ECS), and 8.6 (CodePipeline).

Parameters:
  RepoName:
    Type: String
    Default: dva-lab-08-app
    Description: CodeCommit repository name.

Resources:
  AppRepo:
    Type: AWS::CodeCommit::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepoName
      RepositoryDescription: |
        Sample app used across DVA-C02 Module 8 labs.
        Contains a Python Lambda handler + a tiny web server for EC2/ECS deploys.

Outputs:
  RepoName:
    Description: Repository name
    Value: !GetAtt AppRepo.Name

  RepoArn:
    Description: Repository ARN — referenced by CodeBuild/CodePipeline IAM policies
    Value: !GetAtt AppRepo.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RepoArn"

  CloneUrlHttps:
    Description: HTTPS clone URL — needs IAM HTTPS Git credentials
    Value: !GetAtt AppRepo.CloneUrlHttp

  CloneUrlSsh:
    Description: SSH clone URL — needs SSH public key uploaded to your IAM user
    Value: !GetAtt AppRepo.CloneUrlSsh

  CloneUrlGrc:
    Description: |
      git-remote-codecommit URL — uses AWS CLI env-var creds.
      Recommended for this course.
    Value: !Sub "codecommit::${AWS::Region}://${AppRepo.Name}"

resource_types: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey | AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment | AWS::ApiGateway::Method | AWS::ApiGateway::Model | AWS::ApiGateway::Resource | AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi | AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan | AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
cfn_description: API Gateway for Claim Status API - RESTful endpoints for claim retrieval and summarization
content:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://json.schemastore.org/cloudformation.json
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  API Gateway for Claim Status API - RESTful endpoints for claim retrieval and summarization

Parameters:
  ServiceEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Description: Kubernetes LoadBalancer or NLB endpoint for claim-status-api
    Default: claim-status-api.example.com
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  DeploymentVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: v1
    Description: Bump this value to force a new API Gateway deployment

Resources:
  ClaimStatusApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub claim-status-api-${EnvironmentName}
      Description: GenAI-enabled Claim Status API with Bedrock summarization
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Policy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGetClaim
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/${EnvironmentName}/GET/api/claims/*'
          - Sid: AllowPostSummarize
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/${EnvironmentName}/POST/api/claims/*/summarize'
          - Sid: AllowHealthCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/${EnvironmentName}/GET/health'

  ClaimsResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ClaimStatusApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: api

  HealthResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ClaimStatusApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: health

  ClaimsApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ParentId: !Ref ClaimsResource
      PathPart: claims

  ClaimIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ParentId: !Ref ClaimsApiResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  SummarizeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ParentId: !Ref ClaimIdResource
      PathPart: summarize

  GetClaimMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ClaimIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP
        IntegrationHttpMethod: GET
        Uri: !Sub http://${ServiceEndpoint}/api/claims/{id}
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.path.id: method.request.path.id
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"id": "$input.params(''id'')"}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 404

  SummarizeClaimMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ResourceId: !Ref SummarizeResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref SummarizeRequestModel
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub http://${ServiceEndpoint}/api/claims/{id}/summarize
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.path.id: method.request.path.id
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |
            {
              "id": "$input.params('id')",
              "notesOverride": "$input.path('$.notesOverride')"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 404
        - StatusCode: 500

  HealthMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      ResourceId: !Ref HealthResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP
        IntegrationHttpMethod: GET
        Uri: !Sub http://${ServiceEndpoint}/health
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  SummarizeRequestModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      Name: SummarizeRequest
      ContentType: application/json
      Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          notesOverride:
            type: string
            description: Optional override for claim notes

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetClaimMethod
      - SummarizeClaimMethod
      - HealthMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
      Description: !Sub "Deployment-${EnvironmentName}-${DeploymentVersion}-${AWS::StackId}"
      StageName: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub claim-status-api-${EnvironmentName}-key
      Enabled: true
      GenerateDistinctId: true

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn:
      - ApiDeployment
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: !Sub claim-status-api-${EnvironmentName}-plan
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
          Stage: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Throttle:
        RateLimit: 100.0
        BurstLimit: 50
      Quota:
        Limit: 100000
        Period: MONTH

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    DependsOn:
      - UsagePlan
      - ApiKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ClaimStatusApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${EnvironmentName}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ClaimStatusApiEndpoint-${EnvironmentName}

  ApiId:
    Description: API Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref ClaimStatusApi
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ClaimStatusApiId-${EnvironmentName}

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: API Key ID
    Value: !Ref ApiKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ClaimStatusApiKeyId-${EnvironmentName}

  UsagePlanId:
    Description: Usage Plan ID
    Value: !Ref UsagePlan
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ClaimStatusApiUsagePlanId-${EnvironmentName}

cfn_description: Real-time CloudWatch dashboard for Claude Code hybrid observability. Pulls from ClaudeCode/GenAI namespace via OTEL collector EMF metrics. Claude Code emits claude_code.* metric names (not gen_ai.*).
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Real-time CloudWatch dashboard for Claude Code hybrid observability.
  Pulls from ClaudeCode/GenAI namespace via OTEL collector EMF metrics.
  Claude Code emits claude_code.* metric names (not gen_ai.*).
  Stack name: claude-code-dashboard-{OrgName}-{Environment}

Parameters:
  OrgName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-org
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Override dashboard name (default auto-generated)

Conditions:
  UseDefaultName: !Equals [!Ref DashboardName, '']

Resources:
  Dashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !If
        - UseDefaultName
        - !Sub 'ClaudeCode-${OrgName}-${Environment}'
        - !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 1,
             "properties": {"markdown": "# Claude Code Observability — ${OrgName} (${Environment})"}},

            {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 1, "width": 24, "height": 1,
             "properties": {"markdown": "## Token Usage (OTEL — Real-Time)"}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Token Throughput (All Types, stacked)", "view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${AWS::Region}", "period": 300,
              "metrics": [
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "cacheRead", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Cache Read"}],
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "cacheCreation", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Cache Write"}],
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "input", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Input (uncached)"}],
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "output", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Output"}]]}},
            {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 2, "width": 12, "height": 6,
             "properties": {"title": "Uncached Input vs Output", "view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false, "region": "${AWS::Region}", "period": 300,
              "metrics": [
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "input", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Input (uncached)"}],
                ["ClaudeCode/GenAI", "claude_code.token.usage", "type", "output", "organization", "${OrgName}", {"stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "label": "Output"}]]}},

cfn_description: Nova Sonic Production Phase 2 - Add ECS Service (after Docker image push)
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Nova Sonic Production Phase 2 - Add ECS Service (after Docker image push)'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: nova-sonic

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production

Resources:
  # ============================================
  # ECS SERVICE - Requires Docker image in ECR!
  # ============================================

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-service-${Environment}'
      Cluster:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cluster-arn'
      TaskDefinition:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-task-def'
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets:
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet1'
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet2'
          SecurityGroups:
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-sg'
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-app'
          ContainerPort: 3000
          TargetGroupArn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${ProjectName}-tg-arn'
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 600

Outputs:
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: ECS Service Name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ECSServiceArn:
    Description: ECS Service ARN
    Value: !Ref ECSService

cfn_description: Creates an S3 Bucket, IAM Policies, and SageMaker Notebook to work with Personalize.
content:
---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: Creates an S3 Bucket, IAM Policies, and SageMaker Notebook to work with Personalize.

Parameters:

  NotebookName:
    Type: String
    Default: PersonalizeDemoLab
    Description: Enter the name of the SageMaker notebook instance. Deafault is PersonalizeDemoLab.

  VolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 5
    MaxValue: 16384
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an integer between 5 (GB) and 16384 (16 TB).
    Description: Enter the size of the EBS volume in GB.

Resources:
  # SageMaker Execution Role
  SageMakerIamRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          -
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess"
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess"
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonPersonalizeFullAccess"
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess"

  # SageMaker notebook
  NotebookInstance:
    Type: "AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance"
    Properties:
      InstanceType: "ml.t2.medium"
      NotebookInstanceName: !Ref NotebookName
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerIamRole.Arn
      VolumeSizeInGB: !Ref VolumeSize
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/aws-samples/amazon-personalize-samples.git

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Movies API - CloudFormation Template for AWS Production Deployment

# ============================================================
# Parameters
# ============================================================
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name

# ============================================================
# Resources
# ============================================================
Resources:

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # IAM Role — shared by all Lambda functions
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub lambda-movies-role-${Environment}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-dynamodb-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # DynamoDB Table
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: movies
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: movies-table
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # CloudWatch Log Groups (pre-created to control retention)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/create_movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  GetMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/get_movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/update_movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/delete_movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda Functions (inline code — src/ files embedded)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: create_movie
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table('movies')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              year   = event['year']   if event.get('year')   else '0'
              title  = event['title']  if event.get('title')  else ''
              actors = event['actors'] if event.get('actors') else ''

              response = table.put_item(
                  Item={
                      'year': year,
                      'title': title,
                      'info': {
                          'actors': actors
                      }
                  }
              )

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': str(response)
              }

  GetMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: GetMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: get_movie
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table('movies')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              title = event['title']
              response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps(response.get('Item', {}), default=str)
              }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: update_movie
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          from decimal import Decimal

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table('movies')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              title  = event['title']  if event.get('title')  else ''
              rating = event['rating'] if event.get('rating') else '0.0'
              plot   = event['plot']   if event.get('plot')   else ''

              response = table.update_item(
                  Key={'title': title},
                  UpdateExpression='set info.rating=:r, info.plot=:p',
                  ExpressionAttributeValues={
                      ':r': Decimal(str(rating)),
                      ':p': plot
                  },
                  ReturnValues='UPDATED_NEW'
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': str(response)
              }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: delete_movie
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table('movies')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              title = event['title']
              response = table.delete_item(
                  Key={'title': title},
                  ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(info.actors)',
                  ReturnValues='ALL_OLD'
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': str(response)
              }

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # API Gateway REST API
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: Movies API
      Description: Movies API — connects HTTP endpoints to Lambda functions
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # /Movies
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  # /Movies/{title}
  MoviesTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  # ── POST /Movies → CreateMovieFunction ──
  PostMoviesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  # ── PUT /Movies → UpdateMovieFunction ──
  PutMoviesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  # ── DELETE /Movies → DeleteMovieFunction ──
  DeleteMoviesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  # ── OPTIONS /Movies (CORS preflight) ──
  OptionsMoviesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'DELETE,GET,OPTIONS,POST,PUT'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ── GET /Movies/{title} → GetMovieFunction ──
  GetMovieTitleMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.title: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GetMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: |
            {
              "title": "$input.params('title')"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  # ── OPTIONS /Movies/{title} (CORS preflight) ──
  OptionsMoviesTitleMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.title: true
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'DELETE,GET,OPTIONS,POST,PUT'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ── Deployment (must depend on all methods) ──
  MoviesApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostMoviesMethod
      - PutMoviesMethod
      - DeleteMoviesMethod
      - OptionsMoviesMethod
      - GetMovieTitleMethod
      - OptionsMoviesTitleMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi

  # ── Stage ──
  MoviesApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MoviesApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      Description: !Sub Movies API - ${Environment} stage

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda Permissions (allow API Gateway to invoke each fn)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CreateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*

  GetMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref GetMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*

  UpdateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref UpdateMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*

  DeleteMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DeleteMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*

# ============================================================
# Outputs
# ============================================================
Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub https://${MoviesApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Environment}/
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ApiUrl

  MoviesTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref MoviesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TableName

  CreateMovieFunctionArn:
    Description: Create Movie Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CreateMovieFunction.Arn

  GetMovieFunctionArn:
    Description: Get Movie Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt GetMovieFunction.Arn

  UpdateMovieFunctionArn:
    Description: Update Movie Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UpdateMovieFunction.Arn

  DeleteMovieFunctionArn:
    Description: Delete Movie Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DeleteMovieFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:

    Properties:
      RoleName: QuickSightAdminConsole2025

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:

                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com

            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole

            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Action:
                  - iam:*

                  - glue:*
                  - s3:*

                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch

                Effect: Allow
  etljobadminsuiteassetsaccess:

  etljobadminsuiteassetsaccessschedule:

      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access

      StartOnCreation: true
  etljobadminsuiteassetsmetadataschedule:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Description: Glue Trigger to run etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata glue job every
        3 hours
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Name: etl-job-admin-suite-assets-metadata-every-3-hour
      StartOnCreation: true
  etljobadminsuitefolderassetsschedule:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Description: Glue Trigger to run etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets job every 3 hours
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Name: etl-job-admin-suite-folder-assets-every-3-hour
      StartOnCreation: true
  etljobadminsuiteqmetadataschedule:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: S3 bucket name containing Glue job scripts
Resources:
  QuickSuiteAdmin:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub QuickSuiteAdmin-${AWS::AccountId}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub Quick-Suite-Admin-${AWS::AccountId}
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Action:
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - iam:Create*
                  - iam:Update*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - quicksight:*
                  - glue:*
                  - s3:*
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
                Effect: Allow
  etljobadminsuiteassetsaccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/glue/scripts/2025/admin_suite_user_info_access_manage.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub ${AWS::Region}
        '--S3_OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/monitoring/quicksight/assets_access
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Name: admin_suite_user_info_access_manage
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSuiteAdmin.Arn
      Timeout: 360
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
    DependsOn:
      - adminsuites3
    Metadata:
      AWS::CloudFormation::Designer:
        id: c4462e36-ef27-43d6-a0df-01246a77b117
  etljobadminsuiteassetsmetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/glue/scripts/2025/admin_suite_dataset.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub ${AWS::Region}
        '--S3_OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/monitoring/quicksight/dataset
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Name: admin_suite_dataset

      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2

        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub ${AWS::Region}
        '--QUICKSIGHT_IDENTITY_REGION': !Sub ${AWS::Region}
        '--S3_OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/monitoring/quicksight/datasource_property
      GlueVersion: '5.0'

        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

      Name: admin_suite_datasource
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSuiteAdmin.Arn
      Timeout: 240
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
    DependsOn:
      - adminsuites3
  etljobadminsuiteassetsaccessschedule:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Description: Glue Trigger to run admin_suite_user_info_access_manage glue job daily
      Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      Actions:
        - JobName: admin_suite_user_info_access_manage
      Name: etl-job-admin-suite-assets-access-daily
      StartOnCreation: true
  etljobadminsuiteassetsmetadataschedule:

    Properties:
      Type: SCHEDULED

      Schedule: cron(15 2 * * ? *)
      Actions:

      Name: etl-job-admin-suite-assets-metadata-daily
