content:
---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 05-tour-of-heroes

Resources:
  APIGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
          Action: sts:AssumeRole
          Condition: {}
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess

  HeroesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: heroes
      AttributeDefinitions:
      - AttributeName: id
        AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
      - AttributeName: id
        KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  RestAPIDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestAPIv2
      StageName: prod

  RestAPIv2:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
        - REGIONAL

      Body:
        info:
          description: Tour of Heroes API
          title: Tour Of Heroes
          version: 1.0.0
        paths:
          /api/search/{name}:
            get:
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: |-
                        [
                        #foreach ($item in $input.path('$.Items'))
                        {
                            "id": "$item.id.N",
                            "name": "$item.name.S"
                        }
                        #if($foreach.hasNext), #end
                        #end
                        ]
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                        "TableName": "${HeroesTable}",
                        "ScanFilter": {
                          "name": {
                            "AttributeValueList":[ {"S":"$input.params('name')"} ],
                             "ComparisonOperator": "CONTAINS"
                          }
                        }
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              summary: Search for heroes
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: Return a list of heroes
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Heroes'
              parameters:
              - in: path
                name: name
                type: string
                required: true
              produces:
              - application/json
          /api/heroes/{id}:
            get:
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: |-
                        #if ($input.body == '{}')
                          $input.body
                        #set($context.responseOverride.status = 404)
                        #else
                        {
                          "id": $input.json('$.Item.id.N'),
                          "name": $input.json('$.Item.name.S')
                        }
                        #end
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/GetItem"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                      "TableName": "${HeroesTable}",
                      "Key": {
                        "id": {
                          "N": "$input.params('id')"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              summary: get hero by id
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: hero is found
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
                '404':
                  description: hero is not found
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
              parameters:
              - in: path
                name: id
                type: number
                required: true
              produces:
              - application/json
            delete:
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                      "TableName": "${HeroesTable}",
                      "Key": {
                        "id": {
                          "N": "$input.params('id')"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: hero is deleted
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
                '404':
                  description: hero is not found
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
              parameters:
              - in: path
                name: id
                type: number
                required: true
              summary: Delete a hero
          /api/heroes:
            put:
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: Updated hero
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
              parameters:
              - in: body
                name: hero
                required: true
                schema:
                  $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
              produces:
              - application/json
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/UpdateItem"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                        "TableName": "${HeroesTable}",
                        "Key": {
                          "id": {
                            "N": $input.json('$.id')
                          }
                        },
                        "UpdateExpression": "SET #n = :p",
                        "ExpressionAttributeValues": {
                          ":p": { "S" : $input.json('$.name') }
                        },
                        "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#n":"name"}
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              summary: Update a hero
              consumes:
              - application/json
            post:
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: New hero
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
              parameters:
              - in: body
                name: hero
                required: true
                schema:
                  $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
              produces:
              - application/json
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                        "TableName": "${HeroesTable}",
                        "Item": {
                            "id": {
                                "N": $input.json('$.id')
                            },
                            "name": {
                                "S": $input.json('$.name')
                            }
                        }
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              summary: Add a new hero
              consumes:
              - application/json
            get:
              x-amazon-apigateway-integration:
                passthroughBehavior: when_no_templates
                responses:
                  default:
                    responseTemplates:
                      application/json: |-
                        [
                        #foreach ($item in $input.path('$.Items'))
                        {
                            "id": "$item.id.N",
                            "name": "$item.name.S"
                        }
                        #if($foreach.hasNext), #end
                        #end
                        ]
                    statusCode: '200'
                uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan"
                httpMethod: POST
                requestTemplates:
                  application/json: !Sub |
                    {
                        "TableName": "${HeroesTable}"
                    }
                credentials: !GetAtt APIGatewayRole.Arn
                type: aws
              summary: Return a list of heroes
              responses:
                '200':
                  description: Return a list of heroes
                  headers:
                    Content-Type:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Headers:
                      type: string
                    Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
                      type: string
                  schema:
                    $ref: '#/definitions/Heroes'
              produces:
              - application/json
        swagger: '2.0'
        schemes:
        - https
        definitions:
          Heroes:
            type: array
            items:
              $ref: '#/definitions/Hero'
          Hero:
            type: object
            required:
            - id
            - name
            properties:
              id:
                type: number
              name:
                type: string

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: TAMS API Cognito Stack

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: True
          Mutable: True
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: True
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Priority: 1
            Name: verified_email

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - ${AWS::AccountId}-tams-${id}
        - id: !Select [4, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split [/, !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Name: tams-api
      Identifier: tams-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access
        - ScopeName: delete
          ScopeDescription: Delete access

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-all-scopes
      GenerateSecret: True
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AuthSessionValidity: 3
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: True
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - tams-api/admin
        - tams-api/read
        - tams-api/write
        - tams-api/delete

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  TokenUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token

  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: False
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-0

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref AWS::Region
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Private1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: False
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-1

  PrivateRouteTable0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-0

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  DynamoDbEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
        - id: W9
          reason: VPC cidr only
        - id: W29
          reason: Not relevant.
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      GroupDescription: Endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
          Description: Disallow all traffic
          IpProtocol: "-1"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - CidrIp: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig,  VPC, CIDR]
          Description: https only inbound
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443

  SqsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sqs
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet0
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  EventsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet0
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet0
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: The Id of the Vpc
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  VpcAZs:
    Description: The AWS AZs used by this VPC
    Value: !Join [",", [!GetAtt PrivateSubnet0.AvailabilityZone, !GetAtt PrivateSubnet1.AvailabilityZone]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: SubnetId of private subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet0, !Ref PrivateSubnet1]]

cfn_description: Amazon Cognito User Pool for Vespa Sales Agent authentication
content:
# Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. All Rights Reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Cognito User Pool for Vespa Sales Agent authentication

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: vespa-sales-agent
  FrontendUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Amazon CloudFront frontend URL (added after frontend deployment)

Conditions:
  HasFrontendUrl: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FrontendUrl, '']]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-users'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        # NOTE: localhost URLs are for local development only and should be
        # removed before production deployment. The CloudFront HTTPS URL
        # is added via stack update after frontend deployment.
        - http://localhost:3000/callback
        - !If [HasFrontendUrl, !Sub '${FrontendUrl}/callback', !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000
        - !If [HasFrontendUrl, !Ref FrontendUrl, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agent-platform-id/service
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: agent-platform-id
      Name: Agent Platform
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: service
          ScopeDescription: Service-to-service access

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Amazon Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Amazon Cognito domain prefix
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
  WebClientId:
    Description: Web client ID (Authorization Code flow)
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  M2MClientId:
    Description: M2M client ID (Client Credentials flow)
    Value: !Ref M2MClient

cfn_description: AnyCompany Hotel - WAF WebACL (CLOUDFRONT scope) with AWS Managed Rules and rate limiting for the frontend distribution.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AnyCompany Hotel - WAF WebACL (CLOUDFRONT scope) with AWS Managed Rules
  and rate limiting for the frontend distribution.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]

Resources:
  ##############################################################################
  # WAF WebACL
  ##############################################################################
  WebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-web-acl
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      Description: !Sub WAF WebACL for AnyCompany ${Environment} CloudFront distribution
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-web-acl
      Rules:
        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Common Rule Set
        # Broad coverage: OWASP Top 10 categories, suspicious request bodies,
        # generic bot signatures.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-common-rules

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Known Bad Inputs
        # Catches malformed payloads and exploit-pattern probes.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-bad-inputs

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — SQL injection
        # Defense in depth on top of parameterized queries — the booking
        # and PMS APIs touch Aurora through psycopg with parameterized
        # statements, but a misconfigured handler is one PR away.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          Priority: 3
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-sqli

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Amazon IP Reputation
        # Blocks IPs Amazon has identified as the source of attacks. Free
        # add-on; reduces background noise from credential-stuffing botnets
        # before our custom rate limit even sees them.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 4
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-ip-reputation

        ##################################################################
        # Rate Limiting — global per-IP fallback for CloudFront-fronted
        # traffic (the frontend SPAs). The API Gateway stages are protected
        # separately by the regional WebACL in waf-regional.yaml, so this
        # CloudFront-scope ACL only needs to cover the static frontends.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: RateLimitPerIP
          Priority: 5
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rate-limit
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  WebACLArn:
    Description: WAF WebACL ARN for CloudFront association
    Value: !GetAtt WebACL.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WebACLArn

cfn_description: AnyCompany Hotel - WAF WebACL (REGIONAL scope) for the REST API Gateways. The CLOUDFRONT-scoped WebACL in waf.yaml protects the frontend distributions and CANNOT be reused here: WAFv2 scope is immutab
trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0017", "severity": "LOW", "title": "CloudWatch log groups should be encrypted using CMK", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Log group is not encrypted.", "resolution": "Enable CMK encryption of CloudWatch Log Groups", "resource": "tmpr61v_78o.yaml:171-175", "query": "data.builtin.aws.cloudwatch.aws0017.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AnyCompany Hotel - WAF WebACL (REGIONAL scope) for the REST API Gateways.
  The CLOUDFRONT-scoped WebACL in waf.yaml protects the frontend distributions
  and CANNOT be reused here: WAFv2 scope is immutable and CLOUDFRONT vs REGIONAL
  ACLs are distinct resources. This ACL is associated with both REST API stages
  from the root template (the association resources live there because they need
  the REST API ids). Managed rule groups BLOCK by default (one CommonRuleSet
  sub-rule, SizeRestrictions_BODY, is held to COUNT to avoid false-positives on
  large booking payloads); the two rate-limit rules BLOCK directly.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]

Resources:
  RegionalWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-web-acl
      Scope: REGIONAL
      Description: !Sub WAF WebACL for AnyCompany ${Environment} REST API Gateways
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-web-acl
      Rules:
        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Common Rule Set        [BLOCK mode]
        # Broad OWASP coverage (XSS, path traversal, LFI/RFI, bad UA, etc.),
        # blocking by default. One sub-rule is held back to COUNT via
        # RuleActionOverrides: SizeRestrictions_BODY flags any request body
        # over 8 KB (a fixed AWS threshold), which legitimate multi-guest /
        # multi-room booking payloads and large Cognito JWTs can exceed — so
        # blocking it would 403 real bookings. The rest of the group blocks.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
              RuleActionOverrides:
                - Name: SizeRestrictions_BODY
                  ActionToUse:
                    Count: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-common-rules

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Known Bad Inputs       [BLOCK mode]
        # Deployed in Block (not Count): this group targets exploit
        # signatures (host-header injection, malformed requests, known
        # JNDI/lookup payloads) that have no legitimate match in this API's
        # traffic, so the false-positive risk that keeps CommonRuleSet in
        # Count does not apply here. None lets the group's own rule actions
        # (Block) stand.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-bad-inputs

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — SQL injection          [BLOCK mode]
        # Signature-based SQLi detection; no legitimate request matches, so
        # this blocks by default (no false-positive carve-out needed).
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          Priority: 3
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-sqli

        ##################################################################
        # AWS Managed Rules — Amazon IP Reputation   [BLOCK mode]
        # Blocks source IPs on Amazon's threat-intel reputation lists;
        # blocks by default (no legitimate-traffic carve-out needed).
        ##################################################################
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 4
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-ip-reputation

        ##################################################################
        # Rate limit — Stripe webhook                [BLOCK]
        # 100 requests / 5 min per IP, scoped to POST /webhooks/stripe.
        # Stripe sends a handful per second under load; 100/5min is ~20x
        # headroom, protecting the public webhook endpoint (which relies on
        # signature verification for authenticity) from flooding. BLOCK
        # directly: it's our own threshold, not a managed-rule false-positive
        # risk.
        ##################################################################
        - Name: RateLimitStripeWebhook
          Priority: 5
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 100
              EvaluationWindowSec: 300
              AggregateKeyType: IP
              ScopeDownStatement:
                ByteMatchStatement:
                  SearchString: /webhooks/stripe
                  FieldToMatch:
                    UriPath: {}
                  PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
                  TextTransformations:
                    - Priority: 0
                      Type: NONE
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-stripe-rate-limit

        ##################################################################
        # Rate limit — global per-IP fallback        [BLOCK]
        # 2000 requests / 5 min per IP, everything else. Mirrors the
        # CloudFront WebACL's fallback. BLOCK directly (our own threshold).
        ##################################################################
        - Name: RateLimitPerIP
          Priority: 6
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-rest-rate-limit
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # WAF logging to CloudWatch Logs. The log group name MUST start with
  # "aws-waf-logs-" for WAFv2 to accept it as a logging destination.
  RegionalWebACLLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub aws-waf-logs-anycompany-${Environment}-rest
      RetentionInDays: 30

  RegionalWebACLLogging:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::LoggingConfiguration
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !GetAtt RegionalWebACL.Arn
      LogDestinationConfigs:
        - !GetAtt RegionalWebACLLogGroup.Arn

Outputs:
  RegionalWebACLArn:
    Description: Regional WAF WebACL ARN for REST API stage association
    Value: !GetAtt RegionalWebACL.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RegionalWebACLArn

cfn_description: AnyCompany Hotel - Cognito User Pool for guest and staff authentication with email sign-in and custom guest_id attribute.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AnyCompany Hotel - Cognito User Pool for guest and staff authentication
  with email sign-in and custom guest_id attribute.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]

Resources:
  ##############################################################################
  # Cognito User Pool
  ##############################################################################
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    # Sample default: delete with the stack so teardown leaves no orphaned pool.
    # PRODUCTION should change both back to `Retain` to protect user accounts.
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-user-pool
      # PLUS tier enables Cognito threat protection (advanced security
      # features): compromised-credentials detection, adaptive auth, and
      # the ability to associate a regional WAF with the user pool. Costs
      # ~$0.02/MAU above ESSENTIALS plus ~$0.05/MAU for threat protection.
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      # ⚠️ NO MFA IS ENFORCED. Staff/admin users authenticate with
      # username + password only. This is acceptable for a demo environment,
      # but production deployments should add MFA for staff accounts by
      # enabling MfaConfiguration + EnabledMfas: [SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA].
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        # Property-scoped staff users carry their assigned property here.
        # Chain-level users (Admin, Manager, RevenueManager) leave it unset.
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        # Regional managers carry their region here. Chain-level users leave
        # it unset; property-scoped users derive their region via FK lookup.
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  ##############################################################################
  # User Pool Client (SPA — no secret)
  ##############################################################################
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-spa-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      # Public SPA client: browser auth only. Guest + staff SPAs use SRP
      # exclusively (the password never leaves the client). The admin
      # username/password flow lives on the dedicated AdminAuthClient below,
      # which is NOT embedded in any frontend bundle.
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # Dedicated client for server-side username/password auth (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH).
  # Used only by non-browser callers — the activity simulator and the integration/
  # contract test harnesses (which authenticate as seeded service users via
  # AdminInitiateAuth). It is NOT embedded in any frontend bundle, so the public
  # SPA client can stay SRP-only. GenerateSecret is false so callers don't need
  # to compute a SECRET_HASH. ReadAttributes/WriteAttributes mirror the SPA client
  # so custom:property_id / custom:region flow into the issued tokens — required
  # for property-scoped staff/service users to work.
  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-${Environment}-admin-auth-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  ##############################################################################
  # PMS Staff Groups
  ##############################################################################
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Chain-level full access to all properties and operations

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Chain or property-level management access

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Regional oversight and reporting

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Chain-wide analytics and revenue reporting

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Property-level front desk operations

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Property-level housekeeping task management

  ##############################################################################
  # M2M (Machine-to-Machine) OAuth2 Client
  ##############################################################################
  M2MResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: anycompany-pms
      Name: AnyCompany Hotel PMS API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to PMS resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to PMS resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access

  M2MAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: M2MResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-pms-m2m-${Environment}"
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - anycompany-pms/read
        - anycompany-pms/write
        - anycompany-pms/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ##############################################################################
  # User Pool Domain (required for OAuth2 token endpoint)
  ##############################################################################
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-pms-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID (SPA)
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId

  AdminAuthClientId:
    Description: Cognito client ID for server-side ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH (simulator + test harnesses; not browser-facing)
    Value: !Ref AdminAuthClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AdminAuthClientId

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn

  M2MClientId:
    Description: M2M App Client ID for service-to-service auth
    Value: !Ref M2MAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-M2MClientId

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Domain for OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainUrl

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
Resources:
  #######################

  #######################

  cognitoAuthRole:

          - Effect: "Allow"

                  - "kinesisvideo:Get*"
                  - "kinesisvideo:List*"
                  - "rekognition:DetectLabels"
                Resource:
                  - "*"
  cognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: 'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref PibotIDPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":

      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoUnauthorizedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: "*"
  # Cognito IoT Provisioning Roles
  cognitoProvAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "PiBot_prov_cogAuth_role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: 'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref ProvisioningIDPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoAuthorizedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                  - "cognito-identity:*"
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: "iot-trusted-user-provisioning"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "iot:CreateProvisioningClaim"
                  - "iot:AttachPrincipalPolicy"
                  - "iot:ListProvisioningTemplates"
                  - "iot:DescribeEndpoint"
                Resource:
                  - "*"
  cognitoProvUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "PiBot_prov_cogUNAuth_role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: 'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref ProvisioningIDPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoUnauthorizedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: "*"
  ###################################
  # Cognito
  ###################################
  PiBotUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "pibot-userpool"
      Schema:
      - Name: name
        AttributeDataType: String
        Mutable: true
        Required: true
      - Name: email
        AttributeDataType: String
        Mutable: false
        Required: true
  PibotUserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: pibot_client
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotUserPool
  PibotIDPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: pibot_id_pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PibotUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PiBotUserPool.ProviderName
  PibotIDRoleMap:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PibotIDPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt cognitoUnauthRole.Arn
        authenticated: !GetAtt cognitoAuthRole.Arn
  # Cognito for IoT Trusted User Provisioning
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "provisioning-userpool"
      Schema:
      - Name: name
        AttributeDataType: String
        Mutable: true
        Required: true
      - Name: email
        AttributeDataType: String
        Mutable: false
        Required: true
  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: provisioning_client
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
  ProvisioningIDPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: provisioning_id_pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
  PibotProvIDRoleMap:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIDPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt cognitoProvUnauthRole.Arn
        authenticated: !GetAtt cognitoProvAuthRole.Arn
#####################################################
# Outputs
#####################################################
Outputs:
  cognitoIdPoolIdweb:
    Description: 'Identity Pool ID for Cognito auth for the main web app'
    Value: !Ref PibotIDPool
  cognitoUserPoolIdweb:
    Description: 'UserPool ID for Cognito auth for the main web app'
    Value: !Ref PiBotUserPool
  cognitoClientIdweb:
    Description: 'UserPool client ID for the main web app'
    Value: !Ref PibotUserPoolClient
  cognitoIdPoolIdprov:
    Description: 'Identity Pool ID for Cognito auth for the Trusted User Provisioning web app'
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningIDPool
  cognitoUserPoolprov:
    Description: 'UserPool Pool ID for Cognito auth for the Trusted User Provisioning web app'
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
  cognitoClientIdprov:
    Description: 'UserPool client ID for the Trusted User Provisioning web app'
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmptgo0f93l.yaml:191-199", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Financial Product Launch System with Cognito authentication'
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Cognito Configuration
        Parameters:
          - UserPoolName
          - MachineAppClientName
          - WebAppClientName

Parameters:

  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ProductLaunchGatewayPool'
    Description: 'Name of the Cognito User Pool'

  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ProductLaunchMachineClient'
    Description: 'Name of the Cognito User Pool Application Client'

  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ProductLaunchWebClient'
    Description: 'Name of the Cognito User Pool Web Application Client'

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email  # <--- Use email as username
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email  # <--- Auto-verify email if you want to skip confirmation step
      # LambdaConfig:
      #   PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostSignupFunction.Arn

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrator group for product managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1  # Higher priority (lower number = higher precedence)

  ProductManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: product_manager
      Description: Product manager group
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2

  ComplianceGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: compliance
      Description: Compliance team group
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3

  WebUserPoolClient:
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false  # Don't use secret for SPA or web apps
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Join
            - ''
            - - 'default-m2m-resource-server-'
              - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
              - '/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Join
          - ''
          - - 'default-m2m-resource-server-'
            - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
            - '/read'
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Join
        - '-'
        - - 'default-m2m-resource-server'
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Name: !Join
        - '-'
        - - 'Default M2M Resource Server '
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: 'read'
          ScopeDescription: 'An example scope created by Amazon Cognito quick start'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'productlaunch-'
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
          - '-'
          - !Select [1, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  PostSignupFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowBasicLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: Cognito
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostSignupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.13
      Role: !GetAtt PostSignupFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

              # Add user to 'product_manager' group by default
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName='product_manager'
                  )
                  print(f"User {username} added to 'product_manager' group.")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error adding user to group: {e}")

              return event

  CognitoMachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineUserPoolClient
      Description: Machine Cognito client ID
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoWebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebUserPoolClient
      Description: Cognito client ID for web app
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito client ID
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/cognito_auth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Join
        - ''
        - - 'default-m2m-resource-server-'
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
          - '/read'
      Description: OAuth2 scope for Cognito auth
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoDiscoveryURLParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/cognito_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OAuth2 Discovery URL
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoTokenURLParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/cognito_token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: OAuth2 Token URL
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoAuthorizeURLParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/cognito_auth_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: OAuth2 Authorization URL
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/productlaunch/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito hosted domain for OAuth2
      Tags:
        Application: ProductLaunch

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AgentCore AG-UI Demo - Cognito User Pool, DynamoDB Table, IAM Roles
  for MCP Server and AG-UI Agent deployed to Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agui-mcp-demo
    Description: Project name used as prefix for all resources
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: testuser@example.com
    Description: Email for the Cognito test user
  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Default: DemoPass123!
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Password for the Cognito test user

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # Cognito User Pool for OAuth Authentication
  # ============================================================
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  # Resource server for machine-to-machine OAuth2 scopes
  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke AgentCore endpoints

  # Machine client (agent-to-gateway, service-to-service)
  CognitoMachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CognitoResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-machine-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-api/invoke'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # Web client (frontend user authentication)
  CognitoWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table for Finance Tracker
  # ============================================================
  FinanceTrackerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-tracker'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE

  # ============================================================
  # IAM Role for MCP Server Runtime
  # ============================================================
  MCPServerRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-server-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MCPServerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceTrackerTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ============================================================
  # IAM Role for AG-UI Agent Runtime
  # ============================================================
  AGUIAgentRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agui-agent-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AGUIAgentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ProjectName}/*'

  # ============================================================
  # SSM Parameters to store resource references
  # ============================================================
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/user-pool-arn'
      Type: String

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/machine-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoMachineClient

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/web-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoWebClient

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/token-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  SSMTableName:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/dynamodb/table-name'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref FinanceTrackerTable

  SSMMCPServerRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/iam/mcp-server-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MCPServerRuntimeRole.Arn

  SSMAGUIAgentRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/iam/agui-agent-role-arn'

      Value: !GetAtt AGUIAgentRuntimeRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:

  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
  MachineClientId:
    Value: !Ref CognitoMachineClient
    Description: Machine-to-machine OAuth client ID
  WebClientId:
    Value: !Ref CognitoWebClient
    Description: Web frontend OAuth client ID
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Description: OIDC Discovery URL for JWT validation
  TokenUrl:
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  DynamoDBTableName:

  MCPServerRoleArn:
