cfn_description: Gateway Stack - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Gateway Stack - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration'

# ============================================================================
# TEMPLATE OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================
# This CloudFormation template deploys Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
# with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration for AI agent communication.
#
# Key Components:
# - IAM Role for AgentCore Gateway with Lambda invoke permissions
# - AgentCore Gateway with JWT authorization (Cognito integration)
# - Gateway Target connecting to Lambda function for protein prediction
# - MCP tool schema defining invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
#
# Dependencies:
# - VEP Stack: Requires Lambda function ARN from SSM Parameter Store
# - Cognito Stack: Requires discovery URL and client ID from SSM Parameter Store
#
# Stack Deployment Order:
# 1. VEP Endpoint Stack (creates Lambda, stores ARN in SSM)
# 2. Cognito Stack (creates auth config, stores in SSM)
# 3. Gateway Stack (reads from SSM, creates gateway) <- THIS STACK
#
# Outputs:
# - Gateway URL for MCP client connections
# - Gateway ID and ARN for reference
# - IAM role information
# ============================================================================

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'Project Configuration'
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
      - Label:
          default: 'Gateway Configuration'
        Parameters:
          - GatewayName
          - GatewayDescription
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: 'Project Name'
      GatewayName:
        default: 'Gateway Name'
      GatewayDescription:
        default: 'Gateway Description'

# ============================================================================
# PARAMETERS
# ============================================================================
# Configure Gateway naming and description
# ============================================================================

Parameters:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Project Configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'protein-engineering'
    Description: 'Project name used for resource naming and tagging'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens'

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'Name for the AgentCore Gateway (leave empty to auto-generate from project name)'
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores'

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'AgentCore Gateway for protein engineering agent with MCP integration'
    Description: 'Description for the AgentCore Gateway'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256

# ============================================================================
# CONDITIONS
# ============================================================================
Conditions:
  UseGeneratedGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

# ============================================================================
# RESOURCES
# ============================================================================
Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM ROLE FOR AGENTCORE GATEWAY
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Allows Gateway to invoke Lambda function for protein prediction
  # Uses dynamic SSM reference to get Lambda ARN from VEP stack
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    # Purpose: Grants AgentCore Gateway permission to invoke Lambda function
    # Trust Policy: Only bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com can assume this role
    # Conditions: Restricts to same account and AgentCore service ARNs
    # Permissions: lambda:InvokeFunction on specific Lambda (from SSM)
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: 'Execution role for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke Lambda functions'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'LambdaInvokeAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/lambda-function-arn}}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: Gateway
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM PARAMETER FOR GATEWAY ROLE
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stores Gateway role ARN for reference (optional, for future use)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    # Purpose: Stores Gateway IAM role ARN for reference
    # Usage: Can be used by monitoring or management tools
    Properties:
      Name: '/protein-agent/gateway/role-arn'
      Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role ARN'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Tier: Standard
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AGENTCORE GATEWAY
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main gateway resource that provides MCP endpoint for AI agents
  # Configured with JWT authorization using Cognito
  # Uses dynamic SSM references to retrieve Cognito configuration
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    # Purpose: Creates MCP-compatible gateway for AI agent communication
    # Protocol: MCP (Model Context Protocol) with SEMANTIC search
    # Authorization: CUSTOM_JWT using Cognito for token validation
    # Dynamic References: Retrieves Cognito config from SSM at deployment time
    Properties:
      Name: !If [UseGeneratedGatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway', !Ref GatewayName]
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url}}'
          AllowedClients:
            - '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/cognito/client-id}}'
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SearchType: SEMANTIC
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: Gateway
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GATEWAY TARGET
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Connects Gateway to Lambda function with MCP tool schema
  # Defines invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
  # Uses dynamic SSM reference to retrieve Lambda ARN from VEP stack
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    # Purpose: Connects Gateway to Lambda function for protein prediction
    # Tool Schema: Defines two MCP tools (invoke_endpoint, get_results)
    # Credentials: Uses Gateway IAM role for Lambda invocation
    # Dynamic Reference: Retrieves Lambda ARN from SSM at deployment time
    Properties:
      Name: 'protein-engineering-lambda'
      Description: 'Lambda target for protein variant effect prediction'
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: '{{resolve:ssm:/protein-agent/lambda-function-arn}}'
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: 'invoke_endpoint'
                  Description: 'Submit a job to predict the variant effects for an amino acid sequence'
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: 'object'
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: 'string'
                        Description: 'Amino acid sequence'
                    Required:
                      - 'sequence'
                - Name: 'get_results'
                  Description: 'Check if a variant effect prediction job has completed and retrieve results'
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: 'object'
                    Properties:
                      output_id:
                        Type: 'string'
                        Description: 'output_id returned by invoke_endpoint'
                    Required:
                      - 'output_id'
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUTS
# ============================================================================
# Provides Gateway connection information and resource identifiers
# ============================================================================

Outputs:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Outputs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayId:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway ID'
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayId'

  GatewayUrl:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway MCP URL'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUrl'

  GatewayArn:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayArn'

  # IAM Role Outputs
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role ARN'
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArn'

  GatewayRoleName:
    Description: 'AgentCore Gateway IAM role name'
    Value: !Ref GatewayRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleName'

  # Target Outputs
  TargetId:
    Description: 'Gateway Target ID'
    Value: !Ref GatewayTarget
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetId'

  TargetName:
    Description: 'Gateway Target name'
    Value: 'protein-engineering-lambda'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetName'

  # SSM Parameter Outputs
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: 'SSM Parameter name for Gateway role ARN'
    Value: '/protein-agent/gateway/role-arn'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArnParameter'

  # Configuration Outputs
  ProjectName:
    Description: 'Project name used for resource naming'
    Value: !Ref ProjectName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ProjectName'

  GatewayName:
    Description: 'Gateway name'
    Value: !If [UseGeneratedGatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway', !Ref GatewayName]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayName'

cfn_description: Ask Around Me - Realtime messaging
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Ask Around Me - Realtime messaging

# Learn more:
#  - Creating AWS IoT rules with CloudFormation: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/iot/bites-of-iot-creating-aws-iot-rules-with-aws-cloudformation/
#  - IAM in Cognito User Pools: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/resource-permissions.html
#  - Pub/Sub policy for unauthenticated clients: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/pub-sub-policy.html

Resources:
  ##########################################
  # Resources for realtime messaging       #
  ##########################################
  AskAroundMeRealtime:
    Type: "AWS::IoT::Thing"
    Properties:
      ThingName: "askaroundme-realtime"
      AttributePayload:
        Attributes: {}

  UserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: askAroundMeUserPool
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: false
          Required: true

  # Creates a User Pool Client to be used by the identity pool
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: askAroundMeUserPoolClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Creates a federated Identity pool
  IdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: askAroundMeIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName

  # Create a role for unauthorized access to AWS resources.
  CognitoUnAuthorizedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoUnauthorizedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:cognito-sync:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":identitypool/", !Ref IdentityPool] ]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:iot:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":client/askAroundMe-*" ] ]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Subscribe
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Receive
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:iot:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":topic/*" ] ]

  # Create a role for authorized access to AWS resources.
  CognitoAuthorizedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoAuthorizedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:cognito-sync:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":identitypool/", !Ref IdentityPool] ]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:iot:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":client/askAroundMe-*" ] ]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Subscribe
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Receive
                Resource: !Join [ "", [ "arn:aws:iot:", !Ref "AWS::Region", ":", !Ref "AWS::AccountId", ":topic/*" ] ]

  # Assigns the roles to the Identity Pool
  IdentityPoolRoleMapping:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthorizedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnAuthorizedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IotEndpoint:
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeRealtime

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: template to create AWS WAF v2 Rule group with rate based rule

Parameters:
  HTTPGetFloodRateParam:
    Description: "A Rate-Based Rule looking for a maximum rate of a single IP address can perform HTTP Get requests in 5 minutes"
    Type: Number
    Default: 10000
    MinValue: 100
    MaxValue: 20000000

  HTTPPostLoginParam:
    Description: "Enter the URI for a Login page to rate-limit IP addresses from login attemps. Leave this blank for universal HTTP Post rate-limit"
    Type: String
    Default: login

Resources:
  SampleRuleGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::WAFv2::RuleGroup'
    Properties:
      Name: HTTP-FloodP-Protection
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      Description: HTTPFloodPProtection
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: SampleRateBasedRuleGroupMetrics
      Capacity: 100
      Rules:
        - Name: HTTPFloodPProtection
          Priority: 0
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
              SampledRequestsEnabled: true
              CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
              MetricName: RateBasedGet
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              AggregateKeyType: "IP"
              Limit: !Ref HTTPGetFloodRateParam
              ScopeDownStatement:
                ByteMatchStatement:
                  FieldToMatch:
                    Method: {}
                  PositionalConstraint: EXACTLY
                  SearchString: get
                  TextTransformations:
                    - Priority: 0
                      Type: LOWERCASE
        - Name: HTTPPostFloodPProtection
          Priority: 1
          Action:
            Block: {}
          VisibilityConfig:
              SampledRequestsEnabled: true
              CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
              MetricName: RateBasedPost
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              AggregateKeyType: "IP"
              Limit: !Ref HTTPGetFloodRateParam
              ScopeDownStatement:
                AndStatement:
                  Statements:
                  - ByteMatchStatement:
                      FieldToMatch:
                        UriPath: {}
                      PositionalConstraint: CONTAINS
                      SearchString: !Ref HTTPPostLoginParam
                      TextTransformations:
                        - Priority: 0
                          Type: LOWERCASE
                        - Priority: 1
                          Type: URL_DECODE
                  - ByteMatchStatement:
                      SearchString: post
                      FieldToMatch:
                        Method: {}
                      TextTransformations:
                      - Priority: 0
                        Type: LOWERCASE
                      PositionalConstraint: EXACTLY
Outputs:
  RuleGorupARN:
    Description: RuleGroup Arn
    Value: !GetAtt SampleRuleGroup.Arn

  When any AgentCore agent is created/deleted, CloudWatch threshold-based
  alarms are auto-created/deleted and obs-signals DynamoDB table is updated.

  Deploy: aws cloudformation deploy --template-file template.yaml \
    --stack-name agent-safety-observability-controls --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM

Parameters:
  ObsSignalsTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: observability-signals
    Description: DynamoDB table for observability signals (must exist)

  RegistryTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: agent-registry
    Description: DynamoDB table for agent registry (must exist)

Resources:

  # =========================================================================
  # Auto Alarms Lambda — Creates/deletes CW threshold alarms on agent lifecycle
  # =========================================================================
  AutoAlarmsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutoAlarmsRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutoAlarmsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:PutCompositeAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBObsSignals
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ObsSignalsTableName}'

  AutoAlarmsLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: AutoAlarmsLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutoAlarms'
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt AutoAlarmsLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REGION: !Ref AWS::Region
          OBS_SIGNALS_TABLE: !Ref ObsSignalsTableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,logging,os,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          logger=logging.getLogger();logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          REGION=os.environ.get("REGION","us-east-1")
          OBS_TABLE=os.environ.get("OBS_SIGNALS_TABLE","observability-signals")
          NS="AgentCore/Agents"
          cw=boto3.client("cloudwatch",region_name=REGION)
          ddb=boto3.resource("dynamodb",region_name=REGION)
          DEFS=[
            {"s":"high-latency","m":"InvocationLatency","st":"Average","th":10000,"op":"GreaterThanThreshold","d":"High latency — avg response time > 10s"},
            {"s":"error-rate","m":"InvocationError","st":"Sum","th":5,"op":"GreaterThanThreshold","d":"Error rate — more than 5 errors per period"},
            {"s":"token-usage","m":"TotalTokens","st":"Sum","th":100000,"op":"GreaterThanThreshold","d":"Token usage — over 100k tokens per period"},
            {"s":"invocation-count","m":"InvocationCount","st":"Sum","th":200,"op":"GreaterThanThreshold","d":"Invocation count — over 200 invocations per period"},
          ]
          def _create(name):
              children=[]
              for d in DEFS:
                  an=f"{name}-{d['s']}";children.append(an)
                  try:cw.put_metric_alarm(AlarmName=an,AlarmDescription=f"{d['d']} for {name}",Namespace=NS,MetricName=d["m"],Dimensions=[{"Name":"AgentName","Value":name}],Statistic=d["st"],Period=300,EvaluationPeriods=3,DatapointsToAlarm=2,Threshold=d["th"],ComparisonOperator=d["op"],TreatMissingData="notBreaching")
                  except ClientError as e:logger.error(f"alarm {an}: {e}")
              cn=f"{name}-composite"
              try:cw.put_composite_alarm(AlarmName=cn,AlarmDescription=f"Composite alarm for {name} — monitors latency, errors, tokens, invocations",AlarmRule=" OR ".join(f'ALARM("{n}")' for n in children))
              except ClientError as e:logger.error(f"composite: {e}")
              now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();t=ddb.Table(OBS_TABLE)
              try:t.put_item(Item={"agent_name":name,"signal_key":cn,"alarm_name":cn,"alarm_state":"OK","severity":"low","description":f"Composite alarm for {name} — monitors latency, errors, tokens, invocations","synced_at":now})
              except:pass
              return children+[cn]
          def _delete(name):
              ans=[f"{name}-{d['s']}" for d in DEFS];cn=f"{name}-composite"
              try:cw.delete_alarms(AlarmNames=[cn])
              except:pass
              try:cw.delete_alarms(AlarmNames=ans)
              except:pass
              t=ddb.Table(OBS_TABLE)
              try:
                  for i in t.scan(FilterExpression="agent_name=:n",ExpressionAttributeValues={":n":name}).get("Items",[]):
                      t.delete_item(Key={"agent_name":i["agent_name"],"signal_key":i["signal_key"]})
              except:pass
          def handler(event,context):
              logger.info(json.dumps(event))
              d=event.get("detail",{});en=d.get("eventName","")
              rp=d.get("requestParameters",{});re=d.get("responseElements",{})
              name=rp.get("agentRuntimeName","")
              if not name:
                  rid=rp.get("agentRuntimeId","") or re.get("agentRuntimeId","")
                  if rid:p=rid.rsplit("-",1);name=p[0] if len(p)==2 else rid
              if not name:return{"statusCode":200,"body":"no agent name"}
              if en=="CreateAgentRuntime":a=_create(name);return{"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"action":"created","agent":name,"alarms":a})}
              elif en=="DeleteAgentRuntime":_delete(name);return{"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"action":"deleted","agent":name})}
              return{"statusCode":200,"body":f"unhandled: {en}"}
      Tags:
        - Key: component
          Value: agent-safety-observability-controls

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule — Triggers Auto Alarms Lambda on agent lifecycle
  # =========================================================================
  AgentObsLifecycleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentObsLifecycle'
      Description: Triggers auto alarm creation/deletion on AgentCore runtime events
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.bedrock-agentcore
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreateAgentRuntime
            - DeleteAgentRuntime
      Targets:
        - Id: AutoAlarmsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt AutoAlarmsLambda.Arn

  AutoAlarmsLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AutoAlarmsLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt AgentObsLifecycleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  AutoAlarmsLambdaArn:
    Description: Lambda that auto-creates/deletes CloudWatch anomaly alarms on agent lifecycle
    Value: !GetAtt AutoAlarmsLambda.Arn

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: EventBridge rule that triggers on agent create/delete for observability
    Value: !GetAtt AgentObsLifecycleRule.Arn

  DeployCommand:
    Description: How to deploy this stack
    Value: !Sub 'aws cloudformation deploy --template-file template.yaml --stack-name ${AWS::StackName} --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM'

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Agent Safety — Evaluation Controls Infrastructure.
  Creates: Evaluation Execution Role, Auto Eval Lambda, EventBridge rule.
  When any AgentCore agent or endpoint is created/deleted, evaluations and alarms
  are auto-managed per-endpoint and signals are written to DynamoDB for the dashboard.

Parameters:
  EvalSignalsTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: evaluation-signals
    Description: DynamoDB table for evaluation signals (must exist)

  RegistryTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: agent-registry
    Description: DynamoDB table for agent registry (must exist)

  SamplingPercentage:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100.0
    Description: Percentage of agent traces to evaluate (0.01-100)

  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications (optional)

Resources:

  # =========================================================================
  # Evaluation Execution Role — Used by AgentCore to run evaluations
  # This role is passed to CreateOnlineEvaluationConfig
  # =========================================================================
  EvalExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EvalExecutionRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TrustPolicyStatement
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:ResourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:evaluator/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:online-evaluation-config/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EvalExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogReadStatement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:GetQueryResults
                  - logs:StartQuery
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogWriteStatement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/evaluations/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchIndexPolicyStatement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeIndexPolicies
                  - logs:PutIndexPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:aws/spans'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:aws/spans:*'
              - Sid: BedrockModelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'

  # =========================================================================
  # Auto Eval Lambda — Creates/deletes evaluations on agent lifecycle
  # =========================================================================
  AutoEvalLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutoEvalRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutoEvalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AgentCoreEvaluation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateOnlineEvaluationConfig
                  - bedrock-agentcore:DeleteOnlineEvaluationConfig
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListOnlineEvaluationConfigs
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetOnlineEvaluationConfig
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetAgentRuntime
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListAgentRuntimeEndpoints
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBWriteSignals
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${EvalSignalsTableName}'
              - Sid: PassEvalRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt EvalExecutionRole.Arn
              - Sid: CloudWatchIndexPolicy
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeIndexPolicies
                  - logs:PutIndexPolicy
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: STSGetAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  AutoEvalLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: AutoEvalLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutoEval'
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt AutoEvalLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REGION: !Ref AWS::Region
          EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE: !Ref EvalSignalsTableName
          EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt EvalExecutionRole.Arn
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SNSTopicArn
          SAMPLING_PCT: !Ref SamplingPercentage
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, logging, os, boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from botocore.config import Config
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          REGION = os.environ.get("REGION","us-east-1")
          EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE = os.environ.get("EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE","evaluation-signals")
          EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN = os.environ.get("EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN","")
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get("SNS_TOPIC_ARN","")
          SAMPLING_PCT = float(os.environ.get("SAMPLING_PCT","100.0"))
          retry = Config(retries={"max_attempts":3,"mode":"adaptive"})
          ac = boto3.client("bedrock-agentcore-control",region_name=REGION,config=retry)
          cw = boto3.client("cloudwatch",region_name=REGION,config=retry)
          ddb = boto3.resource("dynamodb",region_name=REGION)
          EVALS = ["Builtin.Harmfulness","Builtin.Correctness","Builtin.Helpfulness","Builtin.GoalSuccessRate","Builtin.ToolSelectionAccuracy","Builtin.ToolParameterAccuracy","Builtin.Faithfulness"]
          NS = "Bedrock-AgentCore/Evaluations"

          def _resolve_name(rid):
              """Resolve agent name from runtime ID. Uses API first, then extracts from ARN."""
              try:
                  r = ac.get_agent_runtime(agentRuntimeId=rid)
                  return r.get("agentRuntimeName","")
              except ClientError as e:
                  logger.warning(f"GetAgentRuntime failed for {rid}: {e}")
                  # Fallback: runtime ID format is {agent_name}-{10_random_chars}
                  # Only use this if the pattern matches (name part + hyphen + exactly 10 alphanum)
                  import re
                  m = re.match(r'^(.+)-[a-zA-Z0-9]{10}$', rid)
                  if m:
                      return m.group(1)
                  return ""

          def _cfg_name(name, ep):
              # Eval config name must match [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,47}
              # Replace hyphens with underscores, truncate to 48 chars
              safe_name = name.replace("-","_")
              safe_ep = ep.replace("-","_")
              if ep=="DEFAULT": return f"eval_{safe_name}"[:48]
              return f"eval_{safe_name}_{safe_ep}"[:48]

          def _alarm_name(name, ep):
              if ep=="DEFAULT": return f"AgentSafety-Eval-{name}"
              return f"AgentSafety-Eval-{name}-{ep}"

          def _sig_key(key, ep):
              if ep=="DEFAULT": return key
              return f"{key}#{ep}"

          def _create_eval(name, rid, ep):
              cn = _cfg_name(name, ep)
              # Log group pattern: [.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+
              lg = f"/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/{rid}-{ep}"
              # Service name pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+
              sn = f"{name}.{ep}"
              eid = ""
              try:
                  r = ac.create_online_evaluation_config(onlineEvaluationConfigName=cn,description=f"Auto eval for {name}/{ep}",rule={"samplingConfig":{"samplingPercentage":SAMPLING_PCT},"sessionConfig":{"sessionTimeoutMinutes":15}},dataSourceConfig={"cloudWatchLogs":{"logGroupNames":[lg],"serviceNames":[sn]}},evaluators=[{"evaluatorId":e} for e in EVALS],evaluationExecutionRoleArn=EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN,enableOnCreate=True)
                  eid = r.get("onlineEvaluationConfigId","")
                  logger.info(f"Eval config created: {eid} for {name}/{ep}")
              except ClientError as e:
                  if "ConflictException" in str(e): logger.info(f"Eval exists: {cn}")
                  else: logger.error(f"Eval create failed: {e}")
              return eid, cn

          def _create_alarm(name, ep):
              sn = f"{name}.{ep}"
              an = _alarm_name(name, ep)
              try:
                  mq = [{"Id":"h","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Harmfulness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Harmful"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"c1","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Correctness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Incorrect"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"c2","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Correctness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Partially Correct"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"g","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.GoalSuccessRate","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"No"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"u1","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Helpfulness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Not Helpful At All"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"u2","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Helpfulness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Very Unhelpful"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"f1","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Faithfulness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Not At All"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"f2","MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":NS,"MetricName":"Builtin.Faithfulness","Dimensions":[{"Name":"service.name","Value":sn},{"Name":"label","Value":"Not Generally"}]},"Period":3600,"Stat":"Sum"},"ReturnData":False},{"Id":"total","Expression":"FILL(h,0)+FILL(c1,0)+FILL(c2,0)+FILL(g,0)+FILL(u1,0)+FILL(u2,0)+FILL(f1,0)+FILL(f2,0)","Label":"Total Bad","ReturnData":True}]
                  ak = {"AlarmName":an,"AlarmDescription":f"Agent quality alarm for {name}/{ep}.","Metrics":mq,"EvaluationPeriods":1,"Threshold":1,"ComparisonOperator":"GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold","TreatMissingData":"notBreaching"}
                  if SNS_TOPIC_ARN: ak["AlarmActions"]=[SNS_TOPIC_ARN]; ak["OKActions"]=[SNS_TOPIC_ARN]
                  cw.put_metric_alarm(**ak)
                  logger.info(f"Alarm created: {an}")
              except ClientError as e: logger.error(f"Alarm failed: {e}")

          def _write_signals(name, ep, eid, cn):
              now = datetime.now(timezone.utc); exp = int(now.timestamp())+86400; t = ddb.Table(EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE)
              an = _alarm_name(name, ep)
              try: t.put_item(Item={"agent_name":name,"signal_key":_sig_key("alarm_summary",ep),"endpoint":ep,"alarm_name":an,"alarm_state":"INSUFFICIENT_DATA","alarm_reason":"Waiting for evaluation data","alarm_updated_at":now.isoformat(),"eval_config_id":eid,"eval_config_name":cn,"evaluator_count":len(EVALS),"sampling_pct":str(SAMPLING_PCT),"severity":"medium","synced_at":now.isoformat(),"expires_at":exp})
              except ClientError as e: logger.warning(f"DDB write failed: {e}")
              for ev in EVALS:
                  try: t.put_item(Item={"agent_name":name,"signal_key":_sig_key(ev,ep),"endpoint":ep,"evaluator_name":ev.replace("Builtin.",""),"bad_count":0,"good_count":0,"total_count":0,"bad_pct":"0.0","severity":"low","description":f"{ev.replace('Builtin.','')}: waiting for data","config_name":cn,"synced_at":now.isoformat(),"expires_at":exp})
                  except: pass

          def _delete_signals_ep(name, ep):
              t = ddb.Table(EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE)
              suffix = f"#{ep}" if ep != "DEFAULT" else ""
              try:
                  for i in t.scan().get("Items",[]):
                      if i.get("agent_name") != name: continue
                      sk = i.get("signal_key","")
                      if ep == "DEFAULT" and "#" not in sk:
                          t.delete_item(Key={"agent_name":name,"signal_key":sk})
                      elif ep != "DEFAULT" and sk.endswith(suffix):
                          t.delete_item(Key={"agent_name":name,"signal_key":sk})
              except: pass

          def _delete_all_configs(name):
              prefix = f"eval_{name}"
              try:
                  cfgs = []
                  for pg in ac.get_paginator("list_online_evaluation_configs").paginate():
                      cfgs.extend(pg.get("onlineEvaluationConfigs",[]))
                  for cfg in cfgs:
                      cn = cfg.get("onlineEvaluationConfigName","")
                      if cn == prefix[:48] or cn.startswith(f"{prefix}_"):
                          try: ac.delete_online_evaluation_config(onlineEvaluationConfigId=cfg["onlineEvaluationConfigId"]); logger.info(f"Deleted config: {cn}")
                          except ClientError: pass
              except ClientError as e: logger.warning(f"List configs failed: {e}")

          def _delete_all_alarms(name):
              prefix = f"AgentSafety-Eval-{name}"
              try:
                  ans = []
                  for pg in cw.get_paginator("describe_alarms").paginate(AlarmNamePrefix=prefix,AlarmTypes=["MetricAlarm"]):
                      for a in pg.get("MetricAlarms",[]): ans.append(a["AlarmName"])
                  if ans:
                      for i in range(0,len(ans),100): cw.delete_alarms(AlarmNames=ans[i:i+100])
                      logger.info(f"Deleted {len(ans)} alarms for {name}")
              except ClientError: pass

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              detail = event.get("detail",{})
              en = detail.get("eventName","")
              rp = detail.get("requestParameters",{})
              re = detail.get("responseElements",{})

              if en in ("CreateAgentRuntime","DeleteAgentRuntime"):
                  name = rp.get("agentRuntimeName","")
                  rid = rp.get("agentRuntimeId","") or re.get("agentRuntimeId","")
                  if not name and rid:
                      p = rid.rsplit("-",1)
                      name = p[0] if len(p)==2 else rid
                  if not name: return {"statusCode":200,"body":"no agent name"}

                  if en == "CreateAgentRuntime":
                      if not EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN: return {"statusCode":500,"body":"missing role"}
                      ep = "DEFAULT"
                      eid, cn = _create_eval(name, rid, ep)
                      _create_alarm(name, ep)
                      _write_signals(name, ep, eid, cn)
                      return {"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"status":"created","agent_name":name,"endpoint":ep,"eval_config_id":eid})}
                  else:
                      _delete_all_configs(name)
                      _delete_all_alarms(name)
                      t = ddb.Table(EVAL_SIGNALS_TABLE)
                      try:
                          for i in t.scan().get("Items",[]):
                              if i.get("agent_name")==name: t.delete_item(Key={"agent_name":i["agent_name"],"signal_key":i["signal_key"]})
                      except: pass
                      return {"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"status":"deleted","agent_name":name})}

              elif en in ("CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint","DeleteAgentRuntimeEndpoint"):
                  rid = rp.get("agentRuntimeId","") or re.get("agentRuntimeId","")
                  ep = rp.get("name","") or re.get("endpointName","")
                  # CloudTrail may mask name/endpointName with ***. Extract from ARN as fallback.
                  if not ep or ep == "***":
                      ep_arn = re.get("agentRuntimeEndpointArn","")
                      if "/runtime-endpoint/" in ep_arn:
                          ep = ep_arn.rsplit("/runtime-endpoint/",1)[-1]
                  if not rid: return {"statusCode":200,"body":"no agentRuntimeId"}
                  if not ep or ep == "***": return {"statusCode":200,"body":"no endpoint name (masked by CloudTrail)"}
                  if ep == "DEFAULT": return {"statusCode":200,"body":"DEFAULT handled by runtime event"}
                  # Resolve agent name — try API first, then extract from agentRuntimeArn in event
                  name = _resolve_name(rid)
                  if not name:
                      # Extract from ARN: arn:...:runtime/{runtimeId} → runtimeId → parse agent name
                      rt_arn = re.get("agentRuntimeArn","")
                      if "/runtime/" in rt_arn:
                          rid_from_arn = rt_arn.rsplit("/runtime/",1)[-1]
                          import re as re_mod
                          m = re_mod.match(r'^(.+)-[a-zA-Z0-9]{10}$', rid_from_arn)
                          if m: name = m.group(1)
                  if not name: return {"statusCode":200,"body":f"cannot resolve name for {rid}"}

                  if en == "CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint":
                      if not EVAL_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN: return {"statusCode":500,"body":"missing role"}
                      eid, cn = _create_eval(name, rid, ep)
                      _create_alarm(name, ep)
                      _write_signals(name, ep, eid, cn)
                      return {"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"status":"created","agent_name":name,"endpoint":ep,"eval_config_id":eid})}
                  else:
                      cn = _cfg_name(name, ep)
                      try:
                          for pg in ac.get_paginator("list_online_evaluation_configs").paginate():
                              for cfg in pg.get("onlineEvaluationConfigs",[]):
                                  if cfg.get("onlineEvaluationConfigName","")==cn:
                                      ac.delete_online_evaluation_config(onlineEvaluationConfigId=cfg["onlineEvaluationConfigId"])
                      except: pass
                      try: cw.delete_alarms(AlarmNames=[_alarm_name(name,ep)])
                      except: pass
                      _delete_signals_ep(name, ep)
                      return {"statusCode":200,"body":json.dumps({"status":"deleted","agent_name":name,"endpoint":ep})}

              return {"statusCode":200,"body":f"unhandled: {en}"}
      Tags:
        - Key: component
          Value: agent-safety-evaluations

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule — Triggers Auto Eval Lambda on agent lifecycle
  # =========================================================================
  AgentEvalLifecycleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AgentEvalLifecycle'
      Description: Triggers auto evaluation creation/deletion on AgentCore runtime and endpoint events
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.bedrock-agentcore
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreateAgentRuntime
            - DeleteAgentRuntime
            - CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint
            - DeleteAgentRuntimeEndpoint
      Targets:
        - Id: AutoEvalTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt AutoEvalLambda.Arn

  AutoEvalLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AutoEvalLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt AgentEvalLifecycleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  EvalExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN used by AgentCore to run evaluations
    Value: !GetAtt EvalExecutionRole.Arn

  AutoEvalLambdaArn:
    Description: Lambda that auto-creates evaluations when agents are deployed
    Value: !GetAtt AutoEvalLambda.Arn

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: EventBridge rule that triggers on agent create/delete
    Value: !GetAtt AgentEvalLifecycleRule.Arn

cfn_description:
AVA Govern IAM Role - Read-only access for the Agentic Value Accelerator
governance platform. Deploy this stack before launching AVA Govern.

This role follows AWS security best practices:
- Least pri
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  AVA Govern IAM Role - Read-only access for the Agentic Value Accelerator
  governance platform. Deploy this stack before launching AVA Govern.

  This role follows AWS security best practices:
  - Least privilege (read-only, scoped to specific services)
  - No long-lived credentials (uses IAM roles with auto-rotating tokens)
  - Supports ECS, EKS, EC2, Lambda, and App Runner deployments

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Deployment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ComputeType
          - EnableCostExplorer
          - EnableBedrock
          - EnableCloudWatch
          - EnableCloudTrail
    ParameterLabels:
      ComputeType:
        default: Where will AVA Govern run?
      EnableCostExplorer:
        default: Enable FinOps (Cost Explorer)?
      EnableBedrock:
        default: Enable Bedrock governance?
      EnableCloudWatch:
        default: Enable observability (CloudWatch)?
      EnableCloudTrail:
        default: Enable audit trail (CloudTrail)?

Parameters:
  ComputeType:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs
    AllowedValues:
      - ecs
      - eks
      - ec2
      - lambda
      - apprunner
    Description: The compute service where AVA Govern will run

  EnableCostExplorer:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow AVA Govern to read Cost Explorer data for FinOps dashboards

  EnableBedrock:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow AVA Govern to read Bedrock agents, models, guardrails, and knowledge bases

  EnableCloudWatch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow AVA Govern to read CloudWatch metrics and logs

  EnableCloudTrail:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow AVA Govern to read CloudTrail events for audit

Conditions:
  IsECS: !Equals [!Ref ComputeType, 'ecs']
  IsEKS: !Equals [!Ref ComputeType, 'eks']
  IsEC2: !Equals [!Ref ComputeType, 'ec2']
  IsLambda: !Equals [!Ref ComputeType, 'lambda']
  IsAppRunner: !Equals [!Ref ComputeType, 'apprunner']
  NeedsInstanceProfile: !Or [!Condition IsEC2, !Condition IsECS]

  UseCostExplorer: !Equals [!Ref EnableCostExplorer, 'true']
  UseBedrock: !Equals [!Ref EnableBedrock, 'true']
  UseCloudWatch: !Equals [!Ref EnableCloudWatch, 'true']
  UseCloudTrail: !Equals [!Ref EnableCloudTrail, 'true']

Resources:
  AVAGovernRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AVAGovernRole
      Description: Read-only role for AVA Govern platform
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # ECS Tasks
          - !If
            - IsECS
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          # EC2 Instances
          - !If
            - IsEC2
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          # Lambda Functions
          - !If
            - IsLambda
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          # App Runner
          - !If
            - IsAppRunner
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AVA-Govern
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Cost Explorer Policy
  CostExplorerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseCostExplorer
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AVAGovernCostExplorer
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CostExplorerRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ce:GetCostAndUsage
              - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
              - ce:GetCostForecast
              - ce:GetDimensionValues
              - ce:GetReservationCoverage
              - ce:GetReservationPurchaseRecommendation
              - ce:GetReservationUtilization
              - ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage
              - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
              - ce:GetTags
              - ce:GetUsageForecast
              - ce:ListCostAllocationTags
              - ce:ListCostCategoryDefinitions
            Resource: '*'

  # Bedrock Policy
  BedrockPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseBedrock
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AVAGovernBedrock
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # Bedrock Agents
          - Sid: BedrockAgentsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListAgents
              - bedrock:GetAgent
              - bedrock:ListAgentVersions
              - bedrock:GetAgentVersion
              - bedrock:ListAgentAliases
              - bedrock:GetAgentAlias
              - bedrock:ListAgentActionGroups
              - bedrock:GetAgentActionGroup
              - bedrock:ListAgentKnowledgeBases
              - bedrock:GetAgentKnowledgeBase
            Resource: '*'

          # Bedrock Models
          - Sid: BedrockModelsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListFoundationModels
              - bedrock:GetFoundationModel
              - bedrock:ListCustomModels
              - bedrock:GetCustomModel
              - bedrock:ListModelCustomizationJobs
              - bedrock:GetModelCustomizationJob
              - bedrock:ListProvisionedModelThroughputs
              - bedrock:GetProvisionedModelThroughput
              - bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles
              - bedrock:GetInferenceProfile
            Resource: '*'

          # Bedrock Guardrails
          - Sid: BedrockGuardrailsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListGuardrails
              - bedrock:GetGuardrail
              - bedrock:GetGuardrailPolicy
            Resource: '*'

          # Bedrock Knowledge Bases
          - Sid: BedrockKnowledgeBasesRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListKnowledgeBases
              - bedrock:GetKnowledgeBase
              - bedrock:ListDataSources
              - bedrock:GetDataSource
            Resource: '*'

          # Bedrock Flows (agent workflows)
          - Sid: BedrockFlowsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListFlows
              - bedrock:GetFlow
              - bedrock:ListFlowVersions
              - bedrock:GetFlowVersion
              - bedrock:ListFlowAliases
              - bedrock:GetFlowAlias
            Resource: '*'

          # Bedrock Model Invocation Logging
          - Sid: BedrockLoggingRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:GetModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

  # CloudWatch Policy
  CloudWatchPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseCloudWatch
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AVAGovernCloudWatch
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # CloudWatch Metrics
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
              - cloudwatch:GetDashboard
              - cloudwatch:ListDashboards
            Resource: '*'

          # CloudWatch Logs
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - logs:GetLogEvents
              - logs:GetLogGroupFields
              - logs:GetQueryResults
              - logs:StartQuery
              - logs:StopQuery
            Resource: '*'

          # X-Ray (distributed tracing)
          - Sid: XRayRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:GetTraceSummaries
              - xray:BatchGetTraces
              - xray:GetServiceGraph
              - xray:GetTraceGraph
            Resource: '*'

  # CloudTrail Policy
  CloudTrailPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseCloudTrail
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AVAGovernCloudTrail
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudTrailRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
              - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
              - cloudtrail:GetTrail
              - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
              - cloudtrail:ListTrails
              - cloudtrail:GetEventSelectors
            Resource: '*'

  # IAM Read Policy (for policy analysis in governance)
  IAMReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AVAGovernIAMRead
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: IAMReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:ListPolicies
              - iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy
            Resource: '*'

  # Instance Profile (for EC2 and some ECS configurations)
  AVAGovernInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Condition: NeedsInstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: AVAGovernInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref AVAGovernRole

  # EKS OIDC Provider Trust (placeholder - requires OIDC URL input)
  # For EKS, customers should use eksctl or Terraform to set up IRSA

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN - use this when configuring your compute service
    Value: !GetAtt AVAGovernRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: AVAGovernRoleArn

  RoleName:
    Description: IAM Role Name
    Value: !Ref AVAGovernRole
    Export:
      Name: AVAGovernRoleName

  InstanceProfileArn:
    Condition: NeedsInstanceProfile
    Description: Instance Profile ARN - use this for EC2 or ECS EC2 launch type
    Value: !GetAtt AVAGovernInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: AVAGovernInstanceProfileArn

  InstanceProfileName:
    Condition: NeedsInstanceProfile
    Description: Instance Profile Name
    Value: !Ref AVAGovernInstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: AVAGovernInstanceProfileName

  EnabledCapabilities:
    Description: Enabled AVA Govern capabilities based on parameters
    Value: !Sub |
      Cost Explorer: ${EnableCostExplorer}
      Bedrock: ${EnableBedrock}
      CloudWatch: ${EnableCloudWatch}
      CloudTrail: ${EnableCloudTrail}

  NextSteps:
    Description: Instructions for using this role
    Value: !Sub |
      1. Note the RoleArn above
      2. Configure your ${ComputeType} deployment to use this role:
         - ECS: Set taskRoleArn in task definition
         - EC2: Attach instance profile to instance
         - Lambda: Set execution role
         - EKS: Configure IRSA with this role
         - App Runner: Set instance role ARN
      3. Deploy AVA Govern - it will automatically use this role

cfn_description: AWS Security Agent — Agent Space with Application, Penetration Test Service, and Actor IAM roles. Deployed by the AVA CI/CD pipeline.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Security Agent — Agent Space with Application, Penetration Test Service,
  and Actor IAM roles. Deployed by the AVA CI/CD pipeline.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: FSIAgentKitSecurityAgentSpace-CFN
    Description: Name for the Security Agent Space.

  AgentSpaceDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Security Agent Space provisioned by AVA - CloudFormation
    Description: Description for the Security Agent Space.

  NamePostfix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Fixed suffix appended to IAM role names. Leave empty to use the stack's
      unique suffix. Useful for re-deploys that need stable role names.

  ExternalId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    NoEcho: true
    Description: >-
      External ID required when assuming the Penetration Test Service Role and
      Actor Role. Leave empty to use the stack ID slug as a deterministic
      derived value (recommended only for non-production demos — pin a real
      external ID for production).

  CreateApplication:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: >-
      Create AWS::SecurityAgent::Application as part of this stack. AWS allows
      only ONE Application per account, so set this to 'true' on the FIRST
      deployment in an account; subsequent deployments must set 'false' and
      pass ExistingApplicationDomain instead.

  ExistingApplicationDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Domain of the pre-existing Security Agent Application
      (e.g. app-xxxxx.securityagent.global.app.aws). Required when
      CreateApplication = 'false'. Used to compose the operator app URL.

Conditions:
  HasPostfix:        !Not [!Equals [!Ref NamePostfix, '']]
  HasExternalId:     !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExternalId, '']]
  ShouldCreateApp:   !Equals [!Ref CreateApplication, 'true']

Resources:

  # ─── Application Role ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ApplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - 'SecurityAgentRole-Application-cfn${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !If [HasPostfix, !Ref NamePostfix, !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: securityagent.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityAgentApplicationAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                # Full securityagent:* — the Application Role is only assumed
                # by securityagent.amazonaws.com on behalf of WebApp users.
                # Narrower scopes cause 'Failed to load agent instance'.
                Action: 'securityagent:*'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/security

  # ─── Penetration Test Service Role ─────────────────────────────────────
  PenTestServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - 'SecurityAgentRole-PenTestService-cfn${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !If [HasPostfix, !Ref NamePostfix, !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: securityagent.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !If
                  - HasExternalId
                  - !Ref ExternalId
                  - !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/security

  # ─── Actor Role ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ActorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - 'SecurityAgentRole-Actor-cfn${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !If [HasPostfix, !Ref NamePostfix, !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: securityagent.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !If
                  - HasExternalId
                  - !Ref ExternalId
                  - !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityAgentActorAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeApplicationEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:Invoke
                  - lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                # Default to wildcard so the agent can target any user-owned
                # API/Lambda. Tighten Resource to your specific app post-deploy.
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/security

  # ─── Security Agent Application ────────────────────────────────────────
  # Top-level app shell that the Security Agent console looks up to surface
  # Agent Spaces in the WebApp. IAM-only access via RoleArn = Application
  # Role. SINGLETON per AWS account — only one Application is allowed across
  # the entire account, so this is gated by CreateApplication. The first
  # deployment in an account creates it; subsequent deployments must set
  # CreateApplication=false and pass ExistingApplicationDomain.
  Application:
    Type: AWS::SecurityAgent::Application
    Condition: ShouldCreateApp
    DependsOn:
      - ApplicationRole
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ApplicationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/security

  # ─── Agent Space (native CFN type) ─────────────────────────────────────
  AgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::SecurityAgent::AgentSpace
    DependsOn:
      - PenTestServiceRole
      - ActorRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Description: !Ref AgentSpaceDescription
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/security

Outputs:
  applicationid:
    Description: ID of the Security Agent Application (the top-level app shell). Empty when reusing an existing Application.
    Value: !If [ShouldCreateApp, !GetAtt Application.ApplicationId, '']
  applicationdomain:
    Description: Domain of the Security Agent Application. Echoes ExistingApplicationDomain when reusing an existing Application.
    Value: !If [ShouldCreateApp, !GetAtt Application.Domain, !Ref ExistingApplicationDomain]
  agentspaceid:
    Description: ID of the created Security Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
  operatorappurl:
    Description: URL of the Security Agent operator webapp for this Agent Space. Mirrors the DevOps Agent pattern (direct app domain). Requires an authenticated AWS console session in the browser.
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${ApplicationDomain}/${AgentSpaceId}'
      - ApplicationDomain: !If [ShouldCreateApp, !GetAtt Application.Domain, !Ref ExistingApplicationDomain]
        AgentSpaceId: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
  agentspacearn:
    Description: Reference (logical ID -> AgentSpaceId) of the created Security Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpace
  agentspacename:
    Description: Name of the created Security Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName
  applicationrolearn:
    Description: ARN of the Application Role used by the Security Agent WebApp.
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationRole.Arn
  pentestservicerolearn:
    Description: ARN of the PenTest Service Role. Selectable from the WebApp when launching a pentest.
    Value: !GetAtt PenTestServiceRole.Arn
  actorrolearn:
    Description: ARN of the Actor Role used to authenticate against the target application.
    Value: !GetAtt ActorRole.Arn
  primaryaccountid:
    Description: Account ID where the Security Agent Space was created.
    Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
  awsregion:
    Description: AWS region the stack deployed into.
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

cfn_description: AWS DevOps Agent — Agent Space with IAM roles, operator app, and primary-account association. Deployed by the AVA CICD pipeline.
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS DevOps Agent — Agent Space with IAM roles, operator app, and primary-account
  association. Deployed by the AVA CICD pipeline.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: FSIAgentKitAgentSpace-CFN
    Description: Name for the DevOps Agent Space.
  AgentSpaceDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: DevOps Agent Space provisioned by AVA - CloudFormation
    Description: Description for the DevOps Agent Space.
  NamePostfix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Fixed suffix appended to IAM role names. Leave empty to use the stack's
      unique suffix. Useful for re-deploys that need stable role names.

Conditions:
  HasPostfix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NamePostfix, '']]

Resources:
  # IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent service to monitor the account
  DevOpsAgentSpaceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - 'DevOpsAgentRole-AgentSpace-cfn${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !If [HasPostfix, !Ref NamePostfix, !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCreateResourceExplorerServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/resource-explorer-2.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForResourceExplorer
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/devops

  # IAM role for the operator app interface
  DevOpsOperatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub
        - 'DevOpsAgentRole-WebappAdmin-cfn${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !If [HasPostfix, !Ref NamePostfix, !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsOperatorAppAccessPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ava
        - Key: Component
          Value: frontier-agents/devops

  # The Agent Space resource
  AgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    DependsOn:
      - DevOpsAgentSpaceRole
      - DevOpsOperatorRole
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Description: !Ref AgentSpaceDescription
      OperatorApp:
        Iam:
          OperatorAppRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsOperatorRole.Arn

  # Association linking the monitoring account to the agent space
  PrimaryAccountAssociation:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::Association
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Related Posts pipeline — common shared secrets and parameters used by blog-pipeline sub-services.

Parameters:

    Type: String

Resources:
  GitHubTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${Application}/github

      SecretString: '{"token": "REPLACE_ME"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application

  AtlasConnectionSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${Application}/atlas-connection
      Description: MongoDB Atlas connection-string template (no password — IAM auth). Used by related-posts-service. After deploy, replace REPLACE_ME with the real SRV URI from the Atlas cluster (Atlas → Connect → Drivers → Python).
      SecretString: '{"srvUri": "REPLACE_ME", "db": "blog", "collection": "posts"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  BlogPipelineEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${Application}-events
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

    Value: !Ref GitHubTokenSecret

  AtlasConnectionSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Atlas connection secret — use this value for the AtlasSecretArn parameter in the related-posts-service samconfig.yaml.
    Value: !Ref AtlasConnectionSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:atlas-connection-secret-arn

  BlogPipelineEventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the generic blog-pipeline EventBridge bus.
    Value: !GetAtt BlogPipelineEventBus.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:event-bus-arn

  BlogPipelineEventBusName:
