    Value: !Ref BlogPipelineEventBus
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:event-bus-name

cfn_description: Related Posts pipeline atlas-roles — IAM role federated as a MongoDB Atlas database user. Consumed by blog-pipeline Lambdas (e.g. related-posts-service) via STS AssumeRole. Splitting the federated rol
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Related Posts pipeline atlas-roles — IAM role federated as a MongoDB Atlas database user. Consumed by blog-pipeline Lambdas (e.g. related-posts-service) via STS AssumeRole. Splitting the federated role from the Lambda execution roles means Atlas IAM federation is a one-time-per-role setup, decoupled from the lifecycle of the Lambdas that use it.

Parameters:
  Application:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of owning application
    Default: related-posts

Resources:
  BlogPipelineAtlasRWRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Application}-atlas-rw
      Description: Federated as an Atlas database user with readWrite on blog.posts. Lambda execution roles in this account assume this role via STS to authenticate MongoDB Atlas connections (MONGODB-AWS mechanism).
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSameAccountAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

Outputs:
  BlogPipelineAtlasRWRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Atlas-federated readWrite role. Imported by related-posts-service (and any future blog-pipeline Atlas consumer). Federate this exact ARN as an Atlas database user with readWrite on blog.posts — one-time setup, never repeated as Lambdas redeploy.
    Value: !GetAtt BlogPipelineAtlasRWRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:lambda-atlas-rw-role-arn

  BlogPipelineAtlasRWRoleName:
    Description: Name of the Atlas-federated readWrite role (useful for IAM console lookups).
    Value: !Ref BlogPipelineAtlasRWRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:lambda-atlas-rw-role-name

cfn_description: AI Bartender DSQL Data Store and Infrastructure
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: "AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31"
Description: AI Bartender DSQL Data Store and Infrastructure

Parameters:
  Application:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of owning application
    Default: ai-bartender

Resources:
  # Aurora DSQL Cluster
  DSQLCluster:
    Type: AWS::DSQL::Cluster
    Properties:
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Application}-data-store

  # IAM Role for database write operations (to be assumed by Lambda functions)
  DataWriterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Application}-data-writer-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*${Application}*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ${Application}-data-writer-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dsql:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

  # IAM Role for database read operations (to be assumed by Lambda functions)
  DataReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Application}-data-reader-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*${Application}*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ${Application}-data-reader-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dsql:DbConnect
                  - dsql:DbConnectAdmin
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"

###########################################################################
# Outputs
###########################################################################
Outputs:
  DSQLClusterIdentifier:
    Description: The DSQL Cluster Identifier
    Value: !GetAtt DSQLCluster.Identifier
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-cluster-identifier

  DSQLClusterEndpoint:
    Description: The DSQL Cluster Endpoint
    Value: !Sub ${DSQLCluster.Identifier}.dsql.${AWS::Region}.on.aws
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-cluster-endpoint

  DataWriterRoleArn:
    Description: The Role ARN for writing to DSQL
    Value: !GetAtt DataWriterRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-data-writer-role-arn

  DataReaderRoleArn:
    Description: The Role ARN for reading from DSQL
    Value: !GetAtt DataReaderRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-data-reader-role-arn

  DSQLReaderUser:
    Description: The user name for the DSQL database reader
    Value: lambda_drink_reader
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-db-reader-user

  DSQLWriterUser:
    Description: The user name for the DSQL database writer
    Value: lambda_drink_writer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}:dsql-db-writer-user

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: tft-user-pool-${sls:stage}
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: tft-client-${sls:stage}
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

Resources:
  ExampleIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
    Metadata:
      aws:cdk:path: SetupStack/ExampleIdentityPool
  CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRoleABBF7267:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  Ref: ExampleIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
        Version: "2012-10-17"
    Metadata:
      aws:cdk:path: SetupStack/CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRole/Resource
  CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRoleDefaultPolicy2B700C08:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Action:
              - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
              - cognito-sync:*
            Effect: Allow
            Resource: "*"
          - Action: polly:*
            Effect: Allow
            Resource: "*"
        Version: "2012-10-17"
      PolicyName: CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRoleDefaultPolicy2B700C08
      Roles:
        - Ref: CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRoleABBF7267
    Metadata:
      aws:cdk:path: SetupStack/CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRole/DefaultPolicy/Resource
  DefaultValid:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId:
        Ref: ExampleIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated:
          Fn::GetAtt:
            - CognitoDefaultUnauthenticatedRoleABBF7267
            - Arn
    Metadata:
      aws:cdk:path: SetupStack/DefaultValid
  CDKMetadata:
    Type: AWS::CDK::Metadata
    Properties:
      Modules: aws-cdk=1.77.0,@aws-cdk/assets=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-applicationautoscaling=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-autoscaling-common=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-cloudwatch=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-codeguruprofiler=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-cognito=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-ec2=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-ecr=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-ecr-assets=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-events=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-iam=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-kms=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-lambda=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-logs=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-s3=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-s3-assets=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-sqs=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/aws-ssm=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/cloud-assembly-schema=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/core=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/custom-resources=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/cx-api=1.79.0,@aws-cdk/region-info=1.79.0,jsii-runtime=node.js/v12.14.1
    Metadata:
      aws:cdk:path: SetupStack/CDKMetadata/Default
    Condition: CDKMetadataAvailable

        - PolicyName: !Sub "anything-${stage}-grafana-policy"
          # ref: https://github.com/grafana/athena-datasource
          # ref: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html#security-iam-awsmanpol-AmazonGrafanaAthenaAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              # ref: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/example-policies-workgroup.html
              - Sid: "AthenaAccess"
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "athena:ListDatabases"
                  - "athena:ListDataCatalogs"
                  - "athena:ListWorkGroups"
                  - "athena:GetDatabase"
                  - "athena:GetDataCatalog"
                  - "athena:GetTableMetadata"
                  - "athena:ListTableMetadata"
                  - "athena:GetWorkGroup"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
              - Sid: "AthenaWorkgroupAccess"
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "athena:GetQueryExecution"
                  - "athena:GetQueryResults"
                  - "athena:StartQueryExecution"
                  - "athena:StopQueryExecution"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/${athenaWorkgroup}
              - Sid: "GlueReadAccess"
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "glue:GetDatabase"
                  - "glue:GetDatabases"
                  - "glue:GetTable"
                  - "glue:GetTables"
                  - "glue:GetPartition"
                  - "glue:GetPartitions"
                  - "glue:BatchGetPartition"
                Resource:
                  # ref: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/glue-specifying-resource-arns.html
                  - !Sub arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/${glueDatabase}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${glueDatabase}/${glueMainTable}
              - Sid: "QueryBucketAccess"
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
                  - "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
                  - "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt queryResultsBucketArn.Value
                  - !Sub "${queryResultsBucketArn.Value}/*"
              - Sid: "DataBucketAccess"
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
                  - "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt dataBucketArn.Value
                  - !Sub "${dataBucketArn.Value}/*"

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmpjnkbm8jd.yaml:157-166", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  AgentOps E-commerce Analytics Demo — Cognito User Pool + Groups
  (AIM310, AWS Seoul Summit 2026).
  Provisions a Cognito User Pool with admin-create-only user management,
  a public client with SRP + REFRESH auth flows, 3 groups (team-alpha,
  team-beta, admin), and a custom resource Lambda to seed 6 test users.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentops-ecommerce-users
    Description: Cognito User Pool name.

  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentops-web-client
    Description: App client name for the React dashboard.

  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the web app (update for production).

Resources:
  # --- Cognito User Pool ---

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT

  # --- User Pool Client (public, SRP + REFRESH) ---

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false  # Public client for web/mobile
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000
        - http://localhost:3000/logout
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # --- Groups ---

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Team Alpha members and admins
      Precedence: 10

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Team Beta members and admins
      Precedence: 20

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: System administrators
      Precedence: 1

  # --- Custom Resource Lambda Role ---

  CognitoSeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeeder
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # --- Custom Resource Lambda (ZipFile inline) ---

  CognitoSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${UserPoolName}-seeder"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt CognitoSeederRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          # Test user definitions: email, password, groups, custom:role
          TEST_USERS = [
              {
                  'email': 'alice@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['team-alpha'],
                  'role': 'member'
              },
              {
                  'email': 'bob@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['team-alpha'],
                  'role': 'member'
              },
              {
                  'email': 'charlie@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['team-alpha'],
                  'role': 'team_admin'
              },
              {
                  'email': 'dave@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['team-beta'],
                  'role': 'member'
              },
              {
                  'email': 'eve@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['team-beta'],
                  'role': 'team_admin'
              },
              {
                  'email': 'admin@demo.local',
                  'password': 'Demo1234!',
                  'groups': ['admin'],
                  'role': 'admin'
              }
          ]

          def create_users(user_pool_id):
              """Create test users, set passwords, and add to groups."""
              for user_data in TEST_USERS:
                  email = user_data['email']
                  password = user_data['password']
                  groups = user_data['groups']
                  role = user_data['role']

                  try:
                      # Check if user exists; if so, delete and recreate
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_get_user(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, Username=email)
                          logger.info(f"Deleting existing user: {email}")
                          cognito.admin_delete_user(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, Username=email)
                      except cognito.exceptions.UserNotFoundException:
                          pass

                      # Create user with admin_create_user
                      logger.info(f"Creating user: {email}")
                      cognito.admin_create_user(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                              {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                              {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                          ],
                          TemporaryPassword=password,
                          MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                      )

                      # Set permanent password
                      logger.info(f"Setting permanent password for: {email}")
                      cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          Password=password,
                          Permanent=True
                      )

                      # Add user to groups
                      for group in groups:
                          logger.info(f"Adding {email} to group: {group}")
                          cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group
                          )

                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error(f"Error creating user {email}: {str(e)}")
                      raise

              logger.info("All test users created successfully")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """CloudFormation custom resource handler."""
              try:
                  logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']

                  if request_type == 'Create' or request_type == 'Update':
                      create_users(user_pool_id)
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'Message': 'Users created successfully'},
                          f"CognitoSeeder-{user_pool_id}"
                      )
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      # On stack delete, just return success (UserPool deletion cleans up users)
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'Message': 'Stack deletion in progress'},
                          f"CognitoSeeder-{user_pool_id}"
                      )
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.FAILED,
                          {'Message': f'Unknown RequestType: {request_type}'},
                          context.aws_request_id
                      )

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Exception: {str(e)}")
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {'Message': str(e)},
                      context.aws_request_id
                  )

  # --- Custom Resource to invoke the seeder Lambda ---

  CognitoSeederCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CognitoSeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID for web/mobile applications.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AppClientId"

  CognitoRegion:
    Description: AWS region where the User Pool is located.
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CognitoRegion"

  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Cognito User Pool domain for OAuth flows (can be created separately).
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}"

  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom resource Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoSeederFunction.Arn

    Description: "Identity pool ID"
    Value: !Ref myApiIdentityPool

    Properties:
        ClientName: !Sub UserPoolClient${envParameter}
        UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
        WriteAttributes:
          - "email"

  IdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub IdentityPool${envParameter}
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: False
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
  UnAuthRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub Cognito_${IdentityPool.Name}_UnAuth_Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: [ 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' ]
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: "unauthenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'CognitoUnAuthPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                - "*"
  AuthRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub Cognito_${IdentityPool.Name}_Auth_Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: [ 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' ]
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref IdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: "authenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'CognitoAuthPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                - cognito-sync:*
                - cognito-identity:*
                Resource:
                - "*"

  myApiIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    DependsOn: [ IdentityPool, UnAuthRole, AuthRole ]
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnAuthRole.Arn
Outputs:
 UserPool:
    Description: "User pool ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
 IdentityPool:
    Description: "Identity pool ID"
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
 ClientId:
    Description: "Client id for the user pool appclient"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

cfn_description: Codex on Bedrock — CloudWatch dashboard. Each widget is a native PromQL chart widget that queries the CloudWatch OTLP Prometheus-compatible API. The four Overview scorecards show rolling 24-hour total

Codex with Bedrock - IAM Identity Center authentication baseline. Produces a least-privilege customer-managed policy for direct attachment to an Identity Center permission set, with an optional chaine
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Codex with Bedrock - IAM Identity Center authentication baseline. Produces a least-privilege customer-managed policy for direct attachment to an Identity Center permission set, with an optional chained IAM role.'

Parameters:
  CreateChainedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Create an optional second IAM role for customers that require role chaining. The recommended direct permission-set path leaves this false.

  RoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: CodexBedrockIdCRole
    Description: Name for the chained IAM role assumed from an AWSReservedSSO_* session.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$'
    MaxLength: 64

  PolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: CodexBedrockInvokePolicy
    Description: Customer-managed policy scoped to bedrock:InvokeModel* on approved model ARNs.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$'
    MaxLength: 128

  PermissionSetNamePattern:
    Type: String
    Default: 'CodexBedrockUser_*'
    Description: Glob pattern matching the IdC Permission Set role names allowed to chain into this role (matches AWSReservedSSO_<PermissionSetName>_<hash>).

  AllowedBedrockRegions:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'us-east-1,us-west-2'
    Description: AWS regions where Bedrock InvokeModel is permitted.

  AllowedModelIdPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Bedrock model ID glob (e.g. "openai.gpt-5.*"). Default * allows all approved-access models.

  MantleProjectId:
    Type: String
    Default: default
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Bedrock Mantle project that the role may use for Responses inference.

  MaxSessionDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 28800
    MinValue: 3600
    MaxValue: 43200
    Description: Role max session duration in seconds. IdC default 28800 (8h); raise up to 43200 (12h) for long Codex runs.

  EnableMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Grant cloudwatch:PutMetricData so the local OTel sidecar can publish Codex usage metrics to the CloudWatch native OTLP endpoint. Set false to omit monitoring permissions.

Conditions:
  MonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMonitoring, 'true']
  ChainedRoleEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CreateChainedRole, 'true']

Resources:
  CodexBedrockInvokePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Ref PolicyName
      Description: Allow Codex clients to invoke approved Bedrock models (InvokeModel* and Mantle) in approved regions.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: InvokeApprovedBedrockModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/${AllowedModelIdPattern}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:application-inference-profile/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: !Ref AllowedBedrockRegions
          - Sid: MantleInference
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              # GPT-5.x via the Mantle OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoint
              # (bedrock-mantle.<region>.api.aws) requires BOTH the bearer-token
              # auth action and the inference action, verified against the live
              # API: CallWithBearerToken authenticates the request, then
              # CreateInference runs it against project/default.
              - bedrock-mantle:CreateInference
              - bedrock-mantle:GetInference
              - bedrock-mantle:CancelInference
            # NOTE: these calls do not populate aws:RequestedRegion, so a region
            # condition here causes an implicit deny. Region is instead bounded
            # by the regional Mantle endpoint the bearer token targets.
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-mantle:*:${AWS::AccountId}:project/${MantleProjectId}'
          - Sid: MantleBearerToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock-mantle:CallWithBearerToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ListBedrockResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:ListFoundationModels
              - bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles
              - bedrock:GetFoundationModel
              - bedrock:GetInferenceProfile
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: !Ref AllowedBedrockRegions
          # Local OTel sidecar publishes Codex usage metrics to the CloudWatch
          # native OTLP endpoint (monitoring.<region>.amazonaws.com) via SigV4
          # using these same session credentials. PutMetricData is the only
          # action native-OTLP metrics ingestion needs; scoped to approved
          # regions. Omitted entirely when EnableMonitoring=false.
          - !If
            - MonitoringEnabled
            - Sid: PublishCodexUsageMetrics
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:RequestedRegion: !Ref AllowedBedrockRegions
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  CodexBedrockIdCRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ChainedRoleEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref RoleName
      Description: Chained role assumed from an IdC AWSReservedSSO_* session for Codex-on-Bedrock usage.
      MaxSessionDuration: !Ref MaxSessionDurationSeconds
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ChainFromIdCPermissionSet
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:PrincipalArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-reserved/sso.amazonaws.com/AWSReservedSSO_${PermissionSetNamePattern}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-reserved/sso.amazonaws.com/*/AWSReservedSSO_${PermissionSetNamePattern}'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CodexBedrockInvokePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Codex-on-Bedrock IdC chained role
        - Key: DeployedBy
          Value: bedrock-auth-idc.yaml

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the chained Bedrock role. Reference from Codex config or as a role-chain target.
    Condition: ChainedRoleEnabled
    Value: !GetAtt CodexBedrockIdCRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RoleArn'
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the chained Bedrock role.
    Condition: ChainedRoleEnabled
    Value: !Ref CodexBedrockIdCRole
  PolicyName:
    Description: Name of the customer-managed policy to attach directly to the Identity Center permission set.
    Value: !Ref PolicyName
  PolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock customer-managed policy. Attach directly to the IdC Permission Set if you prefer no role chaining.
    Value: !Ref CodexBedrockInvokePolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PolicyArn'

DynamoDB table for JWT middleware user-to-key mapping
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: DynamoDB table for JWT middleware user-to-key mapping

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: codex-user-keys
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for user API key mappings

Resources:
  UserKeyMappingKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} user key mapping table key"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  UserKeyMappingKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-user-key-mapping"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKmsKey

  UserKeyMappingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        Enabled: true
        AttributeName: ttl
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt UserKeyMappingKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: project
          Value: codex-bedrock
        - Key: component
          Value: jwt-middleware
        - Key: managed-by
          Value: cloudformation

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref UserKeyMappingTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableName"

  TableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserKeyMappingTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableArn"

cfn_description: Create AWS Cognito User Pool for Amazon Q Business proof-of-concept
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Create AWS Cognito User Pool for Amazon Q Business proof-of-concept

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Metadata:
      cfn_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: F78
            reason: CFN intended for proof-of-concept. SMS may not be available for MFA yet.
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireNumbers: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: True
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AppCallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AppLogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn:
      - UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !Ref AWS::StackName
          - !Select [1, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref AWS::StackId]]]]
    DependsOn:
      - UserPool

Parameters:
  AppCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://localhost:8080/authorization-code/callback'
    Description: Application url for Cognito to callback after authentication
  AppLogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: 'http://localhost:8080/logout'
    Description: Application url to logout user

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Domain Name
    Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  IssuerURL:
    Description: Issuer URL
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
  OAuthURL:
    Description: OAuth URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  ClientId:
    Description: Client ID
    Value: !GetAtt UserPoolClient.ClientId
  ClientSecret:
    Description: Client Secret
    Value: !GetAtt UserPoolClient.ClientSecret

cfn_description: AWS Pricing Assistant - Bedrock Guardrails for Topic and Content Filtering
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AWS Pricing Assistant - Bedrock Guardrails for Topic and Content Filtering'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-pricing-assistant
    Description: Name of the project for resource naming

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
    Description: Environment name

Resources:
  # Bedrock Guardrail
  PricingAssistantGuardrail:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail
      Description: 'Guardrail to ensure AWS Pricing Assistant only responds to AWS pricing and architecture topics'
      BlockedInputMessaging: 'I can only help with AWS pricing and architecture questions. Please ask about AWS services, costs, or infrastructure design.'
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: 'I can only provide information about AWS pricing and architecture. Please rephrase your question to focus on AWS services or costs.'

      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          - Name: 'Off-Topic Conversations'
            Definition: 'General conversations not related to AWS, cloud computing, or technology infrastructure'
            Examples:
              - 'What is the weather today?'
              - 'Tell me a joke'
              - 'What should I have for lunch?'
              - 'How do I cook pasta?'
            Type: 'DENY'

      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: 'SEXUAL'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'
          - Type: 'VIOLENCE'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'
          - Type: 'HATE'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'
          - Type: 'INSULTS'
            InputStrength: 'MEDIUM'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'
          - Type: 'MISCONDUCT'
            InputStrength: 'MEDIUM'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'
          - Type: 'PROMPT_ATTACK'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'

      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: 'PROFANITY'

      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          - Type: 'EMAIL'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'PHONE'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER'
            Action: 'BLOCK'

  # Guardrail Version
  GuardrailVersion:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion
    Properties:
      GuardrailIdentifier: !Ref PricingAssistantGuardrail
      Description: !Sub 'Version 1.0 of ${ProjectName} guardrail for production use'

  # SSM Parameter for Guardrail Version
  GuardrailVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/pricing-assistant/${Environment}/guardrail-version'
      Type: String
      Value: "2"
      Description: !Sub 'Current guardrail version for ${ProjectName} ${Environment} environment'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Component: guardrails

Outputs:
  GuardrailId:
    Description: ID of the Bedrock Guardrail
    Value: !Ref PricingAssistantGuardrail
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail-id

  GuardrailArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock Guardrail
    Value: !GetAtt PricingAssistantGuardrail.GuardrailArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail-arn

  GuardrailVersion:
    Description: Version of the Bedrock Guardrail
    Value: "2"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-guardrail-version

cfn_description: AWS Pricing Assistant - WAF Rate Limiting for CloudFront
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AWS Pricing Assistant - WAF Rate Limiting for CloudFront'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-pricing-assistant
    Description: Name of the project for resource naming

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
    Description: Environment name

Resources:
  # WAF Web ACL for CloudFront
  CloudFrontWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-cloudfront-waf
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      Description: Rate limiting and security rules for CloudFront distribution
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Rules:
        # Rate limit for general requests - 2000 per 5 minutes per IP
        - Name: RateLimitGeneral
          Priority: 1
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          Action:
            Block:
              CustomResponse:
                ResponseCode: 429
                CustomResponseBodyKey: RateLimitExceeded
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitGeneral

        # Rate limit for API routes - 1000 per 5 minutes per IP
        - Name: RateLimitAPI
          Priority: 2
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 1000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
              ScopeDownStatement:
                ByteMatchStatement:
                  FieldToMatch:
                    UriPath: {}
                  PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
                  SearchString: /api/
                  TextTransformations:
                    - Priority: 0
                      Type: NONE
          Action:
            Block:
              CustomResponse:
                ResponseCode: 429
                CustomResponseBodyKey: RateLimitExceeded
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitAPI

        # Rate limit for WebSocket connections - 500 per 5 minutes per IP
        - Name: RateLimitWebSocket
          Priority: 3
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 500
              AggregateKeyType: IP
              ScopeDownStatement:
                ByteMatchStatement:
                  FieldToMatch:
                    UriPath: {}
                  PositionalConstraint: STARTS_WITH
                  SearchString: /ws/
                  TextTransformations:
                    - Priority: 0
                      Type: NONE
          Action:
            Block:
              CustomResponse:
                ResponseCode: 429
                CustomResponseBodyKey: RateLimitExceeded
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitWebSocket

      CustomResponseBodies:
        RateLimitExceeded:
          ContentType: APPLICATION_JSON
          Content: '{"error": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."}'

      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-waf

Outputs:
  WebACLId:
    Description: ID of the WAF Web ACL
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebACL.Id
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-waf-webacl-id

  WebACLArn:
    Description: ARN of the WAF Web ACL
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebACL.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-waf-webacl-arn

cfn_description: Game Agent - Bedrock Guardrails for Production Security
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Game Agent - Bedrock Guardrails for Production Security'

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: game-agent
    Description: Project name for resource naming

Resources:
  # Bedrock Guardrail for Game Agent
  GameAgentGuardrail:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-guardrails'
      Description: 'Production guardrails for Game Agent AI assistant'
      BlockedInputMessaging: 'I can only help with AWS GameLift, EKS, and cost management questions. Please ask about your AWS infrastructure.'
      BlockedOutputsMessaging: 'I cannot provide that information. Please ask about AWS GameLift, EKS, or cost management.'

      # Denied Topics - Keep conversations focused on AWS infrastructure
      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          # NOTE: topic definitions are written POSITIVELY — they describe only
          # the out-of-scope subject and deliberately AVOID naming in-scope
          # services (AWS, EKS, GameLift, cost). An earlier "...not related to
          # AWS/EKS" phrasing confused the topic classifier into blocking
          # legitimate AWS questions ("list my EKS clusters" → blocked as
          # "Non-AWS Infrastructure"; "AWS spending this month" → blocked).
          # A dedicated "Other Cloud Providers" topic was dropped because it
          # persistently false-blocked AWS cost queries; non-AWS cloud how-to is
          # folded into "General Programming Help" instead. These definitions
          # were tuned empirically via ApplyGuardrail until 11/11 in-scope passed
          # and 10/10 off-topic blocked. Each Definition must stay <=200 chars.
          - Name: 'Personal Advice'
            Definition: 'Requests for advice about personal life, relationships, mental or physical health, medical symptoms or treatment, or legal matters.'
            Type: 'DENY'
            Examples:
              - 'How do I deal with stress?'
              - 'What should I do about my relationship?'
              - 'Give me medical advice for a headache.'

          - Name: 'General Programming Help'
            Definition: 'Requests to write, debug or explain general application source code, programming-language tutorials, or non-Amazon platforms like Azure, Google Cloud, or on-premise data centers.'
            Type: 'DENY'
            Examples:
              - 'How do I write a Python function?'
              - 'How do I set up Azure Kubernetes Service?'
              - 'How do I configure my on-premise VMware servers?'

          - Name: 'Entertainment and Casual Chat'
            Definition: 'Requests for jokes, poems, stories, songs, trivia, games, or casual small talk.'
            Type: 'DENY'
            Examples:
              - 'Tell me a joke'
              - 'Write me a poem about pirates'
              - 'What movies should I watch?'

      # Sensitive Information Filters - Anonymize/Block PII in responses
      # Security: Protect against data leakage (GenAI data protection)
      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          - Type: 'EMAIL'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
          - Type: 'PHONE'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
          - Type: 'CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'IP_ADDRESS'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
          - Type: 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'AWS_SECRET_KEY'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'PASSWORD'
            Action: 'BLOCK'
          - Type: 'USERNAME'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
        # Custom regex patterns for additional sensitive data
        RegexesConfig:
          - Name: 'AWS Account ID'
            Description: 'Block AWS account IDs from being exposed'
            Pattern: '\b\d{12}\b'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
          - Name: 'Internal Hostnames'
            Description: 'Block internal AWS hostnames'
            Pattern: '\b[a-z0-9-]+\.internal\b'
            Action: 'ANONYMIZE'
          - Name: 'Kubernetes Secrets'
            Description: 'Block potential Kubernetes secret references'
            Pattern: 'kubectl\s+get\s+secret|base64\s+-d'
            Action: 'BLOCK'

      # Content Filter Policy - Block harmful content
      # Security: Additional layer of content protection
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: 'HATE'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'HIGH'
          - Type: 'INSULTS'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'HIGH'
          - Type: 'SEXUAL'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'HIGH'
          - Type: 'VIOLENCE'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'HIGH'
          - Type: 'MISCONDUCT'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'HIGH'
          - Type: 'PROMPT_ATTACK'
            InputStrength: 'HIGH'
            OutputStrength: 'NONE'

      # Word Policy - Block specific terms
      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: 'PROFANITY'

      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AI Safety and Security

Outputs:
  GuardrailId:
    Description: Bedrock Guardrail ID
    Value: !GetAtt GameAgentGuardrail.GuardrailId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-GuardrailId'

  GuardrailArn:
    Description: Bedrock Guardrail ARN
    Value: !GetAtt GameAgentGuardrail.GuardrailArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-GuardrailArn'

  GuardrailVersion:
    Description: Bedrock Guardrail Version
    Value: !GetAtt GameAgentGuardrail.Version
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-GuardrailVersion'

cfn_description:
CloudFormation template for creating network infrastructure 
required to deploy EMR on EKS infrastructure. Creates:
- VPC with IPv4 CIDR
- 2 public and 2 private subnets across 2 AZs
- Internet Gatewa
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: |
  CloudFormation template for creating network infrastructure
  required to deploy EMR on EKS infrastructure. Creates:
  - VPC with IPv4 CIDR
  - 2 public and 2 private subnets across 2 AZs
  - Internet Gateway for public subnets
  - NAT Gateways for private subnet internet access
  - VPC Flow Logs with KMS encryption

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Description: A project name that is prefixed to resource names or tags
    Type: String
    Default: SHS-BaseInfraStack

  VpcCIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for this VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.0.0/16

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.10.0/24

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.11.0/24

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.20.0/24

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.21.0/24

Resources:
  NetworkLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-IGW

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Public Subnet (AZ1)
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: 1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Public Subnet (AZ2)
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: 1

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Private Subnet (AZ1)
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: 1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Private Subnet (AZ2)
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: 1

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} NAT Gateway 1 EIP
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} NAT Gateway 2 EIP
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} NAT Gateway 1
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} NAT Gateway 2
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Public Routes

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Private Routes (AZ1)

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName} Private Routes (AZ2)

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Metadata:
      cdk_nag:
        rules_to_suppress:
          - id: AwsSolutions-IAM5
            reason: "VPC Flow Logs requires these permissions to function properly with CloudWatch Logs and KMS encryption"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flowlog-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
                  - !GetAtt NetworkLogsKMSKey.Arn

  # Create a CloudWatch Log Group
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt NetworkLogsKMSKey.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete

  # Create the Flow Log
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

Outputs:
  VPC:
    Description: VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  VPCCidr:
    Description: CIDR range for the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  PublicSubnets:
    Description: List of the public subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: List of the private subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnets"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Description: Public subnet in the 1st Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Description: Public subnet in the 2nd Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Description: Private subnet in the 1st Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Description: Private subnet in the 2nd Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2

resource_types: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry | AWS::EC2::RouteTable | AWS::EC2::Subnet | AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation | AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation | AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
cfn_description: Private VPC CIDR for EKS deployed in a VPC with a limited size CIDR
content:
---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: Private VPC CIDR for EKS deployed in a VPC with a limited size CIDR

Parameters:
  SecondaryCidrParam:
    Type: 'String'
    AllowedPattern: '100\.\d{1,3}\.0\.0/16'
    Default: '100.64.0.0/16'
    Description: 'Additional VPC CIDR from the range 100.64.0.0/16 - 100.127.0.0/16'
  SubnetAz1CidrParam:
    Type: 'String'
    AllowedPattern: '100\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.0/\d\d'
    Default: '100.64.0.0/18'
  SubnetAz2CidrParam:
    Type: 'String'
    AllowedPattern: '100\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.0/\d\d'
    Default: '100.64.64.0/18'
  SubnetAz3CidrParam:
    Type: 'String'
    AllowedPattern: '100\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.0/\d\d'
    Default: '100.64.128.0/18'
  SubnetNamePrefixParam:
    Type: 'String'
    MinLength: 1
    Default: 'vpc_eks_'

Resources:
  PrivateVpcCidrBlock:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !ImportValue Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SecondaryCidrParam

  EksNodeRouteTable:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::RouteTable'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !ImportValue Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: 'Name'
          Value: 'eks_node_route_table'

  SubnetEksNodesAz1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      # AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 0, !GetAZs '' ]
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub "${AWS::Region}a"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetAz1CidrParam
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: False
      VpcId: !ImportValue Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: 'Name'
          Value: !Sub '${SubnetNamePrefixParam}_az1'
  NetworkAclSubnetEksNodesAz1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation'
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !ImportValue NetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz1
  RouteTableSubnetEksNodesAz1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EksNodeRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz1

  SubnetEksNodesAz2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      # AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 1, !GetAZs '' ]
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub "${AWS::Region}b"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetAz2CidrParam
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: False
      VpcId: !ImportValue Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: 'Name'
          Value: !Sub '${SubnetNamePrefixParam}_az2'
  NetworkAclSubnetEksNodesAz2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation'
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !ImportValue NetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz2
  RouteTableSubnetEksNodesAz2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EksNodeRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz2

  SubnetEksNodesAz3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      # AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 2, !GetAZs '' ]
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub "${AWS::Region}c"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetAz3CidrParam
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: False
      VpcId: !ImportValue Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: 'Name'
          Value: !Sub '${SubnetNamePrefixParam}_az3'
  NetworkAclSubnetEksNodesAz3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation'
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !ImportValue NetworkAcl
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz3
  RouteTableSubnetEksNodesAz3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EksNodeRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz3

  NetworkAclAllowPrivateVpcIngress:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry'
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !ImportValue NetworkAcl
      Egress: False
      RuleAction: 'allow'
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: '-1'
      CidrBlock: !Ref SecondaryCidrParam
  NetworkAclAllowPrivateVpcEgress:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry'
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !ImportValue NetworkAcl
      Egress: True
      RuleAction: 'allow'
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: '-1'
      CidrBlock: !Ref SecondaryCidrParam

Outputs:
  PrivateVpcCidr:
    Value: !Ref SecondaryCidrParam
    Export:
      Name: PrivateVpcCidr
  PrivateVpcCidrBlock:
    Value: !Ref PrivateVpcCidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: PrivateVpcCidrBlock
  EksNodeRouteTable:
    Value: !Ref EksNodeRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: EksNodeRouteTable
  SubnetEksNodesAz1:
    Value: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz1
    Export:
      Name: SubnetEksNodesAz1
  SubnetEksNodesAz2:
    Value: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz2
    Export:
      Name: SubnetEksNodesAz2
  SubnetEksNodesAz3:
    Value: !Ref SubnetEksNodesAz3
    Export:
      Name: SubnetEksNodesAz3

cfn_description: Deploy IAM Role for Instances
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Deploy IAM Role for Instances
#----------------------------------------------
Resources:
  # EC2インスタンスに付与するインスタンスロールの作成を行う
  # ここでは、マネージドポリシーのみ付与し、
  # S3などリソースを意識するポリシーは各リソースデプロイ時にアタッチする
  #---IAM Role(For Instances)
  #---
  EC2HighAuthorityRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
  EC2HighAuthorityRoleProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2HighAuthorityRole
  #--
  EC2DockerRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowPushPullDockerImage
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - # docker一時トークン(12時間有効)取得。GetAuthorizationTokenは、Resource未サポート
                Sid: GetAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - "ecr:Describe*"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AllowPushPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*"
  EC2DockerRolePlofile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2DockerRole
  #---
  EC2kubectlRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EksEcrReadPermission
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetRepositories
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: AllowEcrReadList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*"
              - Sid: AllowEksReadWritePermission
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "eks:Describe*"
                  - "eks:List*"
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
                  - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
                  - eks:DeleteAddon
                  - eks:AssociateEncryptionConfig
                  - eks:DeleteNodegroup
                  - eks:UpdateAddon
                  - eks:CreateAddon
                  - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
                  - eks:CreateNodegroup
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: OtherServiceReadPermission
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMReadPermission
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iam:Describe*"
                  - "iam:List*"
                  - "iam:Get*"
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ForThisHandsOnCloudFormationReadPermission
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCloudFormationReadPermission
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:Describe*"
                  - "cloudformation:List*"
                Resource: "*"
  EC2kubectlRolePlofile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2kubectlRole
  #---
  EC2k8sWorkerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        #For EKS
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      #AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnlyを利用せず
      #より制限されたECRアクセスのポリシーを利用する場合は以下のinlineポリシーをコメントアウト
      #Policies:
      #  - PolicyName: PullDockerImageFromMyselfEcrRepository
      #    PolicyDocument:
      #      Version: "2012-10-17"
      #      Statement:
      #        -
      #          # docker一時トークン(12時間有効)取得。GetAuthorizationTokenは、Resource未サポート
      #          Sid: GetAuthorizationToken
      #          Effect: Allow
      #          Action:
      #            - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
      #          Resource: "*"
      #        -
      #          Sid: AllowPushPull
      #          Effect: Allow
      #          Action:
      #            - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
      #            - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
      #          Resource:
      #            - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*"
  EC2k8sWorkerRoleProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2k8sWorkerRole
  #---
  # EKS Service Role(For k8s control plane)
  #---
  EksServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController #PodへのSGデプロイなどで利用
Outputs:
  #---------------- IAM Role
  EC2HighAuthorityRoleArn:
    Description: Role Arn of EC2HighAuthorityRole
    Value: !GetAtt EC2HighAuthorityRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2HighAuthorityRoleArn
  EC2HighAuthorityRoleName:
    Description: Role Name of EC2HighAuthorityRole
    Value: !Ref EC2HighAuthorityRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2HighAuthorityRoleName
  EC2HighAuthorityRoleProfile:
    Description: Arn of EC2HighAuthorityRoleProfile
    Value: !Ref EC2HighAuthorityRoleProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2HighAuthorityRoleProfile
  #--
  EC2DockerRoleArn:
    Description: Role Arn of EC2DockerRole
    Value: !GetAtt EC2DockerRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2DockerRoleArn
  EC2DockerRoleName:
    Description: Role Name of EC2DockerRole
    Value: !Ref EC2DockerRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2DockerRoleName
  EC2DockerRolePlofile:
    Description: Arn of EC2DockerRolePlofile
    Value: !Ref EC2DockerRolePlofile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2DockerRolePlofile
  #--
  EC2kubectlRoleArn:
    Description: Role Arn of EC2kubectlRole
    Value: !GetAtt EC2kubectlRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2kubectlRoleArn
  EC2kubectlRoleName:
    Description: Role Name of EC2kubectlRole
    Value: !Ref EC2kubectlRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2kubectlRoleName
  EC2kubectlRolePlofile:
    Description: Arn of EC2kubectlRolePlofile
    Value: !Ref EC2kubectlRolePlofile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2kubectlRolePlofile
  #--
  EC2k8sWorkerRoleArn:
    Description: Role Arn of EC2k8sWorkerRole
    Value: !GetAtt EC2k8sWorkerRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2k8sWorkerRoleArn
  EC2k8sWorkerRoleName:
    Description: Role Name of EC2k8sWorkerRole
    Value: !Ref EC2k8sWorkerRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2k8sWorkerRoleName
  EC2k8sWorkerRoleProfile:
    Description: Arn of EC2k8sWorkerRoleProfile
    Value: !Ref EC2k8sWorkerRoleProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2k8sWorkerRoleProfile
  #--
  EksServiceRoleArn:
    Description: Role Arn of EksServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt EksServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EksServiceRoleArn
  EksServiceRoleName:
    Description: Role Name of EksServiceRole
    Value: !Ref EksServiceRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EksServiceRoleName
