cfn_description: Student Services AgentCore Infrastructure - Cognito OAuth pools for runtime authentication and IAM execution roles for AgentCore Direct Deploy runtimes (Phase 3). Organized by domain: each agent's ide
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Student Services AgentCore Infrastructure - Cognito OAuth pools for runtime
  authentication and IAM execution roles for AgentCore Direct Deploy runtimes (Phase 3).
  Organized by domain: each agent's identity (Cognito) and permissions (IAM) are grouped together.

Resources:

  # =======================================================================
  # SHARED: Base IAM Policy (attached to all execution roles)
  #
  # Common permissions every AgentCore Direct Deploy runtime needs:
  #   - Bedrock model invocation (InvokeModel, InvokeModelWithResponseStream)
  #   - CloudWatch Logs (create groups, streams, put events)
  #   - CloudWatch Metrics (bedrock-agentcore namespace)
  #   - X-Ray tracing
  # =======================================================================

  AgentCoreBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'student-services-agentcore-base-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Base permissions for AgentCore Direct Deploy runtimes (logs, X-Ray, CloudWatch, Bedrock)
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - 'arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsCreateGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDescribeGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsPutEvents
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
            Resource: '*'

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: StudentServicesAgent (Orchestrator)
  #
  # HTTP runtime invoked via SigV4 from thin client.
  # No Cognito pool needed (inbound auth is IAM-based).
  # Permissions: Bedrock only (base policy).
  # =======================================================================

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgent-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeRolePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: StudentServicesGateway
  #
  # Cognito pool that protects the AgentCore Gateway inbound endpoint.
  # The orchestrator presents a token from this pool to access the gateway.
  # No execution role needed (gateway is managed infrastructure, not a runtime).
  # =======================================================================

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: student-services-gateway-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: Student Services Gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access Student Services Gateway

  StudentServicesGatewayAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      ClientName: student-services-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - student-services-gateway/access
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: CourseRegistration
  #
  # MCP server that registers students in courses.
  # Execution role: Bedrock (base) + DynamoDB (course_registration table writes).
  # Cognito: protects the MCP runtime endpoint (gateway authenticates outbound).
  # =======================================================================

  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseRegistration-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeRolePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess'

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-registration-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: Course Registration
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access Course Registration MCP Server

  CourseRegistrationAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      ClientName: course-registration-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-registration/access
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: CourseCatalog
  #
  # MCP server that searches the course catalog via Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  # Execution role: Bedrock (base) + Bedrock Agent Runtime (Knowledge Base retrieval).
  # Cognito: protects the MCP runtime endpoint.
  # =======================================================================

  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseCatalog-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeRolePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockKnowledgeBaseAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockAgentRuntimeRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*'

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-catalog-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseCatalogUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool

  CourseCatalogResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Identifier: course-catalog
      Name: Course Catalog
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access Course Catalog MCP Server

  CourseCatalogAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseCatalogResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      ClientName: course-catalog-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-catalog/access
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: CourseReview
  #
  # MCP server that retrieves course reviews from DynamoDB.
  # Execution role: Bedrock (base) + DynamoDB (course_review table reads).
  # Cognito: protects the MCP runtime endpoint.
  # =======================================================================

  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CourseReview-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeRolePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess'

  CourseReviewUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-review-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseReviewUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-review-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool

  CourseReviewResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      Identifier: course-review
      Name: Course Review
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access Course Review MCP Server

  CourseReviewAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseReviewResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      ClientName: course-review-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-review/access
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  # =======================================================================
  # DOMAIN: LoanApplication
  #
  # MCP server that predicts loan acceptance via SageMaker XGBoost endpoint.
  # Execution role: Bedrock (base) + SageMaker Runtime (InvokeEndpoint).
  # Cognito: protects the MCP runtime endpoint.
  # =======================================================================

  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: LoanApplication-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AssumeRolePolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerRuntimeInvoke
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*'

  LoanApplicationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: loan-application-user-pool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  LoanApplicationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'loan-application-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool

  LoanApplicationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      Identifier: loan-application
      Name: Loan Application
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access Loan Application MCP Server

  LoanApplicationAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: LoanApplicationResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      ClientName: loan-application-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - loan-application/access
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

# =======================================================================
# Outputs
# =======================================================================

Outputs:

  # --- StudentServicesAgent ---
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: 'Execution role ARN for StudentServicesAgent runtime'
    Value: !GetAtt StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesAgentExecutionRoleArn'

  # --- StudentServicesGateway ---
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID for Student Services Gateway'
    Value: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolId'

  StudentServicesGatewayDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC Discovery URL for Student Services Gateway'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StudentServicesGatewayUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesGatewayDiscoveryUrl'

  StudentServicesGatewayClientId:
    Description: 'App Client ID for Student Services Gateway'
    Value: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesGatewayClientId'

  StudentServicesGatewayTokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'Token endpoint for Student Services Gateway'
    Value: !Sub 'https://student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesGatewayTokenEndpoint'

  StudentServicesGatewayScope:
    Description: 'OAuth scope for Student Services Gateway'
    Value: 'student-services-gateway/access'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StudentServicesGatewayScope'

  # --- CourseRegistration ---
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: 'Execution role ARN for CourseRegistration runtime'
    Value: !GetAtt CourseRegistrationExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationExecutionRoleArn'

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID for Course Registration'
    Value: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationUserPoolId'

  CourseRegistrationDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC Discovery URL for Course Registration'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CourseRegistrationUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationDiscoveryUrl'

  CourseRegistrationClientId:
    Description: 'App Client ID for Course Registration'
    Value: !Ref CourseRegistrationAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationClientId'

  CourseRegistrationTokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'Token endpoint for Course Registration'
    Value: !Sub 'https://course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationTokenEndpoint'

  CourseRegistrationScope:
    Description: 'OAuth scope for Course Registration'
    Value: 'course-registration/access'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseRegistrationScope'

  # --- CourseCatalog ---
  CourseCatalogExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: 'Execution role ARN for CourseCatalog runtime'
    Value: !GetAtt CourseCatalogExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogExecutionRoleArn'

  CourseCatalogUserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID for Course Catalog'
    Value: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogUserPoolId'

  CourseCatalogDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC Discovery URL for Course Catalog'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CourseCatalogUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogDiscoveryUrl'

  CourseCatalogClientId:
    Description: 'App Client ID for Course Catalog'
    Value: !Ref CourseCatalogAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogClientId'

  CourseCatalogTokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'Token endpoint for Course Catalog'
    Value: !Sub 'https://course-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogTokenEndpoint'

  CourseCatalogScope:
    Description: 'OAuth scope for Course Catalog'
    Value: 'course-catalog/access'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseCatalogScope'

  # --- CourseReview ---
  CourseReviewExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: 'Execution role ARN for CourseReview runtime'
    Value: !GetAtt CourseReviewExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewExecutionRoleArn'

  CourseReviewUserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID for Course Review'
    Value: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewUserPoolId'

  CourseReviewDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC Discovery URL for Course Review'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CourseReviewUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewDiscoveryUrl'

  CourseReviewClientId:
    Description: 'App Client ID for Course Review'
    Value: !Ref CourseReviewAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewClientId'

  CourseReviewTokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'Token endpoint for Course Review'
    Value: !Sub 'https://course-review-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewTokenEndpoint'

  CourseReviewScope:
    Description: 'OAuth scope for Course Review'
    Value: 'course-review/access'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CourseReviewScope'

  # --- LoanApplication ---
  LoanApplicationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: 'Execution role ARN for LoanApplication runtime'
    Value: !GetAtt LoanApplicationExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationExecutionRoleArn'

  LoanApplicationUserPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID for Loan Application'
    Value: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationUserPoolId'

  LoanApplicationDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: 'OIDC Discovery URL for Loan Application'
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${LoanApplicationUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationDiscoveryUrl'

  LoanApplicationClientId:
    Description: 'App Client ID for Loan Application'
    Value: !Ref LoanApplicationAppClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationClientId'

  LoanApplicationTokenEndpoint:
    Description: 'Token endpoint for Loan Application'
    Value: !Sub 'https://loan-application-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationTokenEndpoint'

  LoanApplicationScope:
    Description: 'OAuth scope for Loan Application'
    Value: 'loan-application/access'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoanApplicationScope'

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: This CloudFormation template creates a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) with two public subnets and two private subnets across two Availability Zones (AZs). It also sets up an ECS Cluster, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateways, Route Tables, and other necessary resources for a secure and highly available network infrastructure.
Metadata:
  'AWS::CloudFormation::Interface':
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'VPCConfig'
        Parameters:
        - Vpccidr
        - PublicSubnetAcidr
        - PublicSubnetBcidr
        - PrivateSubnetAcidr
        - PrivateSubnetBcidr

Parameters:
  Vpccidr:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16

  PublicSubnetAcidr:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24

  PublicSubnetBcidr:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24

  PrivateSubnetAcidr:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24

  PrivateSubnetBcidr:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24

Resources:
  ##############################
  ##### Streamlit Cluster #####
  ############################

  StreamlitCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  ################
  ##### VPC #####
  ##############

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref Vpccidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'VPC'

  VPCLogGroup:
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Type: 'AWS::Logs::LogGroup'
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 7

  VPCLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "LogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: 'Allow'
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:PutRetentionPolicy'
                Resource: '*'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::FlowLog"
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VPCLogRole.Arn

  ##########################
  ##### Public Subnet #####
  ########################

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: InternetGateway

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # Create a Subnet
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetAcidr
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
                          - 0
                          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnetA

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetBcidr
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
                          - 1
                          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnetB

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB

  ##########################
  ##### Private Subnet #####
  ########################

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetAcidr
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
                          - 0
                          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnetA

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetBcidr
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
                          - 1
                          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnetB

  # NAT Gateway
  NatGatewayAEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayBEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayAEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayBEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTableA

  DefaultPrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTableB

  DefaultPrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB

Outputs:
  VPC:
    Description: "VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: Basic-VPC

  PublicSubnetA:
    Description: "PublicSubnetA"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
    Export:
      Name: Basic-PublicSubnetA

  PublicSubnetB:
    Description: "PublicSubnetB"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetB
    Export:
      Name: Basic-PublicSubnetB

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Description: "PrivateSubnetA"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
    Export:
      Name: Basic-PrivateSubnetA

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Description: "PrivateSubnetB"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
    Export:
      Name: Basic-PrivateSubnetB

  StreamlitCluster:
    Description: "StreamlitCluster"
    Value: !Ref StreamlitCluster
    Export:
      Name: StreamlitCluster

content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: >-
  This template creates a custom SMTP resource that stores the SMTP
  credentials in Parameter Store under the names "smtp-username" and
  "smtp-password".

Parameters:
  IamAccessKeyVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Version number of the AWS access keys. Increment this number to rotate the keys.
    MinValue: 1
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: (Optional) ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the SMTP credentials in Parameter Store
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(arn:aws:kms:(us|af|ap|ca|eu|il|mx|me|sa)-(east|west|south|north|southeast|northeast|central)-[1-7]:\d{12}:key\/[a-z0-9]{8}(-[a-z0-9]{4}){3}-[a-z0-9]{12}$)?'
    ConstraintDescription: This value must be a valid ACM certificate ARN format, or left blank
  Username:
    Type: String
    Description: Desired name of the IAM user
    Default: SMTPUser
  LambdaLogRetentionTime:
    Type: Number
    Description: The length of time in days to retain the Sectigo Lambda function execution logs
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365

Conditions:
  UseCustomKMSKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]]

Resources:
  SmtpUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub ${Username}Group
  SmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref Username
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpUserGroup
  SmtpUserPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${Username}Policy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: '*'
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpUserGroup
  SmtpUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      Serial: !Ref IamAccessKeyVersion
      Status: Active
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUser

  SmtpPassword:
    Type: Custom::SmtpPassword
    DependsOn: SmtpLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SMTPCredentialsLambdaFunction.Arn
      Key: !GetAtt SmtpUserAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      ParameterType: password
      UserName: !Ref Username

  SmtpUsername:
    Type: Custom::SmtpUsername
    DependsOn: SmtpLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SMTPCredentialsLambdaFunction.Arn
      Key: !Ref SmtpUserAccessKey
      ParameterType: username
      UserName: !Ref Username

  SMTPLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Lambda to generate SMTP credentials
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InlineSMTPLambdaExecutionRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
                - Fn::If:
                  - UseCustomKMSKey
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - kms:Decrypt
                      - kms:DescribeKey
                      - kms:CreateGrant
                      - kms:Encrypt
                    Resource:
                      - !Ref KmsKeyArn
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - ssm:PutParameter
                    - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*-smtp-username"
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*-smtp-password"

  SmtpLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${SMTPCredentialsLambdaFunction}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetentionTime

# The following function is based on data from https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/smtp-credentials.html
  SMTPCredentialsLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Generates SMTP credentials and stores in Parameter Store
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Role: !GetAtt SMTPLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.13
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: !Sub |
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import base64
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          import cfnresponse
          import logging
          import os
          import logging
          from sys import exit

          # Configure logging
          logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)
          log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

          # Constants
          REGION = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
          SMTP_REGIONS = [
              "us-east-2",  # US East (Ohio)
              "us-east-1",  # US East (N. Virginia)
              "us-west-2",  # US West (Oregon)
              "ap-south-1",  # Asia Pacific (Mumbai)
              "ap-northeast-2",  # Asia Pacific (Seoul)
              "ap-southeast-1",  # Asia Pacific (Singapore)
              "ap-southeast-2",  # Asia Pacific (Sydney)
              "ap-northeast-1",  # Asia Pacific (Tokyo)
              "ca-central-1",  # Canada (Central)
              "eu-central-1",  # Europe (Frankfurt)
              "eu-west-1",  # Europe (Ireland)
              "eu-west-2",  # Europe (London)
              "eu-south-1",  # Europe (Milan)
              "eu-north-1",  # Europe (Stockholm)
              "sa-east-1",  # South America (Sao Paulo)
              "us-gov-west-1",  # AWS GovCloud (US)
              "us-gov-east-1",  # AWS GovCloud (US)
          ]
          CUSTOM_KMS_KEY = not os.environ['KMS_KEY_ARN'] == ""

          # Boto3 Clients
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=REGION)

          # Boto3 Decorators
          """
          These Python decorators signal the success or failure of Lambda-backed CloudFormation
          custom resources. To use these resources:

          1. Since the signal requires data that will be provided by the inputs to the lambda
          handler (i.e., 'event' and 'context'), the long form of a decorator needs to be used.
          For example, if you have the following function defined in your code:

          def sample_function(params):
              ....

          Call the decorator by stating something like:
          'outcome = assess_cfn_status(event, context, data, id, False)(sample_function)(params)'

          3. The last parameter (final_step) of the assess_cfn_status function/decorator indicates
          if this is the final step of the custom resource logic. If set to "True", the decorator will
          send a success signal to CloudFormation if the result is successful. Please note that the
          function will exit without returning the result, so set it to "False" and call
          cfnresponse.send outside of the function if you need to use the result before signaling (i.e.,
          adding the output to the resource output attributes)
          """
          def send_cfn_signal(event, context, data, id, final_step=False):
              def inner(func):
                  def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
                      error = None
                      outcome = func(*args, **kwargs)
                      err_msg = "Custom resource execution failed. See the further details in CloudWatch Log Stream: {}.".format(context.log_stream_name)
                      if isinstance(outcome, dict):
                          if "CFN_Response_Status" in outcome:
                              if "Error_Message" in outcome:
                                  err_msg = outcome["Error_Message"]
                              elif "Error" in outcome:
                                  error = outcome["Error"]
                                  log.error(err_msg)
                              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, id, reason=err_msg)
                              if error is not None:
                                  raise error
                              else:
                                  exit()
                          else:
                              return outcome
                      if final_step:
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, id)
                          exit()
                      else:
                          return outcome
                  return wrapper
              return inner

          def boto3_err_msg(func):
              def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
                  try:
                      response = func(*args, **kwargs)
                      return response
                  except ClientError as err:
                      message = err.response['Error']['Message']
                      log.error(message)
                      payload = {
                          "CFN_Response_Status": cfnresponse.FAILED,
                          "Error_Message": message
                      }
                      return payload
                  except Exception as err:
                      payload = {
                          "CFN_Response_Status": cfnresponse.FAILED,
                          "Error": err
                      }
                      log.error("Encountered error that was not a boto3 ClientError.")
                      return payload
              return wrapper

          def assess_cfn_status(event, context, data, id, final_step=False):
              def inner(boto_func):
                  def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
                      new_func = send_cfn_signal(event, context, data, id, final_step)(boto3_err_msg(boto_func))
                      result = new_func(*args, **kwargs)
                      return result
                  return wrapper
              return inner

          # These values are required to calculate the signature. Do not change them.
          DATE = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          TERMINAL = "aws4_request"
          VERSION = 0x04

          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def calculate_key(secret_access_key, region):
              if region not in SMTP_REGIONS:
                  raise ValueError(f"The {region} Region doesn't have an SMTP endpoint.")

              signature = sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode('utf-8'), DATE)
              signature = sign(signature, region)
              signature = sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = sign(signature, TERMINAL)
              signature = sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              signature_and_version = bytes([VERSION]) + signature
              smtp_password = base64.b64encode(signature_and_version)
              return smtp_password.decode('utf-8')

          def put_parameter(username, value, type):
                  if CUSTOM_KMS_KEY:
                      ssm.put_parameter(
                              Name=f"{username}-smtp-{type}",
                              Description=f"SMTP {type} for email communications",
                              Value=value,
                              Type='SecureString',
                              KeyId=os.environ['KMS_KEY_ARN'],
                              Overwrite=True,
                              Tier='Standard'
                          )
                  else:
                      ssm.put_parameter(
                              Name=f"{username}-smtp-{type}",
                              Description=f"SMTP {type} for email communications",
                              Value=value,
                              Type='SecureString',
                              Overwrite=True,
                              Tier='Standard'
                          )
                  return None

          def delete_smtp_credentials(username, type):
              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=f"{username}-smtp-{type}")
              return None

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              parameter_type = event['ResourceProperties']['ParameterType']
              username = event['ResourceProperties']['UserName']
              key = event['ResourceProperties']['Key']
              parameter_arn = "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/" + f"{username}-smtp-{parameter_type}"
              cfn_data ={}

              if event['RequestType'] == 'Create':
                  if parameter_type == 'username':
                      assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, True)(put_parameter)(username, key, parameter_type)
                  elif parameter_type == 'password':
                      pwd = assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, False)(calculate_key)(key, REGION)
                      assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, True)(put_parameter)(username, pwd, parameter_type)
              elif event['RequestType'] == 'Update':
                  name_change = False
                  if "OldResourceProperties" in event:
                      old_username = event['OldResourceProperties']['UserName']
                      if username != old_username:
                          name_change = True
                  final = not name_change
                  if parameter_type == 'username':
                      assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, final)(put_parameter)(username, key, parameter_type)
                  elif parameter_type == 'password':
                      pwd = assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, False)(calculate_key)(key, REGION)
                      assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, final)(put_parameter)(username, pwd, parameter_type)
                  if name_change:
                      assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, name_change)(delete_smtp_credentials)(old_username, parameter_type)
              elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                  assess_cfn_status(event, context, cfn_data, parameter_arn, True)(delete_smtp_credentials)(username, parameter_type)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: DynamoDB Table with Auto Scaling, mimics console settings.

Parameters:

  MinReadCapacity:
    Description: Minimum provisioned table read capacity units.
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 5
    MaxValue: 40000

  MaxReadCapacity:
    Description: Maximum provisioned table read capacity units.
    Type: Number
    Default: 15
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 40000

  ReadCapacityUtilizationTarget:
    Type: Number
    Description: Target read capacity utlization.
    Default: 70
    MinValue: 50
    MaxValue: 99

  MinWriteCapacity:
    Description: Minimum provisioned table write capacity units.
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 5
    MaxValue: 40000

  MaxWriteCapacity:
    Description: Maximum provisioned table write capacity units.
    Type: Number
    Default: 50
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 40000

  WriteCapacityUtilizationTarget:
    Description: Target write capacity utlization.
    Type: Number
    Default: 70
    MinValue: 50
    MaxValue: 99

Resources:

  DDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"

    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        -
          AttributeName: "ArtistId"
          AttributeType: "S"
        -
          AttributeName: "Concert"
          AttributeType: "S"
        -
          AttributeName: "TicketSales"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        -
          AttributeName: "ArtistId"
          KeyType: "HASH"
        -
          AttributeName: "Concert"
          KeyType: "RANGE"
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinReadCapacity
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinWriteCapacity
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        -
          IndexName: "GSI"
          KeySchema:
            -
              AttributeName: "TicketSales"
              KeyType: "HASH"
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: "KEYS_ONLY"
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 5

  TableReadCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget"
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 15
      MinCapacity: 5
      ResourceId: !Join
        - /
        - - table
          - !Ref DDBTable
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableWriteCapacityScalableTarget:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget"
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 15
      MinCapacity: 5
      ResourceId: !Join
        - /
        - - table
          - !Ref DDBTable
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ScalingRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          -
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service:
                - application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        -
          PolicyName: "root"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              -
                Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateTable"
                  - "cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm"
                  - "cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms"
                  - "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics"
                  - "cloudwatch:SetAlarmState"
                  - "cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms"
                Resource: "*"

  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: WriteAutoScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref WriteCapacityUtilizationTarget
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ReadAutoScalingPolicy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadCapacityScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ReadCapacityUtilizationTarget
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

# This CloudFormation template creates a simple VPC with a highly available network
# architecture, including two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT Gateways
# across two different Availability Zones.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'A highly available VPC with two public and two private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, and route tables.'

# ====================================================================================
# PARAMETERS
# These parameters allow the user to customize the VPC and subnet CIDR blocks.
# ====================================================================================
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in the first AZ.
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in the second AZ.
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in the first AZ.
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in the second AZ.

# ====================================================================================
# RESOURCES
# This is where all the AWS resources are defined.
# ====================================================================================
Resources:
  # The VPC itself
  VPC:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPC'
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  # The Internet Gateway for public access
  InternetGateway:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::InternetGateway'
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGateway'

  # Attach the Internet Gateway to the VPC
  AttachGateway:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnet 1
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      # Use the Fn::Select function to get the first Availability Zone
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'

  # Public Subnet 2
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      # Use the Fn::Select function to get the second Availability Zone
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'

  # Elastic IP for NAT Gateway 1
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::EIP'
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateway 1 for private subnet in AZ1
  NatGateway1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::NatGateway'
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1'

  # Elastic IP for NAT Gateway 2
  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::EIP'
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateway 2 for private subnet in AZ2
  NatGateway2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::NatGateway'
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2'

  # Private Subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      # Use the Fn::Select function to get the first Availability Zone
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'

  # Private Subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      # Use the Fn::Select function to get the second Availability Zone
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'

  # Route table for the public subnets
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::RouteTable'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable'

  # Route that sends all internet-bound traffic from the public subnets to the Internet Gateway
  PublicRoute:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Route'
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Associate public subnet 1 with its route table
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Associate public subnet 2 with its route table
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Route table for private subnet 1
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::RouteTable'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1'

  # Route for private subnet 1 to the NAT Gateway in AZ1
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Route'
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  # Associate private subnet 1 with its route table
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  # Route table for private subnet 2
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::RouteTable'
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2'

  # Route for private subnet 2 to the NAT Gateway in AZ2
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Route'
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # Associate private subnet 2 with its route table
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

# ====================================================================================
# OUTPUTS
# These outputs provide useful information after the stack is created.
# ====================================================================================
Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: The ID of the new VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCId"
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id"
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id"
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of the first private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: The ID of the second private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"

trivy_findings_json: [{"id": "AWS-0066", "severity": "LOW", "title": "Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled", "type": "CloudFormation Security Check", "message": "Function does not have tracing enabled.", "resolution": "Enable tracing", "resource": "tmp8y4e62qt.yaml:197-215", "query": "data.builtin.aws.lambda.aws0066.deny"}]
content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AWS Partner Revenue Measurement (PRM) - tag resources by rule. Each rule maps a
  set of resources (by service/resource-type and/or by existing tags) to a partner
  product code (aws-apn-id = pc:<code>). Rules are evaluated in order; each resource
  is tagged by the FIRST matching rule (a resource can carry only one aws-apn-id
  tag). By default it never overwrites another partner's existing aws-apn-id tag,
  checks that Cost Explorer (the other PRM prerequisite) is enabled, and can send a
  status beacon to the partner by assuming a cross-account IAM role they provide.
  Optionally re-runs on a schedule.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label: { default: Tagging rules }
        Parameters: [TaggingRules]
      - Label: { default: Options }
        Parameters: [PreserveExistingTags, ReTagSchedule, PreserveTagsOnDelete]
      - Label: { default: "Status beacon (optional, provided by your partner)" }
        Parameters: [BeaconRoleArn, BeaconExternalId, BeaconTable, BeaconRegion]
    ParameterLabels:
      TaggingRules: { default: Tagging rules (JSON) }
      PreserveExistingTags: { default: Preserve another partner's existing tag }
      ReTagSchedule: { default: Re-tag schedule }
      PreserveTagsOnDelete: { default: Keep tags when stack is deleted }
      BeaconRoleArn: { default: Beacon role ARN }
      BeaconExternalId: { default: Beacon external id }
      BeaconTable: { default: Beacon table name }
      BeaconRegion: { default: Beacon table region }

Parameters:
  TaggingRules:
    Type: String
    Default: "[]"
    Description: >-
      JSON array of rules, evaluated in order. Each rule: {"productCode":"<code>",
      "resourceTypes":["ec2:instance","rds:db"], "tagFilters":[{"Key":"Public",
      "Values":["true"]}]}. resourceTypes and tagFilters are optional; a rule with
      neither matches every taggable resource. Example (public-facing -> pen test,
      databases -> managed compliance, everything else -> managed services):
      [{"productCode":"PENTEST_CODE","tagFilters":[{"Key":"PublicFacing",
      "Values":["true"]}]},{"productCode":"COMPLIANCE_CODE","resourceTypes":
      ["rds:db","dynamodb:table"]},{"productCode":"MANAGED_SVC_CODE"}].
      Default "[]" tags nothing - supply your rules.
  PreserveExistingTags:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: >-
      If true (default), resources that already carry a DIFFERENT partner's
      aws-apn-id tag are left untouched, so you never overwrite another partner's
      attribution. Set false to overwrite every matched resource.
  ReTagSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(1 day)"
    Description: >-
      EventBridge schedule expression to re-run tagging, which catches newly created
      resources and re-applies any tags stripped by an IaC deploy. Defaults to daily
      (rate(1 day)). Set to an empty string to disable and tag only on stack
      create/update.
  PreserveTagsOnDelete:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: >-
      If true (default), deleting this stack LEAVES the aws-apn-id tags in place so
      revenue attribution is not interrupted. Set false to remove all aws-apn-id
      tags when the stack is deleted.
  BeaconRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional. The cross-account IAM role ARN your partner gave you. If set, after
      tagging the Lambda assumes this role and writes a small status record
      (account, region, resources tagged, Cost Explorer status) to the partner's
      account. Nothing is sent unless this is set, and only the partner-controlled
      account can be written to.
  BeaconExternalId:
    Type: String
    Default: "jacobian-prm"
    Description: External id to present when assuming the beacon role (from your partner).
  BeaconTable:
    Type: String
    Default: "prm-phone-home"
    Description: DynamoDB table name in the partner account (from your partner).
  BeaconRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1"
    Description: Region of the partner's beacon table.

Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ReTagSchedule, ""]]
  HasBeacon: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BeaconRoleArn, ""]]

Resources:
  TaggerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: lambda.amazonaws.com }
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: prm-tagging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TaggingApiAndReadOnlyChecks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                  - tag:TagResources
                  - tag:UntagResources
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ServiceLevelTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: "*"
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - rds:AddTagsToResource
                  - rds:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - rds:ListTagsForResource
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                  - dynamodb:TagResource
                  - dynamodb:UntagResource
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                  - eks:TagResource
                  - eks:UntagResource
                  - ecs:TagResource
                  - ecs:UntagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:TagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:UntagResource
                  - backup:TagResource
                  - backup:UntagResource
                  - cloudfront:TagResource
                  - cloudfront:UntagResource
                  - apigateway:PUT
                  - apigateway:DELETE
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                  - logs:UntagLogGroup
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:UntagResource
                  - sns:TagResource
                  - sns:UntagResource
                  - sqs:TagQueue
                  - sqs:UntagQueue
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                  - secretsmanager:UntagResource
                  - elasticache:AddTagsToResource
                  - elasticache:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - es:AddTags
                  - es:RemoveTags
                  - states:TagResource
                  - states:UntagResource
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                  - ecr:TagResource
                  - ecr:UntagResource
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - bedrock:TagResource
                  - bedrock:UntagResource
                  - fsx:TagResource
                  - fsx:UntagResource
                  - glue:TagResource
                  - glue:UntagResource
                  - kinesis:AddTagsToStream
                  - kinesis:RemoveTagsFromStream
                  - firehose:TagDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:UntagDeliveryStream
                  - redshift:CreateTags
                  - redshift:DeleteTags

  BeaconAssumePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasBeacon
    Properties:
      PolicyName: prm-beacon-assume
      Roles: [!Ref TaggerRole]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: !Ref BeaconRoleArn

  TaggerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Applies PRM aws-apn-id tags to existing resources by rule.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt TaggerRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          RULES: !Ref TaggingRules
          PRESERVE: !Ref PreserveExistingTags
          BEACON_ROLE_ARN: !Ref BeaconRoleArn
          BEACON_EXTERNAL_ID: !Ref BeaconExternalId
          BEACON_TABLE: !Ref BeaconTable
          BEACON_REGION: !Ref BeaconRegion
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,datetime,boto3
          K="aws-apn-id"
          def g(c,**f):
           o=[];t=None
           while 1:
            if t:f["PaginationToken"]=t
            r=c.get_resources(ResourcesPerPage=100,**f)
            o+=r["ResourceTagMappingList"];t=r.get("PaginationToken")
            if not t:break
           return o
          def b(a,fn):
           for i in range(0,len(a),20):fn(a[i:i+20])
          def ex(m):
           for t in m.get("Tags",[]):
            if t["Key"]==K:return t["Value"]
          def ap(c,rules,keep):
           seen=set();n=0
           for r in rules:
            f={}
            if r.get("resourceTypes"):f["ResourceTypeFilters"]=r["resourceTypes"]
            if r.get("tagFilters"):f["TagFilters"]=r["tagFilters"]
            v="pc:"+r["productCode"];arns=[]
            for m in g(c,**f):
             a=m["ResourceARN"]
             if a in seen:continue
             e=ex(m)
             if e==v:seen.add(a);continue
             if e and keep:continue
             arns.append(a)
            b(arns,lambda z,v=v:c.tag_resources(ResourceARNList=z,Tags={K:v}))
            seen.update(arns);n+=len(arns)
           return n
          def ce():
           try:
            e=datetime.date.today();s=e-datetime.timedelta(days=1)
            boto3.client("ce").get_cost_and_usage(TimePeriod={"Start":s.isoformat(),"End":e.isoformat()},Granularity="DAILY",Metrics=["UnblendedCost"]);return True
           except Exception:return False
          def ph(d):
           ra=os.environ.get("BEACON_ROLE_ARN","")
           if not ra:return
           try:
            cr=boto3.client("sts").assume_role(RoleArn=ra,RoleSessionName="prm-beacon",ExternalId=os.environ.get("BEACON_EXTERNAL_ID","prm"))["Credentials"]
            boto3.client("dynamodb",region_name=os.environ.get("BEACON_REGION","us-east-1"),aws_access_key_id=cr["AccessKeyId"],aws_secret_access_key=cr["SecretAccessKey"],aws_session_token=cr["SessionToken"]).put_item(TableName=os.environ.get("BEACON_TABLE","prm-phone-home"),Item={"pk":{"S":"ACCT#"+d["account"]},"sk":{"S":d["region"]+"#"+str(int(datetime.datetime.now().timestamp()))},"account":{"S":d["account"]},"region":{"S":d["region"]},"event":{"S":str(d["event"])},"tagged":{"N":str(d["tagged"])},"ceEnabled":{"BOOL":bool(d["ceEnabled"])},"codes":{"S":",".join(d.get("codes") or [])}})
           except Exception:pass
          def handler(e,ctx):
           c=boto3.client("resourcegroupstaggingapi")
           acct=boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
           reg=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION","")
           keep=os.environ.get("PRESERVE","true").lower()=="true"
           if "RequestType" not in e:
            R=json.loads(os.environ.get("RULES","[]"));n=ap(c,R,keep)
            ph({"event":"schedule","account":acct,"region":reg,"tagged":n,"ceEnabled":ce(),"codes":[r.get("productCode") for r in R]});return
           import cfnresponse
           p=e.get("ResourceProperties",{});rt=e["RequestType"]
           try:
            if rt=="Delete":
             if str(p.get("PreserveOnDelete","true")).lower()!="true":
              b([m["ResourceARN"] for m in g(c,TagFilters=[{"Key":K}])],lambda z:c.untag_resources(ResourceARNList=z,TagKeys=[K]))
             cfnresponse.send(e,ctx,cfnresponse.SUCCESS,{});return
            R=p.get("Rules",[])
            if isinstance(R,str):R=json.loads(R)
            n=ap(c,R,keep);ok=ce()
            ph({"event":rt,"account":acct,"region":reg,"tagged":n,"ceEnabled":ok,"codes":[r.get("productCode") for r in R]})
            cfnresponse.send(e,ctx,cfnresponse.SUCCESS,{"tagged":n,"ceEnabled":ok})
           except Exception as x:
            cfnresponse.send(e,ctx,cfnresponse.FAILED,{"error":str(x)[:300]})

  TagApplier:
    Type: Custom::PrmTagger
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TaggerFunction.Arn
      PreserveOnDelete: !Ref PreserveTagsOnDelete
      Rules: !Ref TaggingRules

  ScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Description: Periodically re-run PRM tagging to catch new resources.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ReTagSchedule
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt TaggerFunction.Arn
          Id: prm-retag

  SchedulePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref TaggerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt ScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  FunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the tagging Lambda.
    Value: !GetAtt TaggerFunction.Arn
